domains.name: member
domains.description: Single source of truth for all insured individuals — members, subscribers, dependents, and beneficiaries across commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and CHIP lines of business. Owns member demographics, PII/PHI identity, eligibility status, LOB assignment, COBRA continuants, household relationships, and member lifecycle events. All other domains reference member identity via FK. Supports HIPAA privacy obligations and CMS enrollment reporting.

products.name: subscriber
products.description: Core master entity representing the primary insured individual (subscriber/policyholder) who holds the health insurance contract. Captures full demographic identity including SSN, date of birth, gender, marital status, language preference, race/ethnicity (for HEDIS/CMS reporting), tobacco use status, disability status, and Medicare/Medicaid beneficiary identifiers. Serves as the SSOT for subscriber identity across commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and CHIP lines of business. All dependent, eligibility, and benefit records reference this entity. Supports HIPAA PHI/PII obligations, CMS enrollment reporting, and X12 834 subscriber loop requirements.

products.name: dependent
products.description: Master entity representing individuals covered under a subscriber's health plan — spouses, domestic partners, children, and other qualifying dependents. Tracks relationship type to subscriber, dependent sequence number, student status, disability status, age-out eligibility rules, and CHIP/Medicaid eligibility indicators. Maintains its own demographic profile including DOB, gender, SSN, and language preference. Supports dependent verification workflows, age-out processing, and CMS CHIP enrollment reporting. Each dependent record is linked to a subscriber and an enrollment span.

products.name: identity
products.description: Authoritative identity resolution record for each unique insured individual (subscriber or dependent) assigned a unique member ID by the health plan. Stores the plan-assigned member ID (MBI for Medicare, Medicaid ID, commercial member ID), cross-reference IDs from source systems (Facets member ID, QNXT ID), alternate IDs (SSN hash, external subscriber ID from employer), and identity verification status. Manages member ID history and superseded IDs. This is the enterprise golden record for member identity used by all downstream domains (claims, pharmacy, care management) to resolve member identity.

products.name: member_contact
products.description: Single source of truth for all member contact information and addresses. Manages physical and mailing addresses (home, mailing, temporary, employer), phone numbers (home, mobile, work), email addresses, and fax numbers. Tracks contact type, address type, effective and termination dates, address verification status (USPS CASS-certified), county FIPS code, census tract, geographic coordinates for network adequacy analysis, opt-in/opt-out status per channel (SMS, email, robocall), TCPA consent flags, and preferred contact method and language. Supports multiple concurrent addresses with priority ranking. Used for premium billing, EOB mailing, provider directory access, CMS geographic reporting, member services outreach, care management communications, and CAHPS survey administration. Maintains full address and contact history for audit and compliance purposes.

products.name: household
products.description: Represents a family or household unit grouping subscribers and their dependents under a common household identifier. Tracks household composition, head of household designation, household size, income level for ACA subsidy eligibility and Medicaid MAGI calculations, and federal poverty level (FPL) percentage. Supports family deductible and out-of-pocket maximum aggregation, COB household relationship tracking, ACA marketplace household eligibility determinations, and premium tax credit calculations. Used for Medicaid household income verification and CMS enrollment reporting.

products.name: member_grievance
products.description: Operational record of formal member grievances (non-appeal complaints) filed against the health plan regarding service quality, access to care, provider behavior, billing disputes, or administrative issues. Tracks grievance receipt date, grievance type code (quality of care, access, attitude/service, billing/financial, benefit/coverage), issue category, member-reported description, assigned investigator, investigation timeline, resolution date, resolution type, resolution description, member satisfaction with resolution, regulatory reporting flag, and CMS/state DOI reportable indicator. products.name: member_communication
products.description: Tracks all outbound and inbound communications with members and manages ID card issuance and fulfillment. Communication types include: EOB mailings, welcome kits, ID card issuance (physical and digital), Annual Notice of Change (ANOC), Evidence of Coverage (EOC), SBC (Summary of Benefits and Coverage), care gap notifications, wellness program invitations, and regulatory notices. Records communication type, channel (mail, email, SMS, phone, portal), send date, delivery status, template version, regulatory requirement flag (e.g., CMS-mandated notice), language used, and member acknowledgment status. domains.name: enrollment
domains.description: Manages the end-to-end enrollment and eligibility lifecycle — open enrollment, special enrollment periods, qualifying life events, 834 EDI transactions, effective dates, terminations, reinstatements, and retroactive adjustments. products.name: enrollment_eligibility_span

products.name: reconciliation
products.description: Transactional record capturing periodic reconciliation between the health plan's enrollment records and external authoritative sources — employer group rosters, CMS enrollment files (TRR/MARx), state Medicaid agency 834 files, and ACA exchange enrollment data. Captures reconciliation run date, source system, discrepancy count by type (adds, terms, changes, demographic mismatches), auto-resolution vs. manual resolution status, resolution deadline, and financial impact of unresolved discrepancies on premium billing and risk adjustment. Critical for CMS compliance (monthly TRR reconciliation), premium billing accuracy, and employer group roster integrity.
products.reference: CMS Enrollment Reconciliation / Employer Group Reconciliation Standards

products.name: exchange_enrollment
products.description: Master record for enrollments originating from ACA health insurance exchanges — Federally Facilitated Marketplace (FFM), State-Based Marketplaces (SBM), and SHOP exchange. Captures exchange transaction ID, marketplace plan ID (HIOS ID), APTC amount and reconciliation status, CSR variant, eligibility determination reference, effectuation status, 1095-A reporting flag, and premium payment effectuation deadline. Interfaces with CMS FFM enrollment data feeds. Critical for ACA compliance, APTC reconciliation with IRS, and annual 1095-A generation. Sourced from Availity/Change Healthcare exchange gateway and CMS 834 files.

domains.name: plan
domains.description: Single source of truth for all health plan products and benefit designs — HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, QHP, and government plans (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid). Owns benefit structures, cost-sharing rules (deductibles, copays, coinsurance, OOP, MOOP), formulary tiers, SBC documents, plan-year configurations, and regulatory classifications. Supports ACA compliance, CMS plan submissions, and benefits configuration in core administration platforms (Facets, QNXT).
domains.references: ACA, CMS Plan Filing Standards, NAIC

products.name: health_plan
products.description: Master catalog of all health plan products offered by the insurer — HMO, PPO, EPO, POS, HDHP, QHP, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid managed care plans. Serves as the SSOT for plan identity, plan type classification, line of business (LOB), market segment (individual, small group, large group, Medicare, Medicaid), regulatory classification, CMS plan ID, HIOS plan ID, plan-year lifecycle, and provider network configuration (network ID, tiered network designations, access type, out-of-network coverage rules, network adequacy standards). Foundational entity for all benefit configuration, enrollment, and claims adjudication in Facets/QNXT.

products.name: benefit_package
products.description: Defines the structured benefit package associated with a health plan and plan year, grouping all covered services into a coherent benefit design. Captures package name, effective dates, plan-year, benefit tier (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum for ACA QHPs), actuarial value percentage, metal tier classification, embedded vs. aggregate deductible design, and full pharmacy benefit configuration — PBM vendor, formulary ID, retail vs. mail-order copay differentials, specialty pharmacy requirements, 90-day supply rules, mandatory generic substitution flags, specialty drug management programs, and retail/mail-order/specialty pharmacy network designations. products.name: benefit
products.description: Granular catalog of individual covered benefits within a benefit package — medical, dental, vision, behavioral health, pharmacy, DME, SNF, home health, preventive, wellness, and ancillary services. Each benefit record captures the benefit category, CPT/HCPCS service category, coverage type (in-network, out-of-network), and serves as the anchor for child-level structures: benefit limits (visit limits, day limits, dollar limits as child arrays), exclusions and non-covered service rules (as child arrays), ACA Essential Health Benefit (EHB) classification, wellness/preventive mandate flags, and prior authorization requirement indicators. Directly drives claims adjudication rules in Facets/QNXT. Sub-entities modeled as child arrays: benefit_limit (limit_type, limit_value, limit_period, accumulation_rule), benefit_exclusion (exclusion_type, exclusion_code, exclusion_reason), and benefit_authorization_flag (auth_required, auth_type, review_level).

products.name: cost_share_rule
products.description: Defines cost-sharing parameters for a specific benefit within a benefit package — deductibles, copays, coinsurance rates, out-of-pocket maximums (MOOP), and accumulator threshold definitions. products.name: provider_provider
products.description: Core master entity representing all healthcare providers — physicians, hospitals, clinics, ancillary providers, facilities, DME suppliers, and behavioral health providers. Serves as the NPI-based SSOT for provider identity across the enterprise. Stores individual (Type 1 NPI) and organizational (Type 2 NPI) provider records sourced from Cactus or ProviderSource. Includes provider type, taxonomy code, primary specialty, DEA number, UPIN, TIN/EIN, gender, languages spoken (with proficiency), cultural competency certifications, contact information for key operational contacts (credentialing, billing, office manager), malpractice coverage status flag, board certification summary status, and provider status flags. Supports CMS provider directory accuracy mandates, NCQA credentialing standards, and CLAS standards for language access.

A provider may hold multiple specialties across different taxonomies. Supports network adequacy analysis by specialty and HEDIS measure attribution.

products.name: practice_location
products.description: Represents a physical or virtual practice location where a provider delivers care. Captures address (street, city, state, ZIP+4), county, FIPS code, geolocation (lat/long), phone, fax, office hours, accessibility features (ADA compliance, wheelchair access), telehealth availability, accepting new patients flag by location, patient age/population restrictions, and location type (office, hospital, urgent care, telehealth-only). Supports CMS provider directory accuracy requirements, network adequacy geographic access standards (time/distance), and member-facing provider search. A provider may have multiple practice locations; each location may serve multiple providers.

products.name: license
products.description: Single source of truth for all professional licenses, certifications, and regulatory registrations held by a provider. Covers state medical licenses (MD, DO, NP, PA, RN, LCSW, LPC, etc.), DEA controlled substance registrations (including authorized schedules II-V and registration state), CDS (state-level controlled dangerous substance) permits, state pharmacy licenses, and other regulatory registrations. Stores license/registration type, issuing authority (state medical board, state nursing board, DEA, CMS, state pharmacy board), license or registration number, authorized schedules (for DEA/CDS), issue date, expiration date, renewal date, status (active, suspended, revoked, expired, surrendered, pending renewal), disciplinary action flags, disciplinary action details, and primary source verification (PSV) date and source. Supports NCQA credentialing standards for PSV, multi-state licensure tracking via Interstate Medical Licensure Compact, controlled substance prescribing authorization, pharmacy benefit management workflows, and state-specific scope-of-practice validation.
products.reference: NCQA Credentialing Standards, State Medical Board Records

attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the current active version of the license record. True for the current record; false for historical versions. Supports Type 2 slowly changing dimension queries.

attributes.name: record_effective_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time from which this version of the license record is effective for business reporting. Supports Type 2 slowly changing dimension tracking.

attributes.name: record_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this version of the license record was superseded by a new version. Null for the current active record. Supports Type 2 slowly changing dimension tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this license record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: renewal_cycle_months
attributes.description: The number of months between required renewals for this license type. Common values are 12, 24, or 36 months depending on state and license type.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date the license was last renewed. Used to track renewal cycles and ensure continuous licensure for credentialing purposes.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards, State Licensing Board Requirements

attributes.name: scope_of_practice
attributes.description: Description of the clinical activities and services the provider is authorized to perform under this license. Varies by license type and state regulations. Used for state-specific scope-of-practice validation.
attributes.references: State Licensing Board Scope of Practice Regulations, NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this license data originated. Typically the Provider Management System (Cactus or ProviderSource) or credentialing platform.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this license record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: telemedicine_authorized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is authorized to deliver telemedicine services under this license. True if telemedicine practice is permitted; false otherwise. Critical for virtual care network management.
attributes.references: State Telemedicine Regulations, CMS Telehealth Requirements

attributes.name: verification_source
attributes.description: The specific entity or system used to perform primary source verification. Examples include state medical board website, NPDB, third-party credentialing verification organization (CVO), or automated verification service.

attributes.name: verification_url
attributes.description: The web address of the state licensing board or regulatory authority where the license can be verified online. Used for automated primary source verification workflows.

products.name: affiliation
products.description: Captures the organizational affiliations of individual providers — medical group memberships, IPA affiliations, ACO participation, health system relationships, and hospital associations. Stores affiliation type, affiliated organization (group practice or facility reference), affiliation start and end dates, department, role, and active status. Supports provider directory accuracy, network configuration, claims routing logic, and understanding of provider-to-organization hierarchies. For hospital-based providers, captures the association with the facility where the provider practices.

attributes.name: affiliation_id
attributes.description: Primary key for affiliation

attributes.name: coordinator_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Affiliation coordination is handled by a specific employee who manages contracts, privileges, and network status for each affiliation.

attributes.name: group_practice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to provider.group_practice. Business justification: affiliation should reference the medical group (group_practice) it belongs to; the existing column name does not match target PK naming, so a new FK column is added and the generic column removed.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual provider (physician, nurse practitioner, or other healthcare professional) who holds this affiliation. Links to the provider master entity.

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator denoting whether the provider is accepting new patients through this affiliation. True indicates accepting new patients; False indicates not accepting new patients.

attributes.name: admitting_privileges_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator denoting whether the provider has admitting privileges at the affiliated hospital or facility. True indicates admitting privileges are granted; False indicates no admitting privileges.

attributes.name: affiliation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the provider affiliation. Indicates whether the affiliation is active and in effect, inactive, suspended, pending approval, or terminated.

attributes.name: affiliation_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the affiliation relationship. Indicates whether the provider is affiliated with a medical group, Independent Practice Association (IPA), Accountable Care Organization (ACO), health system, hospital, or other facility type.

attributes.name: billing_npi
attributes.description: The National Provider Identifier (NPI) used for billing purposes in this affiliation context. May represent the organizational NPI (Type 2) of the affiliated entity.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this affiliation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: credentialing_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's credentials and affiliation with the organization were last verified. Used to track compliance with credentialing re-verification requirements.

attributes.name: department_name
attributes.description: The name of the department, division, or service line within the affiliated organization where the provider practices. Examples include Cardiology, Emergency Medicine, Orthopedic Surgery, Primary Care.

attributes.name: directory_display_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator denoting whether this affiliation should be displayed in the member-facing provider directory. True indicates the affiliation is publicly visible; False indicates it is for internal use only.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider affiliation ended or is scheduled to end. Null for open-ended affiliations that are currently active.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last updated this affiliation record. Supports audit and accountability requirements.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this affiliation record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: medical_staff_category
attributes.description: The category of medical staff membership the provider holds at the affiliated hospital or facility. Categories include Active Staff, Courtesy Staff, Consulting Staff, Honorary Staff, Affiliate Staff, and Provisional Staff.

attributes.name: network_participation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator denoting whether this affiliation makes the provider eligible for participation in the health plan's provider network. True indicates network participation; False indicates non-participating affiliation.

attributes.name: next_credentialing_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next credentialing verification for this affiliation is due. Supports proactive credentialing workflow management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the provider affiliation. May include details about practice restrictions, scheduling notes, or administrative remarks.

attributes.name: primary_affiliation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator denoting whether this is the provider's primary organizational affiliation. True indicates this is the main affiliation; False indicates a secondary or additional affiliation.

attributes.name: role_title
attributes.description: The provider's role or title within the affiliated organization. Examples include Staff Physician, Medical Director, Department Chair, Attending Physician, Consulting Physician.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this affiliation record in the source system. Used for traceability and reconciliation with upstream systems.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this affiliation record originated. Examples include Cactus, ProviderSource, credentialing system, or manual entry.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider affiliation became effective. Represents the beginning of the provider-organization relationship.

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: The Tax Identification Number (TIN) or Employer Identification Number (EIN) under which the provider bills for services rendered through this affiliation. Used for claims routing and payment processing.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this affiliation record. Supports audit and accountability requirements.

products.name: group_practice
products.description: Represents a medical group, physician organization, IPA, or multi-specialty group practice as a distinct business entity with its own Type 2 NPI and TIN. Stores group name, group NPI, TIN/EIN, group type (solo practice, group practice, IPA, FQHC, RHC), primary specialty, address, phone, CMS certification number, and group size. Serves as the organizational parent for individual provider affiliations and supports group-level contracting and network participation.
products.reference: CMS Group Practice Enrollment, Type 2 NPI

attributes.name: group_practice_id
attributes.description: Primary key for group_practice

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Group practice financial statements require linking each practice group to its cost center for consolidated reporting.

attributes.name: group_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Group Practice Management requires a designated practice manager employee overseeing operations, staffing, and compliance for the group.

attributes.name: medicaid_provider_id
attributes.description: The state-assigned Medicaid provider identifier for the group practice, used for Medicaid claims submission.

attributes.name: medicare_provider_id
attributes.description: The Medicare-assigned provider identifier for the group practice, used for Medicare claims submission and enrollment.

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group practice is currently accepting new patients. Used for provider directory accuracy and member access.

attributes.name: accessibility_accommodations
attributes.description: Description of accessibility accommodations available at the group practice (e.g., wheelchair access, hearing loop, accessible exam tables) to comply with ADA requirements.

attributes.name: aco_name
attributes.description: The name of the ACO in which the group practice participates, if applicable.

attributes.name: aco_participant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group practice participates in an Accountable Care Organization (ACO) for value-based care arrangements.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: The primary street address line 1 of the group practice's main location or headquarters.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: The primary street address line 2 (suite, floor, building) of the group practice's main location.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: The city where the group practice's primary location is situated.

attributes.name: cms_certification_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Certification Number (CCN)
attributes.description: The CMS Certification Number (CCN) assigned to FQHC, RHC, or other certified facilities. Required for Medicare/Medicaid billing.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: The county in which the group practice's primary location is located. Used for network adequacy and geographic access reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this group practice record was first created in the provider management system.

attributes.name: credentialing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the group practice was initially credentialed and approved for network participation.

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: The current credentialing status of the group practice within the health plan's credentialing process.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this group practice record originated (e.g., Cactus, ProviderSource, NPPES).

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: The trade name or DBA name under which the group practice operates, if different from the legal name.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the group practice's participation in the health plan network became effective.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: The primary email address for administrative and contracting communications with the group practice.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: The fax number for the group practice, used for prior authorization and medical records transmission.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: The legal business name of the medical group, physician organization, or practice entity as registered with state authorities and CMS.

attributes.name: group_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit Type 2 NPI assigned to the group practice organization by CMS. This is the organizational NPI distinct from individual provider NPIs.
attributes.references: CMS National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES)

attributes.name: group_size
attributes.description: The total number of individual providers (physicians, nurse practitioners, physician assistants) affiliated with and practicing under this group.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Classification of the group practice organizational structure: solo practice (single physician), single specialty group, multi-specialty group, Independent Practice Association (IPA), Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC), or Rural Health Clinic (RHC).
attributes.references: CMS Provider Taxonomy, HRSA FQHC/RHC Designation

attributes.name: hospital_affiliation
attributes.description: The name of the primary hospital or health system with which the group practice is affiliated or has admitting privileges.

attributes.name: language_services_offered
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of languages in which the group practice offers clinical services, used for provider directory cultural competency and member access.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Standards, ACA Section 1557

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: The current participation status of the group practice in the health plan's provider network. Active indicates the group is contracted and accepting members.

attributes.name: pcmh_recognition_level
attributes.description: The NCQA PCMH recognition level achieved by the group practice (Level 1, 2, or 3), with Level 3 being the highest.

attributes.name: pcmh_recognized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group practice has achieved NCQA Patient-Centered Medical Home (PCMH) recognition, qualifying for enhanced reimbursement and quality incentives.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: The primary contact phone number for the group practice.

attributes.name: primary_specialty
attributes.description: The primary medical specialty or service focus of the group practice (e.g., Family Medicine, Cardiology, Orthopedic Surgery, Multi-Specialty).

attributes.name: recredentialing_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the group practice must complete recredentialing to maintain network participation. NCQA requires recredentialing at least every 36 months.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: The two-letter state abbreviation for the group practice's primary location.

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tax Identification Number (TIN) / Employer Identification Number (EIN)
attributes.description: The federal tax identification number (TIN/EIN) assigned to the group practice by the IRS. Used for claims payment and 1099 reporting.

attributes.name: taxonomy_code
attributes.description: The 10-character alphanumeric taxonomy code identifying the group's primary classification, specialty, and area of practice per the NUCC taxonomy.
attributes.references: National Uniform Claim Committee (NUCC) Health Care Provider Taxonomy

attributes.name: telehealth_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the group practice offers telehealth or telemedicine services to members.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the group practice's participation in the health plan network was terminated or is scheduled to terminate. Null for active participants.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason for termination of the group practice's network participation (e.g., voluntary withdrawal, quality issues, credentialing failure, contract non-renewal).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this group practice record was last modified in the provider management system.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: The public website URL for the group practice, used in provider directory listings.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: The 5-digit or 9-digit ZIP code for the group practice's primary location.

products.name: facility
products.description: Master record for healthcare facilities — hospitals, SNFs, ASCs, FQHCs, RHCs, behavioral health facilities, home health agencies, hospices, dialysis centers, and DME suppliers. Stores facility name, facility type, CMS certification number (CCN), Medicare/Medicaid certification status, accreditation body (Joint Commission, DNV, CIHQ), accreditation expiration, bed count, trauma level, teaching hospital status, critical access hospital designation, CLIA number, and facility NPI. Distinct from individual provider records; supports institutional claims (837I) routing, network adequacy facility-type analysis, and CMS Star Rating facility attribution. Serves as the organizational anchor for hospital privilege tracking.
products.reference: CMS Certification Number (CCN), Joint Commission Accreditation

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the healthcare facility record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Facility operational costs are tracked against a cost center for capital budgeting and regulatory cost reporting.

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is currently accepting new patients. Used in provider directory and network adequacy reporting.

attributes.name: accreditation_body
attributes.description: Organization that has accredited the facility. Values: joint_commission (The Joint Commission), dnv (DNV Healthcare), cihq (Center for Improvement in Healthcare Quality), aoa (American Osteopathic Association), aaahc (Accreditation Association for Ambulatory Health Care), achc (Accreditation Commission for Health Care), none (not accredited). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: joint_commission|dnv|cihq|aoa|aaahc|achc|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: accreditation_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current accreditation expires. Null if facility is not accredited.

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the facility physical location.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite, floor, or building number.

attributes.name: bed_count
attributes.description: Total number of licensed beds at the facility. Used for network adequacy calculations and capacity planning.

attributes.name: ccn
attributes.description: Six-character alphanumeric identifier assigned by CMS to Medicare/Medicaid certified facilities. Also known as Provider Number.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where the facility is located.

attributes.name: clia_number
attributes.description: Ten-character identifier issued by CMS for facilities performing laboratory testing. Format: 2-digit state code + 1 letter + 7 digits.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: County where the facility is located. Used for network adequacy geographic analysis.

attributes.name: credentialing_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the current credentialing approval became effective.

attributes.name: credentialing_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current credentialing approval expires and recredentialing is required.

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current status of the facility credentialing process. Indicates whether the facility has passed credentialing review and is approved for network participation.

attributes.name: critical_access_hospital_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is designated as a Critical Access Hospital under the Medicare Rural Hospital Flexibility Program.
attributes.references: CMS Critical Access Hospital Standards (42 CFR 485)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the facility record or current participation status became effective.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for facility communications and electronic correspondence.

attributes.name: emergency_services_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility provides 24/7 emergency department services.

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the healthcare facility as registered with state and federal authorities.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the healthcare facility. Values: hospital (acute care hospital), snf (Skilled Nursing Facility), asc (Ambulatory Surgical Center), fqhc (Federally Qualified Health Center), rhc (Rural Health Clinic), behavioral_health (behavioral health facility). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hospital|snf|asc|fqhc|rhc|behavioral_health|home_health|hospice|dialysis_center|dme_supplier|ltac|irf|imaging_center — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the facility, used for prior authorization and medical records transmission.

attributes.name: medicaid_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is certified to participate in the Medicaid program.

attributes.name: medicare_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is certified to participate in the Medicare program.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Tiering classification of the facility within the provider network. Tier 1 is preferred/lowest cost-sharing. Out_of_network indicates non-participating facility.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: Type 2 NPI assigned to the facility by CMS. Ten-digit unique organizational identifier required for HIPAA transactions.

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal ownership structure of the facility. Values: for_profit (investor-owned), non_profit (tax-exempt), government (federal/state/local), tribal (Indian Health Service or tribal).

attributes.name: parent_organization_name
attributes.description: Name of the parent health system or organization that owns or operates the facility. Null if facility is independent.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the facility in the provider network. Indicates whether the facility is actively participating, suspended, or terminated.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the facility.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Five or nine-digit ZIP code of the facility location.

attributes.name: quality_rating
attributes.description: Overall quality rating score for the facility on a scale of 1.00 to 5.00. Derived from CMS Star Ratings, HEDIS measures, or internal quality assessments.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facility record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facility record was last updated in the data platform.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this facility record originated (e.g., Cactus, ProviderSource).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this facility in the source system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state abbreviation where the facility is located.

attributes.name: tax_identifier
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) assigned by IRS. Used for claims payment and 1099 reporting.

attributes.name: teaching_hospital_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is a teaching hospital affiliated with a medical school and residency programs.

attributes.name: telehealth_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility offers telehealth or virtual care services.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the facility participation was terminated or is scheduled to terminate. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: trauma_level
attributes.description: Trauma center designation level assigned by state or American College of Surgeons. Level 1 is highest capability. Not_designated indicates facility is not a trauma center.
attributes.references: American College of Surgeons Trauma Center Verification

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Public website URL for the facility. Used in provider directory.

products.name: directory_entry
products.description: Published provider directory record representing the consumer-facing view of a provider's participation in a specific health plan and network. Captures provider display name, accepting new patients status, languages spoken, telehealth availability, network tier, plan participation, directory publication date, last verified date, and directory accuracy attestation status. Supports CMS and state DOI provider directory accuracy mandates (no-surprise billing, network adequacy). Distinct from the internal provider master — this is the published, plan-specific directory entry.
products.reference: CMS Provider Directory Requirements (42 CFR 438.10, 45 CFR 156.230)

attributes.name: directory_entry_id
attributes.description: Primary key for directory_entry

attributes.name: provider_directory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider directory entry record. This is the primary key for the published directory entry, distinct from the internal provider master record.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.provider_contract. Business justification: Directory Publication Report requires contract details for each provider entry to determine network participation terms.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific health plan for which this directory entry is published. A provider may have multiple directory entries across different plans.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal provider master record. Links this published directory entry to the authoritative provider identity in the provider domain.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider network in which this provider participates for this plan. Determines member access and cost-sharing tier.

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is currently accepting new patients for this plan and network. Critical for directory accuracy and member access.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Accuracy Mandate (42 CFR 438.10)

attributes.name: accessibility_features
attributes.description: Description of accessibility features available at the practice location (wheelchair access, hearing loop, accessible parking). Supports ADA compliance and member access.

attributes.name: attestation_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the directory information with the provider. Documents the verification approach for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: attestation_status
attributes.description: Status of the provider attestation or verification process for this directory entry. Tracks compliance with CMS directory accuracy requirements.

attributes.name: board_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of board certifications held by the provider. Demonstrates advanced training and specialty expertise.

attributes.name: directory_display_name
attributes.description: Consumer-facing display name of the provider as it appears in the published directory. May differ from legal name for readability and member experience.

attributes.name: directory_publication_date
attributes.description: Date when this directory entry was published or last updated in the member-facing provider directory. Required for CMS directory accuracy attestation.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Accuracy Standards (42 CFR 438.10)

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender of the provider. Some members have preferences for provider gender, particularly for primary care and OB/GYN services.

attributes.name: graduation_year
attributes.description: Year the provider graduated from medical school or professional training program. Helps members assess provider experience.

attributes.name: hospital_affiliation
attributes.description: Name of hospital(s) where the provider has admitting privileges or primary affiliation. Important for continuity of care and member decision-making.

attributes.name: languages_spoken
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of languages spoken by the provider or available at the practice location. Critical for member access and cultural competency.

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date when the directory information was last verified with the provider or practice. CMS and state DOI mandate regular verification cycles (typically 90 days).

attributes.name: medical_school
attributes.description: Name of the medical school or professional training institution where the provider received their degree. Provides credential transparency for members.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Cost-sharing tier for this provider within the plan network. Determines member copay, coinsurance, and out-of-pocket costs.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Standards

attributes.name: next_verification_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next directory verification must be completed to maintain compliance with CMS and state DOI accuracy mandates.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Verification Cycle Standards

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: Ten-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS. The authoritative unique identifier for healthcare providers in the United States.

attributes.name: office_hours
attributes.description: Text description of office hours for the practice location. Helps members understand availability for appointment scheduling.

attributes.name: participation_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the providers participation in this plan and network became effective. Determines when members can access the provider at in-network rates.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the providers participation in this specific plan and network. Determines whether the directory entry is published to members.

attributes.name: participation_termination_date
attributes.description: Date when the providers participation in this plan and network ended or will end. Critical for member notification and continuity of care transitions.

attributes.name: pcp_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider is eligible to serve as a Primary Care Provider (PCP) for plan members. Relevant for HMO and POS plans requiring PCP selection.

attributes.name: practice_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the practice location street address where the provider sees patients. Published in member-facing directory for appointment scheduling.

attributes.name: practice_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the practice location street address (suite, floor, building). Optional field for additional address detail.

attributes.name: practice_city
attributes.description: City name of the practice location. Used for member search and network adequacy geographic analysis.

attributes.name: practice_county
attributes.description: County name of the practice location. Required for state DOI network adequacy reporting and CMS service area compliance.

attributes.name: practice_email
attributes.description: Email address for the practice location. May be published for member communication or used for administrative coordination.

attributes.name: practice_fax
attributes.description: Fax number for the practice location. Used for prior authorization submissions and medical records exchange.

attributes.name: practice_location_name
attributes.description: Name of the practice location, clinic, or facility where the provider sees patients for this directory entry. A provider may have multiple directory entries for different locations.

attributes.name: practice_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the practice location. Published in directory for member appointment scheduling and inquiries.

attributes.name: practice_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state abbreviation of the practice location. Critical for state-specific network adequacy and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: practice_website_url
attributes.description: Website URL for the practice or provider. Published in directory to enable members to learn more about the provider and services offered.

attributes.name: practice_zip_code
attributes.description: Five-digit or nine-digit ZIP code of the practice location. Used for member proximity search and network adequacy geo-access analysis.

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the provider entity type. Determines directory presentation and search filtering options for members.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this directory entry record was first created in the data warehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this directory entry record was last updated in the data warehouse. Tracks data freshness and change frequency.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this directory entry was derived (e.g., Cactus, ProviderSource). Supports data lineage and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this directory entry in the source system. Enables traceability and reconciliation with upstream provider management systems.

attributes.name: specialty_display
attributes.description: Consumer-friendly specialty name displayed in the directory. Simplified from clinical taxonomy codes for member understanding.

attributes.name: telehealth_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider offers telehealth or virtual visit services for this plan. Increasingly important for member access and convenience.

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: Nine-digit Tax Identification Number (EIN or SSN) associated with the provider or practice for billing and contracting purposes.

products.name: provider_directory_verification
products.description: Tracks the outreach and verification events conducted to confirm provider directory accuracy as required by CMS and state DOI mandates. Records verification method (phone, mail, online portal, attestation), verification date, verified by (staff ID or automated system), verification outcome (confirmed, updated, unable to reach, removed), fields verified (address, phone, accepting patients, specialty), and next scheduled verification date. Supports CMS quarterly directory accuracy reporting and no-surprise billing compliance.
products.reference: CMS Directory Accuracy Requirements, No Surprises Act

attributes.name: provider_directory_verification_id
attributes.description: System‑generated unique identifier for each provider directory verification record.

attributes.name: employee_id

products.name: sanction
products.description: Single source of truth for all sanctions, exclusions, adverse actions, and the periodic screening events that detect them. Captures sanction records: sanction type (OIG exclusion, SAM exclusion, state Medicaid exclusion, DEA revocation, medical board action, licensure disciplinary action), sanction source, sanction date, reinstatement date, sanction reason, severity level, and impact on participation status. Also captures screening events: screening date, screening source (OIG LEIE, SAM.gov, state Medicaid exclusion lists, EPLS), provider NPI screened, screening result (clear, match found, potential match requiring manual review), match details, resolution action, resolution date, and screened-by (staff ID or automated system). Supports mandatory monthly OIG/SAM exclusion screening compliance, NCQA credentialing standards, CMS program integrity requirements, Medicaid/Medicare fraud prevention, and complete audit trail for regulatory examinations. Critical for preventing payment to excluded providers and defending screening compliance during CMS and OIG audits.

products.name: participation_status
products.description: Tracks the participation status history of a provider within a specific health plan, network, and line of business (LOB). Records participation status (active, inactive, terminated, suspended, pending credentialing), effective date, termination date, termination reason code, LOB (commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, CHIP, marketplace/QHP), network ID, and status change trigger (credentialing decision, contract termination, sanction, voluntary withdrawal). This is the authoritative record for claims adjudication in-network/out-of-network determination. Supports member notification requirements for provider terminations, continuity of care provisions, and regulatory reporting of network changes.

domains.name: claim
domains.description: Core transactional domain for all medical, dental, vision, and behavioral health claims — professional (837P), institutional (837I), and dental (837D). Owns claim header and line detail, diagnosis codes (ICD), procedure codes (CPT/HCPCS), DRG assignments, adjudication decisions, EOB generation, COB processing, adjustments, denials, and LAE tracking. Interfaces with EDI clearinghouses (Availity, Change Healthcare) and supports IBNR reserving and MLR reporting.
domains.references: HIPAA 837/835 EDI, CMS Claims Standards, UB-04

products.name: header
products.description: Core master record and lifecycle hub for every submitted health insurance claim — professional (CMS-1500/837P), institutional (UB-04/837I), dental (ADA/837D), and behavioral health. Captures claim-level identifiers (ICN), claim type, bill type, place of service, financial totals (billed/allowed/paid), adjudication status with full status transition history (prior status, new status, timestamp, reason, changed-by), service dates, COB indicator, LOB, plan and member identifiers, provider NPIs (rendering, billing, facility, attending, referring), DRG assignment, admission details, claim source (EDI/paper/portal), adjustment linkage, pend/suspend reason tracking, SLA monitoring dates, and HIPAA compliance flags. Serves as the central hub linking all claim-related detail records.
products.reference: ANSI X12 837 Claim Header / CMS-1500 / UB-04

products.name: adjudication
products.description: Authoritative record of the adjudication decision for each claim and claim line, capturing the full pre-payment processing lifecycle including all clinical and administrative edit results. Includes adjudication status (paid/denied/pended/suspended/voided), auto-adjudication flag, adjudicator ID, benefit plan applied, accumulator impacts (deductible/OOP), COB processing results, allowed amount calculation method (fee schedule/MAC/RBP/capitation), network status, medical necessity determination, and final disposition. Captures granular edit-level results (NCCI/OCE/LCD/NCD/plan-specific/timely filing/duplicate) with edit code, edit description, pass/fail/bypass/override outcomes per line, bypass reason, and override authority. Supports coding compliance, payment accuracy, and CMS edit mandate adherence.

products.name: adjustment
products.description: Single source of truth for all post-adjudication corrections, recoveries, and audit findings — including claim adjustments, voids, reprocessing events, overpayment identification and recovery, and post-payment audit results for payment integrity and FWA detection. domains.name: pharmacy
domains.description: Manages pharmacy benefit administration — formulary design, drug tier assignments, NDC-level drug master, MAC/AWP/WAC pricing, retail and mail-order dispensing, specialty pharmacy, and pharmacy claim adjudication. Owns PBM contract terms, step therapy and quantity limit rules, drug utilization review (DUR) outcomes, and prior authorization for specialty drugs. Interfaces with RxClaim or Argus PBM systems and supports CMS Part D reporting.
domains.references: CMS Part D, NCPDP, FDA NDC, USP Drug Classification

products.name: drug_master
products.description: Authoritative NDC-level drug master record for all covered pharmaceutical products. Captures National Drug Code (NDC), drug name, generic name, brand name, manufacturer, dosage form, strength, route of administration, drug class, controlled substance schedule, FDA approval status, and therapeutic equivalence codes (AB-rated/biosimilar). Includes generic substitution relationships and the full therapeutic classification hierarchy: ATC (Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical) code, GPI (Generic Product Identifier) prefix, pharmacological category, therapeutic class, therapeutic subclass, class name, and subclass name. This is the SSOT for all drug identity, classification, equivalence, and therapeutic hierarchy data used across formulary, claims, DUR, rebate contracting, HEDIS pharmacy measures, and PBM adjudication. Sourced from First Databank/Medi-Span drug database feeds.

attributes.name: drug_master_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each drug master record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Serves as the primary key for all downstream joins across formulary, claims, DUR, rebate contracting, and PBM adjudication.

attributes.name: created_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Data governance requires tracking which employee entered or updated drug master records.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Required for drug rebate and pricing management: linking each drug to its manufacturer/vendor enables accurate rebate calculations, pricing negotiations, and CMS reporting.

attributes.name: atc_code
attributes.description: The WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification code at the 5th level, identifying the drug's anatomical main group, therapeutic subgroup, pharmacological subgroup, chemical subgroup, and chemical substance. Used for therapeutic class reporting, HEDIS pharmacy measures, population health analytics, and international drug classification alignment.
attributes.references: WHO ATC/DDD Index; WHO Collaborating Centre for Drug Statistics Methodology; NCQA HEDIS Pharmacy Measures

attributes.name: awp_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current AWP unit price became effective. Used to apply the correct AWP for historical claims repricing, audit reconciliation, and retroactive rebate calculations.
attributes.references: First Databank AWP Update Schedule; Medi-Span AWP Update Schedule; CMS Part D Pricing

attributes.name: awp_unit_price
attributes.description: The Average Wholesale Price (AWP) per unit of the drug as published by First Databank or Medi-Span. AWP is the benchmark pricing reference used in pharmacy reimbursement calculations, MAC pricing comparisons, and rebate contract negotiations. Expressed in USD per unit (tablet, mL, gram, etc.).
attributes.references: First Databank AWP; Medi-Span AWP; CMS Part D Pricing Benchmarks; NAIC Model Pharmacy Benefit Transparency Act

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The proprietary trade name under which the drug is marketed by the manufacturer (e.g., Lipitor, Humira). Used in formulary tier assignment, rebate contracting, member communications, and brand vs. generic substitution logic in PBM adjudication.
attributes.references: FDA Drug Labeling Requirements; First Databank Drug Database

attributes.name: controlled_substance_schedule
attributes.description: The DEA controlled substance schedule classification (I through V) indicating the drug's potential for abuse and accepted medical use. Schedule II-V drugs require enhanced DUR edits, quantity limits, early refill restrictions, and special handling in PBM adjudication. Not_scheduled indicates no DEA restriction.
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act (21 USC 812); DEA Schedule of Controlled Substances; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this drug master record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for data lineage, audit compliance, and change data capture tracking per HIPAA Security Rule requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR Part 164.312); SOC 2 Audit Trail Requirements; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: dea_number_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid DEA registration number is required on the prescription for this drug due to its controlled substance classification. Drives prescription validation edits in PBM adjudication and pharmacy dispensing workflows.
attributes.references: DEA Controlled Substances Act (21 USC 829); DEA Practitioner Registration Requirements

attributes.name: dosage_form
attributes.description: The physical form in which the drug is dispensed (e.g., tablet, capsule, solution, injection, patch, inhaler). Critical for formulary configuration, quantity limit rules, step therapy protocols, and DUR screening in RxClaim/Argus. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tablet|capsule|solution|injection|patch|inhaler|cream|ointment|suspension|powder — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Dosage Form Terminology; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; First Databank Drug Database

attributes.name: drug_class_code
attributes.description: The classification code for the drug class within the GPI or ETC hierarchy, representing a more granular grouping below therapeutic subclass (e.g., specific statin subtype). Used in formulary step therapy rules, DUR clinical edits, and rebate tier segmentation in PBM systems.
attributes.references: First Databank Enhanced Therapeutic Classification (ETC); Medi-Span GPI Classification

attributes.name: drug_class_name
attributes.description: The human-readable name of the drug class corresponding to the drug_class_code. Provides the most granular named classification level in the therapeutic hierarchy for formulary configuration and clinical reporting.
attributes.references: First Databank Enhanced Therapeutic Classification (ETC); Medi-Span GPI Classification

attributes.name: drug_name
attributes.description: The full proprietary or established name of the drug as it appears on the FDA-approved label and in the First Databank or Medi-Span drug database feed. Used as the primary human-readable identity label across formulary displays, EOB communications, and member-facing materials.
attributes.references: FDA Drug Labeling Requirements; First Databank Drug Database; Medi-Span Drug Database

attributes.name: drug_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the drug record in the master file. Active drugs are eligible for formulary placement and PBM adjudication. Discontinued or recalled drugs trigger claim edits and member/provider notifications. Drives formulary maintenance workflows in RxClaim/Argus.
attributes.references: FDA Drug Approval and Market Status; First Databank Drug Database; CMS Part D Formulary Requirements

attributes.name: drug_type
attributes.description: Classification of the drug as brand-name, generic, biosimilar, over-the-counter (OTC), compounded, or repackaged. Drives formulary tier assignment, cost-sharing rules, generic substitution logic, and rebate eligibility in PBM adjudication and formulary management.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book; FDA Purple Book (Biosimilars); CMS Part D; NCQA HEDIS Pharmacy Measures

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this drug master record became effective and eligible for use in formulary configuration, PBM adjudication, and claims processing. Used for temporal validity enforcement in adjudication date-of-service lookups and formulary effective date management.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; Internal Formulary Management Policy

attributes.name: fda_approval_status
attributes.description: The current FDA regulatory approval status of the drug product. Approved drugs are eligible for formulary coverage. Tentatively approved generics may be covered under specific plan designs. Withdrawn or not-approved drugs are excluded from formulary and trigger claim denials. Required for CMS Part D formulary compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book; FDA Purple Book; CMS Part D Formulary Requirements; 42 CFR Part 423

attributes.name: generic_name
attributes.description: The International Nonproprietary Name (INN) or United States Adopted Name (USAN) for the active ingredient(s) of the drug (e.g., atorvastatin, adalimumab). Used for generic substitution logic, DUR screening, therapeutic equivalence grouping, and HEDIS pharmacy measure reporting.
attributes.references: WHO INN Program; USAN Council; First Databank Drug Database

attributes.name: gpi_code
attributes.description: The 14-digit Medi-Span Generic Product Identifier (GPI) code providing a hierarchical drug classification from drug group (2 digits) through drug class, subclass, name, name extension, dosage form, and strength. Used as the primary therapeutic classification key in RxClaim/Argus PBM systems for formulary management, DUR screening, and rebate contracting.
attributes.references: Medi-Span GPI Classification System; Wolters Kluwer Health Drug Database

attributes.name: hcc_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this drug is clinically associated with one or more CMS Hierarchical Condition Categories (HCCs) for risk adjustment purposes. HCC-relevant drugs are used in RAF score modeling, RAPS/EDPS encounter data submissions, and population health stratification for Medicare Advantage plans.
attributes.references: CMS HCC Risk Adjustment Model; CMS RAPS/EDPS Submission Requirements; 42 CFR Part 422

attributes.name: is_biosimilar
attributes.description: Indicates whether this drug is an FDA-approved biosimilar to a reference biological product. Biosimilars have distinct formulary placement rules, interchangeability designations, and rebate contracting considerations under CMS Part D and commercial plan designs.
attributes.references: FDA Purple Book; Biologics Price Competition and Innovation Act (BPCIA); CMS Part D Biosimilar Policy

attributes.name: is_generic_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether an FDA-approved generic equivalent is available in the market for this brand-name drug. Used in formulary tier assignment, member cost-sharing communications, and generic substitution prompts during PBM adjudication and pharmacy dispensing.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book; CMS Part D Generic Substitution Policy; NCQA HEDIS PDC Measures

attributes.name: is_maintenance_drug
attributes.description: Indicates whether this drug is classified as a maintenance medication intended for long-term chronic condition management (e.g., antihypertensives, statins, diabetes medications). Maintenance drugs are eligible for 90-day supply dispensing at mail-order pharmacies and are used in HEDIS medication adherence measures (PDC).
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Medication Adherence Measures; CMS Part D Medication Therapy Management (MTM) Criteria

attributes.name: is_preventive_drug
attributes.description: Indicates whether this drug qualifies as a preventive medication under ACA Section 2713 or HDHP/HSA preventive care rules, making it eligible for $0 cost-sharing before the deductible is met. Used in benefit configuration and claims adjudication cost-sharing logic.
attributes.references: ACA Section 2713; IRS Notice 2004-23 (HSA Preventive Care); USPSTF Preventive Drug List

attributes.name: is_specialty_drug
attributes.description: Indicates whether this drug is classified as a specialty pharmaceutical requiring special handling, storage, administration, or monitoring (e.g., biologics, oncology agents, hepatitis C treatments). Specialty drugs are subject to mandatory specialty pharmacy channel requirements, prior authorization, and enhanced DUR in PBM adjudication. Critical for CMS Part D specialty tier placement.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Specialty Tier Definition; NCPDP Specialty Drug Classification; PBM Specialty Drug List

attributes.name: labeler_code
attributes.description: The 5-digit FDA-assigned labeler code (first segment of the NDC) identifying the firm that manufactures, repackages, relabels, or distributes the drug. Used for manufacturer-level rebate aggregation and PBM contract management.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Labeler Code Registry; CMS Part D

attributes.name: multi_source_code
attributes.description: The FDA Orange Book multi-source code indicating the competitive market status of the drug: O=originator brand with no generic, M=multi-source (generic available), N=no current market (discontinued), Y=single-source generic. Used in generic substitution logic, formulary tier assignment, and MAC pricing eligibility determination.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book Multi-Source Code Definitions; CMS Part D Generic Substitution

attributes.name: ndc
attributes.description: The 11-digit National Drug Code assigned by the FDA uniquely identifying the labeler, product, and package size of a drug. This is the primary external business identifier for the drug and is used in pharmacy claims (NCPDP/837P), formulary management, PBM adjudication (RxClaim/Argus), and CMS Part D reporting. Stored in 5-4-2 format without hyphens.
attributes.references: FDA National Drug Code Directory; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; CMS Part D Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: ndc_11
attributes.description: The NDC formatted in the standard 5-4-2 hyphenated display format (e.g., 12345-6789-01) as required for human-readable labeling, SBC documentation, and regulatory submissions to CMS and state DOIs.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Labeling Requirements; CMS Part D Reporting

attributes.name: package_size
attributes.description: The quantity of drug units contained in the dispensed package as defined by the NDC (e.g., 30 tablets, 100 mL, 1 vial). Used in unit-of-use pricing calculations, days supply verification, quantity limit enforcement, and MAC pricing per-unit derivation.
attributes.references: FDA NDC Package Size Definition; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; First Databank Drug Database

attributes.name: package_size_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the package size quantity (e.g., EA for each/tablet/capsule, ML for milliliter, GM for gram). Used in conjunction with package_size for accurate dispensing quantity calculations, days supply verification, and unit-cost pricing in PBM adjudication. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|ML|GM|MG|TAB|CAP|VIAL|PATCH|KIT — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; FDA NDC Package Size Terminology; First Databank Drug Database

attributes.name: pharmacological_category
attributes.description: The pharmacological mechanism-of-action category of the drug (e.g., ACE Inhibitor, Beta Blocker, SSRI, Statin, Monoclonal Antibody). Used for DUR drug-drug interaction screening, therapeutic duplication edits, clinical program targeting in care management, and HEDIS measure attribution.
attributes.references: First Databank Drug Database; Medi-Span Drug Database; NCQA HEDIS Pharmacy Measures

attributes.name: reference_drug_ndc
attributes.description: The NDC of the FDA Reference Listed Drug (RLD) or reference biological product to which this generic or biosimilar is therapeutically equivalent. Enables generic substitution relationship mapping, step therapy configuration, and biosimilar interchangeability tracking in the PBM system.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book; FDA Purple Book; 21 CFR Part 314.3

attributes.name: rems_program
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) Program
attributes.description: The name of the FDA-mandated Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) program associated with this drug, if applicable (e.g., iPLEDGE for isotretinoin, TIRF REMS for fentanyl products). REMS drugs require special dispensing controls, patient enrollment, and prescriber certification that must be validated during PBM adjudication and prior authorization.
attributes.references: FDA REMS Program Requirements (21 USC 355-1); FDA REMS Database

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The path by which the drug is administered to the patient (e.g., oral, intravenous, subcutaneous, topical, inhalation). Drives formulary benefit category assignment (medical vs. pharmacy benefit), prior authorization requirements, and specialty pharmacy routing in PBM adjudication. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oral|intravenous|subcutaneous|intramuscular|topical|inhalation|transdermal|ophthalmic|otic|rectal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Route of Administration Terminology; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard; First Databank Drug Database

attributes.name: source_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (First Databank, Medi-Span, RxClaim, or Argus) for this drug master record. Used for data lineage, cross-system reconciliation, and upstream change tracking in the lakehouse ingestion pipeline.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR Part 164)

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system from which this drug master record was ingested (e.g., FDB=First Databank, MEDISPAN=Medi-Span, RXCLAIM=RxClaim PBM, ARGUS=Argus PBM, INTERNAL=internally maintained). Used for data lineage tracking, conflict resolution during ETL, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR Part 164); SOC 2 Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: strength
attributes.description: The concentration or potency of the active ingredient(s) expressed as a numeric value with unit of measure (e.g., 10 mg, 500 mg/5 mL, 0.25%). Used in DUR duplicate therapy screening, quantity limit enforcement, and clinical appropriateness review in UM/PA workflows.
attributes.references: FDA Drug Labeling Requirements; First Databank Drug Database; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which this drug master record was terminated or superseded, indicating the drug is no longer active for formulary placement or new claim adjudication. Null indicates the record is currently active. Used for historical claims repricing and formulary audit trails.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements; Internal Formulary Management Policy

attributes.name: therapeutic_class_code
attributes.description: The standardized code identifying the broad therapeutic class of the drug (e.g., cardiovascular agents, anti-infectives, antineoplastics). Used for formulary tier grouping, rebate contract aggregation, utilization reporting, and disease management program enrollment triggers.
attributes.references: First Databank Enhanced Therapeutic Classification (ETC); Medi-Span GPI Therapeutic Classification

attributes.name: therapeutic_class_name
attributes.description: The human-readable name of the therapeutic class corresponding to the therapeutic_class_code. Used in formulary displays, member-facing SBC documents, provider communications, and regulatory reporting to CMS and state DOIs.
attributes.references: First Databank Enhanced Therapeutic Classification (ETC); Medi-Span GPI Therapeutic Classification

attributes.name: therapeutic_equivalence_code
attributes.description: The FDA Orange Book therapeutic equivalence evaluation code (e.g., AB, AA, BC) indicating whether a generic drug is therapeutically equivalent to the reference listed drug. AB-rated generics are substitutable at the pharmacy. Used in generic substitution logic, formulary step therapy, and DAW (Dispense As Written) override processing in PBM adjudication.
attributes.references: FDA Orange Book (Approved Drug Products with Therapeutic Equivalence Evaluations); 21 CFR Part 314

attributes.name: therapeutic_subclass_code
attributes.description: The standardized code identifying the therapeutic subclass within the broader therapeutic class (e.g., HMG-CoA Reductase Inhibitors within cardiovascular agents). Enables granular formulary tier differentiation, step therapy protocol design, and rebate contract segmentation.
attributes.references: First Databank Enhanced Therapeutic Classification (ETC); Medi-Span GPI Therapeutic Classification

attributes.name: therapeutic_subclass_name
attributes.description: The human-readable name of the therapeutic subclass corresponding to the therapeutic_subclass_code. Used in formulary management workflows, clinical program configuration, and detailed utilization analytics.
attributes.references: First Databank Enhanced Therapeutic Classification (ETC); Medi-Span GPI Therapeutic Classification

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this drug master record was last modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for incremental data refresh, change detection, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks lakehouse pipeline.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR Part 164.312); SOC 2 Audit Trail Requirements; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: wac_unit_price
attributes.description: The Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) per unit as reported by the manufacturer, representing the list price to wholesalers before discounts and rebates. Used as a pricing benchmark for specialty drug reimbursement, rebate baseline calculations, and CMS Part D coverage gap discount program calculations.
attributes.references: 42 USC 1395w-3a (WAC Definition); CMS Part D Coverage Gap Discount Program; Medi-Span WAC

products.name: formulary
products.description: Master record for each formulary (drug benefit list) offered by the health plan. Defines the formulary name, effective date range, line of business (LOB), plan year, formulary type (open/closed/tiered), PBM contract reference, and regulatory filing status. A formulary is the SSOT for which drugs are covered under a given benefit design and is required for CMS Part D compliance.

attributes.name: formulary_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the formulary record. Primary key for the formulary data product in the pharmacy domain.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Formulary Requirements; HIPAA Administrative Simplification

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Formulary design must adhere to specific regulatory obligations (ACA, CMS); linking enables reporting of compliance status per formulary.

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
