attributes.description: The Medicare Part D Initial Coverage Limit (ICL) threshold amount for the current benefit year, as published annually by CMS. Defines the boundary between the initial coverage phase and the coverage gap (donut hole).
attributes.references: CMS Part D Benefit Parameters Annual Update; 42 CFR §423.104

attributes.name: is_deductible_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has fully satisfied their pharmacy deductible for the current benefit period. When true, plan cost-sharing (copay/coinsurance) applies rather than full deductible responsibility.
attributes.references: ACA 45 CFR §156.130; CMS Part D Benefit Parameters

attributes.name: is_moop_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the member has reached their maximum out-of-pocket (MOOP) limit for the current benefit period. When true, the plan covers 100% of covered pharmacy costs for the remainder of the benefit period.
attributes.references: ACA 45 CFR §156.130; CMS Part D Benefit Parameters

attributes.name: last_adjudication_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of the most recent pharmacy claim adjudication event that updated this accumulator record. Critical for real-time point-of-sale cost-sharing calculation and concurrency control.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard D.0; CMS Part D Real-Time Adjudication Requirements

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The line of business (LOB) under which the member's pharmacy benefit is administered. Determines applicable regulatory framework, benefit phase rules, and accumulator logic (e.g., Part D coverage gap applies only to Medicare Part D).
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D; ACA Exchange Rules; FEHB Program Handbook

attributes.name: lis_copay_tier
attributes.description: The applicable LIS copay tier for the member, determining the fixed copay amounts for generic, preferred brand, non-preferred, and specialty drugs under the Low-Income Subsidy (LIS) program.
attributes.references: CMS Part D LIS Copay Schedule; 42 CFR §423.782

attributes.name: lis_level
attributes.description: Low-Income Subsidy (LIS) eligibility level for Medicare Part D members, determining reduced cost-sharing amounts. 'full' indicates 100% subsidy; 'partial_1/2/3' indicate graduated subsidy tiers; 'none' indicates no LIS. Affects TrOOP accumulation rules.
attributes.references: CMS Part D LIS Program; 42 CFR §423.780; SSA §1860D-14

attributes.name: mail_order_applied_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative cost-sharing amount applied for drugs dispensed through mail-order pharmacy channels in the current benefit period. Supports mail-order utilization reporting and member EOB generation.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Mail Order Requirements; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard

attributes.name: moop_limit_amt
attributes.description: The maximum out-of-pocket (MOOP) dollar threshold the member must reach before the plan covers 100% of covered pharmacy costs for the remainder of the benefit period. Set per plan design and ACA/CMS requirements.
attributes.references: ACA 45 CFR §156.130; CMS Part D Benefit Parameters Annual Update

attributes.name: oop_applied_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative out-of-pocket (OOP) spend by the member for pharmacy benefits in the current benefit period, including deductible, copays, and coinsurance. Used to track progress toward the maximum out-of-pocket (MOOP) limit.
attributes.references: ACA 45 CFR §156.130; CMS Part D Benefit Parameters

attributes.name: part_d_benefit_phase
attributes.description: Current Medicare Part D benefit phase for the member based on accumulated TrOOP and ICL amounts. Drives cost-sharing calculation at point of sale. 'not_applicable' for non-Part D lines of business.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 5; 42 CFR §423.100

attributes.name: pbm_member_code
attributes.description: Member identifier assigned by the Pharmacy Benefit Manager (PBM) system (RxClaim or Argus). Used to cross-reference accumulator balances between the health plan and PBM for reconciliation.
attributes.references: PBM Contract Terms; NCPDP SCRIPT Standard

attributes.name: rx_claim_count
attributes.description: Total number of pharmacy claims adjudicated and applied to this accumulator record in the current benefit period. Used for utilization reporting and EOB generation.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard; CMS Part D Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: specialty_drug_applied_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative cost-sharing amount applied specifically for specialty tier drugs in the current benefit period. Tracked separately to support specialty pharmacy reporting, prior authorization analytics, and plan design evaluation.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Specialty Tier Rules; NCPDP Telecommunication Standard

attributes.name: third_party_applied_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative dollar amount paid by third parties (e.g., manufacturer copay assistance programs, other insurance) toward the member's pharmacy cost-sharing. Tracked separately as these amounts may not count toward TrOOP under CMS rules.
attributes.references: CMS Part D TrOOP Rules; 42 CFR §423.100; CMS Manufacturer Coupon Policy

attributes.name: troop_applied_amt
attributes.description: Cumulative true out-of-pocket (TrOOP) expenditure for Medicare Part D members, counting only qualifying cost-sharing amounts toward the catastrophic coverage threshold. Excludes amounts paid by third parties not qualifying under CMS TrOOP rules. Required for CMS Part D benefit phase determination.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 5; 42 CFR §423.100

attributes.name: troop_limit_amt
attributes.description: The annual TrOOP threshold amount that, when reached, transitions a Medicare Part D member into catastrophic coverage. Published annually by CMS as part of the Part D benefit parameters.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Benefit Manual Chapter 5; 42 CFR §423.104

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this accumulator record was most recently modified, reflecting the latest claim adjudication event or manual adjustment. Supports concurrency control and audit trail.
attributes.references: HIPAA Audit Controls 45 CFR §164.312; Internal Data Governance Standard

products.name: pharmacy_contract
products.description: Contractual record governing the reimbursement terms between the health plan (or PBM on its behalf) and individual dispensing pharmacies or pharmacy chains. Captures pharmacy NPI, network tier (preferred/standard/specialty), dispensing fee schedule, ingredient cost basis (AWP discount/MAC/WAC), effective date range, contract type (direct/PBM-administered), performance requirements, and audit provisions. Distinct from pbm_contract which governs the PBM relationship.

attributes.name: pharmacy_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the pharmacy contract record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: dispensing_pharmacy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dispensing pharmacy or pharmacy chain entity in the pharmacy master. Links this contract to the specific pharmacy party.
attributes.references: NCPDP Provider Identification Standard; CMS NPI Registry

attributes.name: mac_list_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the MAC pricing list applied under this contract for generic and multi-source drug reimbursement. References the specific MAC schedule version used by the PBM or health plan. Applicable when ingredient_cost_basis is mac.
attributes.references: CMS Part D MAC Pricing; NAIC Model MAC Transparency Act; State DOI MAC Regulations

attributes.name: ncpdp_provider_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Council for Prescription Drug Programs (NCPDP) Provider ID
attributes.description: 7-digit NCPDP pharmacy identifier used in pharmacy claim transactions (NCPDP Telecom D.0) and PBM adjudication. Complements the NPI for pharmacy-specific identification.
attributes.references: NCPDP Telecom Standard Version D.0; CMS Part D Prescription Drug Event (PDE) Reporting

attributes.name: pbm_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PBM contract under which this pharmacy dispensing agreement is administered, when the contract is PBM-administered rather than direct. Null for direct health-plan contracts.
attributes.references: RxClaim / Argus PBM System — Contract Administration Module

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.provider_network. Business justification: Contracts are negotiated per network; linking contracts to provider_network enables contract‑level reporting, tiering, and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: accreditation_type
attributes.description: Type of accreditation required or held by the pharmacy under this contract. URAC and ACHC are common for specialty pharmacies. PCAB (Pharmacy Compounding Accreditation Board) for compounding pharmacies. Relevant for specialty and mail-order contracts.
attributes.references: URAC Specialty Pharmacy Accreditation; ACHC Pharmacy Accreditation; CMS Part D Specialty Drug Requirements

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: Contractually stipulated frequency at which the health plan or PBM may conduct pharmacy audits. Applicable when audit_rights_indicator is true.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Audit Requirements 42 CFR 423.505; NAIC Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: audit_rights_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the health plan or PBM retains the right to conduct on-site or desk audits of the pharmacy's dispensing records under this contract. Required for CMS Part D compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Audit Requirements 42 CFR 423.505; HIPAA Audit Provisions

attributes.name: auto_renewal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract automatically renews at the end of the contract term unless either party provides notice of termination within the required notice period.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Pharmacy Contracting Act; State DOI Contract Renewal Requirements

attributes.name: awp_discount_pct
attributes.description: Contracted discount percentage applied to the drug's Average Wholesale Price (AWP) to determine ingredient cost reimbursement for brand and generic drugs. Expressed as a positive percentage (e.g., 16.50 = AWP minus 16.50%). Applicable when ingredient_cost_basis is awp_discount.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Reimbursement Standards; First DataBank / Medi-Span AWP Reference

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable contract reference number assigned by the health plan or PBM. Used in correspondence, audits, and regulatory filings. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this agreement.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; CMS Part D Contract Requirements

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pharmacy contract. Active contracts are eligible for claim adjudication. Suspended contracts are temporarily ineligible. Terminated/expired contracts are closed. Drives network eligibility checks in RxClaim/Argus.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Network Adequacy; NCQA Pharmacy Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contractual relationship: direct (health plan contracts directly with pharmacy), pbm_administered (PBM manages on plan's behalf), chain (multi-location chain agreement), independent (single-location independent pharmacy), mail_order, or specialty. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct|pbm_administered|chain|independent|mail_order|specialty — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Part D Network Adequacy; NAIC Model Pharmacy Benefit Management Transparency Act

attributes.name: credentialing_required_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pharmacy must complete and maintain credentialing requirements (state licensure, DEA registration, accreditation) as a condition of this contract.
attributes.references: NCQA Pharmacy Credentialing Standards; CMS Part D Network Adequacy; State Board of Pharmacy Licensure

attributes.name: days_supply_mail_max
attributes.description: Maximum days supply per mail-order prescription fill authorized under this contract (typically 90 days). Drives adjudication edits in RxClaim/Argus.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Days Supply Rules; NCPDP Telecom Standard

attributes.name: days_supply_retail_max
attributes.description: Maximum days supply per retail prescription fill authorized under this contract (typically 30 or 34 days). Claims exceeding this limit may be rejected during adjudication.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Days Supply Rules; NCPDP Telecom Standard

attributes.name: dispensing_channel
attributes.description: The dispensing channel(s) authorized under this contract. Retail covers walk-in pharmacies; mail_order covers 90-day supply dispensing; specialty covers high-cost/complex drugs; long_term_care covers SNF/LTC facilities; home_infusion covers IV therapy.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Dispensing Channel Definitions; URAC Specialty Pharmacy Standards

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_mail_order
attributes.description: Contracted flat dispensing fee (in USD) paid per mail-order prescription dispensed. Typically lower than retail due to higher volume and automation. Applicable for mail-order and specialty pharmacy contracts.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Dispensing Fee Standards; NAIC Model Pharmacy Contracting Act

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_retail
attributes.description: Contracted flat dispensing fee (in USD) paid to the pharmacy per retail prescription dispensed, in addition to ingredient cost reimbursement. A core financial term of the pharmacy contract.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Dispensing Fee Standards; NAIC Model Pharmacy Contracting Act

attributes.name: dispensing_fee_specialty
attributes.description: Contracted flat dispensing fee (in USD) paid per specialty drug prescription dispensed. Specialty drugs require enhanced clinical services, justifying a separate fee schedule.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Specialty Drug Dispensing; URAC Specialty Pharmacy Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy contract becomes binding and the pharmacy is eligible to dispense claims under this agreement. Used for network eligibility validation during adjudication.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Contract Requirements; NAIC Model Law on Pharmacy Contracting

attributes.name: executed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy contract was fully executed (signed by all parties). May precede the effective_date if there is a future start date.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; CMS Part D Contract Execution Requirements

attributes.name: generic_awp_discount_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Generic Average Wholesale Price (AWP) Discount Percentage
attributes.description: Contracted AWP discount percentage specifically for generic drugs, which typically carries a deeper discount than brand drugs. Expressed as a positive percentage. Applicable when ingredient_cost_basis is awp_discount and a separate generic rate is negotiated.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Reimbursement Standards; First DataBank / Medi-Span AWP Reference

attributes.name: generic_dispensing_rate_target
attributes.description: Contracted minimum generic dispensing rate (GDR) the pharmacy must achieve as a performance requirement. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 85.00 = 85%). Supports CMS Part D Star Ratings and cost management objectives.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Star Ratings — Generic Dispensing Rate Measure; NCQA HEDIS Pharmacy Measures

attributes.name: ingredient_cost_basis
attributes.description: The pricing methodology used to calculate ingredient cost reimbursement to the pharmacy. AWP (Average Wholesale Price) discount, MAC (Maximum Allowable Cost), WAC (Wholesale Acquisition Cost) discount, NADAC (National Average Drug Acquisition Cost), or Usual and Customary (U&C). Core reimbursement term in the contract.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Prescription Drug Pricing; NAIC Model Pharmacy Benefit Management Transparency Act; AWP/WAC/MAC industry standards

attributes.name: last_amended_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent amendment or addendum to this pharmacy contract. Used to track contract evolution and ensure the current fee schedule and terms are applied during adjudication.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Contract Amendment Requirements; NAIC Model Pharmacy Contracting Act

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The line of business to which this pharmacy contract applies. Determines applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., CMS Part D rules for Medicare, state Medicaid rules). A contract may be scoped to one or multiple LOBs.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Contract Requirements; CMS Medicaid Managed Care Rules; ACA Exchange Requirements

attributes.name: mail_order_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmacy is authorized to dispense mail-order (90-day supply) prescriptions under this contract.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Mail Order Pharmacy Requirements; NCPDP Mail Service Pharmacy Standards

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Network participation tier assigned to the pharmacy under this contract. Preferred pharmacies typically offer lower member cost-sharing. Drives member cost-sharing calculations and formulary benefit design.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Preferred Pharmacy Network Rules; ACA Section 2707 Network Adequacy

attributes.name: part_d_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmacy contract is applicable to Medicare Part D prescription drug benefit administration. When true, CMS Part D network adequacy, pricing, and reporting requirements apply.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Part D 42 CFR Part 423; CMS Part D Network Adequacy Final Rule

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract includes performance guarantees (e.g., generic dispensing rate, medication adherence, fill accuracy). When true, performance_guarantee_details apply.
attributes.references: NCQA Pharmacy Quality Standards; CMS Part D Star Ratings Pharmacy Measures

attributes.name: pharmacy_npi
attributes.description: 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned to the dispensing pharmacy by CMS. Used for claims adjudication, EDI transactions (NCPDP 5.1/D.0), and network directory publication.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162; HIPAA Administrative Simplification

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pharmacy contract record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports data lineage, audit trails, and SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.312; Internal Data Governance Audit Trail Standard

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pharmacy contract record was most recently updated in the lakehouse silver layer. Used for change detection, incremental processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR 164.312; Internal Data Governance Audit Trail Standard

attributes.name: recoupment_provision_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes provisions allowing the health plan or PBM to recoup overpayments identified through audits or claims reviews.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Overpayment Recovery Rules 42 CFR 423.505(b)(20); NAIC Model Pharmacy Contracting Act

attributes.name: source_system_contract_code
attributes.description: Native contract identifier from the originating PBM system (RxClaim or Argus) or provider management system (Cactus/ProviderSource). Used for lineage tracing and reconciliation between the lakehouse and operational systems.
attributes.references: RxClaim / Argus PBM System; Cactus / ProviderSource Provider Management System

attributes.name: specialty_drug_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pharmacy is contracted and credentialed to dispense specialty drugs under this agreement. Specialty pharmacies must meet enhanced accreditation requirements (URAC, ACHC).
attributes.references: URAC Specialty Pharmacy Accreditation; CMS Part D Specialty Drug Requirements

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code identifying the primary state jurisdiction governing this pharmacy contract. Determines applicable state DOI regulations, MAC transparency laws, and pharmacy contracting statutes.
attributes.references: NAIC State Insurance Regulation; State DOI Pharmacy Contracting Laws; USPS State Abbreviation Standard

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the pharmacy contract ends or was terminated. Null for open-ended contracts. Claims with service dates after this date are not eligible for reimbursement under this contract.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Contract Requirements; NAIC Model Law on Pharmacy Contracting

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days advance written notice required by either party to terminate the contract without cause. Regulatory minimums vary by state DOI requirements.
attributes.references: State DOI Pharmacy Contracting Regulations; NAIC Model Pharmacy Contracting Act

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the pharmacy contract document (e.g., v1.0, v2.1, Amendment 3). Tracks contract amendments and renegotiations over time for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Internal Contract Management Standards; CMS Part D Contract Amendment Requirements

attributes.name: wac_discount_pct
attributes.description: Contracted discount percentage applied to the drug's Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC) for ingredient cost reimbursement. Applicable when ingredient_cost_basis is wac_discount.
attributes.references: CMS Part D Reimbursement Standards; WAC as defined under 42 USC 1395w-3a

domains.name: billing
domains.description: Single source of truth for premium billing and revenue collection — group invoicing, individual premium statements, payment processing, grace periods, retroactive adjustments, premium reconciliation, refunds, and collections. Owns APR rate structures, PMPM calculations, subsidy and APTC tracking for ACA members, and accounts receivable. Supports CMS premium remittance and state DOI financial reporting. Source system: HealthEdge or custom billing platform.
domains.references: ACA Premium Stabilization, GAAP, SAP, NAIC

products.name: premium_invoice
products.description: Core billing document representing a premium invoice or statement issued to an employer group, individual member (IFP/ACA marketplace direct-pay), COBRA qualified beneficiary, or government sponsor for a specific billing period. Captures invoice number, billing period start/end, total premium due, subsidy/APTC amounts applied, net amount due, invoice status (draft, issued, paid, partially paid, void, delinquent), due date, document type (group list-bill invoice, group self-bill invoice, individual member statement, COBRA invoice, government remittance request), delivery method (mail, email, member portal), line-of-business (LOB), statement-specific fields for IFP direct-pay members (statement number, member reference, plan name, statement delivery preference), and source system reference from HealthEdge or custom billing platform. SSOT for ALL premium billing documents — both group invoices and individual member statements — in the billing domain.

attributes.name: premium_invoice_id
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier for the premium invoice record.

attributes.name: billing_clerk_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Invoice creation is performed by a billing clerk; required for internal audit and workload tracking.

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Regulatory filing of premium invoices required by state insurance premium reporting obligations.

attributes.name: credentialing_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credential.application. Business justification: Required for the Credentialing Application Fee Invoicing process, linking each premium invoice to the specific credentialing application it charges, enabling audit and regulatory reconciliation.

attributes.name: group_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employer group billed for group coverage.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the health plan or benefit design underlying the premium.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: General Ledger posting of premium invoices for revenue recognition required for financial statements.

attributes.name: member_identity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the individual member associated with the invoice, if applicable.

attributes.name: member_risk_score_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.member_risk_score. Business justification: Required for CMS risk‑adjusted premium reporting linking each invoice to the member's risk score at billing time.

attributes.name: network_service_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.service_area. Business justification: Invoices are generated per service area to satisfy network adequacy reporting and state filing requirements.

attributes.name: transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to enrollment.enrollment_transaction. Business justification: Required for premium invoicing: each invoice must reference the enrollment transaction that generated the premium, enabling audit, reporting, and reconciliation.

attributes.name: billing_period_end
attributes.description: Last day of the coverage period for which the premium is billed.

attributes.name: billing_period_start
attributes.description: First day of the coverage period for which the premium is billed.

attributes.name: collection_status
attributes.description: Current state of the collection effort for the invoice.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the invoice record was first created in the data lake.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO currency code for monetary amounts.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Channel used to deliver the invoice to the recipient.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Any discount (e.g., early‑pay, promotional) applied to the invoice.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment must be received to avoid delinquency.

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after due date before the invoice is considered delinquent.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: External invoice number assigned by the billing system, used for member and regulator reference.

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current processing state of the invoice.

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice based on the recipient and billing arrangement.

attributes.name: is_eligible_for_subsidy
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the member/group qualifies for a premium subsidy.

attributes.name: issue_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact time the invoice was generated and issued to the recipient.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Business segment to which the invoice belongs.

attributes.name: net_amount_due
attributes.description: Final amount the recipient must pay after adjustments.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Optional comments or remarks added by billing staff.

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: Interface through which the payment was made.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Primary instrument used to settle the invoice.

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human‑readable name of the health plan.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Amount returned to the payer for over‑payment or claim reversal.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates if the invoice must be reported to CMS or state DOI for compliance.

attributes.name: retroactive_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Adjustment for prior‑period premium changes applied to the current invoice.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating billing system that generated the invoice.

attributes.name: source_system_invoice_reference
attributes.description: Original invoice identifier from the source billing system.

attributes.name: statement_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for an individual member statement when invoice_type is individual_statement.

attributes.name: subsidy_amount
attributes.description: Amount of premium assistance applied (e.g., APTC, state subsidy).

attributes.name: subsidy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subsidy applied to the premium.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax applied to the premium, if applicable.

attributes.name: total_premium_amount

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

Captures member/subscriber reference, plan code, coverage tier (EE, EE+SP, EE+CH, FAM), rate type, gross premium, employer contribution, employee contribution, APTC subsidy amount, CSR adjustment, retroactive adjustment indicator, and effective coverage dates. Supports PMPM-level billing reconciliation.

attributes.name: invoice_line_id

attributes.name: health_plan_id

attributes.name: ledger_id

attributes.name: pa_request_id

attributes.name: premium_invoice_id

attributes.name: transaction_id

attributes.name: billing_period_start

attributes.name: coverage_end_date

products.name: pa_decision
products.description: Transactional record capturing the authorization decision and underlying medical necessity determination rendered on a PA request. Stores decision date, decision type (approved, denied, partially approved, pended, withdrawn), clinical criteria applied (InterQual/MCG criteria set, version, effective date), criteria met/not met flag, clinical rationale narrative, ICD diagnosis codes supporting the determination, deciding reviewer NPI and credentials (MD, RN, PharmD), denial reason code and category (medical necessity, administrative, benefit exclusion, out-of-network, experimental/investigational), denial regulatory citation, appeal eligibility flag, and effective authorization period (start/end dates). Each PA request may have one or more decision records reflecting amendments, P2P reversals, or appeal overrides. Serves as the single evidentiary record for NCQA audits, state DOI market conduct exams, and denial defense.

products.name: concurrent_review
products.description: Manages inpatient concurrent review records for admitted members — the ongoing UM review process evaluating continued medical necessity during a hospital stay. Captures admission date, current and approved length of stay (LOS), LOS benchmarks by DRG (geometric/arithmetic mean LOS, plan-specific target, outlier threshold, benchmark source — CMS, Milliman, plan actuarial), next review date, clinical reviewer NPI, InterQual/MCG criteria version applied, continued stay justification. Includes integrated discharge planning: planned discharge date, discharge destination (home, SNF, LTAC, home health, hospice), post-acute services authorized, barriers to discharge, social work involvement, care coordinator assigned, actual discharge date, and readmission risk score. Links to the originating PA request, UM case, and inpatient admission.

products.name: transition

domains.name: credential
domains.description: Manages the provider credentialing and re-credentialing lifecycle — primary source verification (PSV), NCQA credentialing standards, committee decisions, sanctions screening (OIG/SAM), DEA and state license validation, malpractice history, hospital privileges verification, and credentialing event history. Distinct from provider identity (owned by provider domain); credential owns the qualification and approval workflow that gates network participation.

products.name: application
products.description: Core master record for a provider credentialing or re-credentialing application submitted to the health plan. Captures the full lifecycle of the credentialing request — application date, application type (initial, re-credential, reinstatement), submission channel (paper, portal, CVO, delegated entity), current workflow status (received, in-review, PSV-in-progress, committee-ready, decided, closed), assigned credentialing specialist, NCQA credentialing cycle, target completion date, expiration date, and overall disposition. This is the central orchestrating entity — all downstream verification activities (PSV), sanctions screenings, NPDB queries, committee reviews, attestations, and outreach communications link back to this application. Sourced from CAQH ProView, Cactus, ProviderSource, or direct submission.

products.name: psv_verification
products.description: Unified master record for each credential element held by a provider and its primary source verification (PSV). This is the SOLE authoritative product (SSOT) for ALL verifiable credential element types — no other product in this domain stores credential element data. Supported element types include: state professional licenses (MD, DO, NP, PA, RN, LCSW), DEA controlled substance registrations (with schedules II-V), specialty board certifications (ABMS, AOA, ABPS with MOC status), professional liability (malpractice) insurance (occurrence/claims-made, per-occurrence and aggregate limits, tail coverage), hospital clinical privileges (admitting, surgical, procedural, courtesy), graduate medical education and training (medical school, residency, fellowship, ECFMG for IMGs), and professional work history (5-year history with gap explanations per NCQA). Each record stores: element type discriminator, issuing/granting authority, element-specific attributes (number, schedules, limits, scope, restrictions), effective and expiration dates, current status, PSV source contacted (FSMB, AMA, ABMS, NPDB, OIG, DEA Diversion Control, state boards, facilities, carriers, ECFMG), verification method, verification date, verification result (verified, unable to verify, discrepancy), and verifier identity. One record per credential element per provider per application cycle. Core to NCQA CR 1-4 compliance.
products.reference: NCQA PSV Standards; URAC Credentialing Standards

products.name: sanction_screening
products.description: Consolidated record for the full sanctions and exclusions lifecycle — both screening events and confirmed adverse findings. Captures each screening event (date, type — initial/monthly routine/triggered, databases queried including OIG LEIE, SAM.gov, state Medicaid exclusion lists, NPDB, screening result — clear/match found/pending review, resolution status) and each confirmed sanction, exclusion, or disciplinary action (sanction type, sanctioning authority, effective/end dates, severity, impact on credentialing status). Record type discriminator distinguishes screening events from confirmed sanctions. Monthly OIG/SAM screening is a CMS Conditions of Participation requirement. Confirmed sanctions drive automatic credentialing holds and committee escalation. Links to application for initial/re-credentialing screenings; routine monthly screenings may exist independently.

products.name: npdb_query
products.description: Transactional record of each National Practitioner Data Bank (NPDB) query and the individual adverse action or malpractice payment reports returned. Header-detail structure: header captures query submission (query type — initial/re-credentialing/continuous, submission date, NPDB-assigned query ID, queried provider, response date, number of reports returned); detail captures each report returned (NPDB report ID, report type — malpractice payment/clinical privileges action/DEA action/exclusion-debarment/judgment-conviction, reporting entity, subject of report, incident date, payment amount for malpractice, action taken, action date, and the health plan's internal review disposition — reviewed/flagged for committee/no action required). NPDB querying is mandatory under HCQIA for initial credentialing and re-credentialing. Continuous Query enrollment status tracked here. Each query with its nested reports is a complete transactional record.

products.name: committee_review
products.description: Master record of a credentialing committee or peer review committee session and the formal credentialing decisions rendered. Captures committee meeting details (date, committee type — credentialing/quality/peer review, quorum indicator, agenda items, committee chair attestation) and the per-provider decisions produced (decision type — approved/approved with conditions/deferred/denied/revoked/suspended, decision effective date, decision expiration date, conditions or restrictions imposed, denial reason codes, appeal rights notification date, voting record, decision rationale). products.name: credential_appeal
products.description: Transactional record for a provider's formal appeal of an adverse credentialing decision (denial, revocation, suspension). Captures appeal submission date, appeal type (informal reconsideration, formal hearing, external review), grounds for appeal, supporting documentation submitted, hearing date, hearing panel composition, appeal decision (upheld, overturned, modified), appeal decision date, and notification sent date. products.name: contract_link
products.description: Represents the assignment of a vendor contract to a provider credential record. Each row captures the contract role (primary, supplemental, etc.) and the period during which the contract covers the credential.. Existence Justification: A credential record represents a provider's credentialing status with a health plan. Multiple vendor contracts can cover the same credential record (e.g., primary and supplemental credentialing services), and each vendor contract can cover many credential records across providers. The business actively creates, updates, and deletes these links and tracks role, effective and expiration dates for each coverage.

products.name: obligation_mapping
products.description: This association product represents the mapping between a credential record and a regulatory obligation. It captures the effective and expiration dates that define when a specific credential satisfies a particular regulatory requirement.. Existence Justification: A credential record can satisfy multiple regulatory obligations (e.g., NCQA, HIPAA) and a single regulatory obligation must be satisfied by many credential records across providers. The business actively tracks each credential‑obligation pairing with effective and expiration dates, making the relationship a true many‑to‑many operational entity.

products.name: finding
products.description: Represents the operational link between a provider's credential record and an audit finding. Each row records that a particular finding applies to a specific credential and captures attributes that belong only to this relationship.. Existence Justification: During audit engagements, auditors associate each audit finding with the specific provider credential records that are impacted. A single finding can affect multiple credential records, and a single credential record can be the subject of multiple findings over time. The link is actively created, updated, and tracked as part of the audit remediation process.

attributes.description: Indicates the decision-making authority of this committee type — whether it renders final credentialing decisions, makes recommendations to a higher body, serves in an advisory capacity, or operates under delegated authority from the governing board.

attributes.description: High-level functional category grouping committee types for reporting and governance purposes. Distinguishes credentialing decision-making committees from peer review, quality oversight, advisory, and appeals bodies.

attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the purpose, scope, and responsibilities of this committee type within the credentialing and provider oversight lifecycle.

attributes.description: Standard frequency at which this committee type convenes to review credentialing files and render decisions. NCQA requires timely processing, so meeting cadence directly impacts credentialing cycle time.

attributes.description: The minimum number of voting members required to be present for the committee to conduct official business and render binding credentialing decisions, per organizational bylaws and NCQA standards.

attributes.name: ncqa_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this committee type is explicitly required by NCQA credentialing accreditation standards. Used to distinguish mandatory committee structures from optional or organization-specific governance bodies.

attributes.name: regulatory_basis

attributes.name: review_scope

attributes.name: voting_method

domains.name: network
domains.description: Owns provider network configurations, tier assignments, in-network/out-of-network designations, geographic access standards, network adequacy metrics, and service area configurations. Manages ACO and VBC arrangement participation, network-to-plan associations, network directories, and CMS network adequacy filings. Distinct from provider identity (provider domain) and contract terms (contract domain); network owns the structural relationship between providers and plan networks.
domains.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NCQA, NAIC

products.name: provider_network
products.description: Master entity representing a named provider network — the structural grouping of providers under a specific network product (e.g., HMO Narrow Network, PPO Broad Network, Medicare Advantage Network). Owns network identity, network type (HMO, PPO, EPO, POS), line of business association, effective/termination dates, geographic footprint, CMS network ID, NCQA accreditation status, and tier classification. SSOT for network identity — distinct from plan (benefit design), provider (provider identity), and contract (reimbursement terms).
products.reference: CMS Network Adequacy Filing — Network ID

attributes.references: CMS HPMS Network Adequacy Filing Requirements

attributes.name: network_adequacy_status
attributes.description: Regulatory assessment of whether the network meets time-and-distance and provider-to-member ratio standards. Adequate (meets all standards), Deficient (fails standards), Conditional (approved with corrective action plan), Pending Review (under regulatory evaluation).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: network_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify the network in operational systems, claims processing, and provider directories. Externally-known business identifier.

attributes.name: network_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the network's design, provider composition, geographic coverage, and unique features. Used in member materials and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: CMS Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Requirements

attributes.name: network_directory_url
attributes.business_glossary_term: Network Provider Directory Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
attributes.description: The web URL where members and providers can access the online provider directory for this network. Required for ACA and Medicare Advantage compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Directory Requirements, ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: network_name
attributes.description: The official business name of the provider network (e.g., 'HMO Narrow Network', 'PPO Broad Network', 'Medicare Advantage Network'). Human-readable identifier used in member communications and plan documents.

attributes.name: network_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the provider network. Active (accepting enrollments and claims), Inactive (closed to new enrollments), Suspended (temporary hold), Pending (awaiting regulatory approval), Terminated (permanently closed).

attributes.name: network_type
attributes.description: The structural classification of the provider network. HMO (Health Maintenance Organization) requires PCP and referrals; PPO (Preferred Provider Organization) allows out-of-network access; EPO (Exclusive Provider Organization) no out-of-network except emergency; POS (Point of Service) hybrid model; HDHP (High Deductible Health Plan) network; ACO (Accountable Care Organization) value-based network.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws, CMS Network Standards

attributes.name: next_adequacy_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next network adequacy review. Typically annual for Medicare Advantage and Exchange networks.

attributes.name: out_of_network_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the network allows members to access out-of-network providers with cost-sharing. True for PPO and some POS networks, False for HMO and EPO.
attributes.references: Network Design Standards, ACA Essential Health Benefits

attributes.name: pcp_count
attributes.description: The number of primary care physicians in this network. Key metric for network adequacy and member-to-PCP ratio calculations.

attributes.name: pcp_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members enrolled in this network are required to select a primary care physician. True for HMO and POS networks, False for PPO and EPO.

attributes.name: provider_count
attributes.description: The total number of unique providers (physicians, facilities, ancillary) participating in this network. Used for network adequacy calculations and member communications.

attributes.name: referral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether specialist visits require a referral from the PCP. True for HMO networks, False for PPO, EPO, and most POS networks.

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the network received regulatory approval from CMS or state Department of Insurance to begin operations.
attributes.references: State DOI Licensing Requirements, CMS HPMS Approval Process

attributes.name: service_area_type
attributes.description: The geographic granularity at which this network is defined. Statewide (entire state), Regional (multi-county region), County (county-level), ZIP (ZIP code level), National (multi-state or nationwide).

attributes.name: specialist_count
attributes.description: The number of specialist physicians in this network. Used for specialty access adequacy assessments.

attributes.name: star_rating
attributes.description: The CMS Star Rating for Medicare Advantage networks, ranging from 1.0 to 5.0 stars. Based on quality measures including network access, member satisfaction, and clinical outcomes. Null for non-Medicare networks.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when this provider network ceases operations and is no longer available for new enrollments. Nullable for open-ended networks. Existing members may have run-out periods.
attributes.references: CMS Network Filing Requirements, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: tier_classification
attributes.description: The tiering structure of the network for cost-sharing purposes. Tier 1 (lowest cost-sharing, narrow network), Tier 2 (moderate cost-sharing), Tier 3 (highest cost-sharing, broadest access), Single Tier (no tiering), Tiered (multi-tier structure).

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this network record. Used for audit and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this provider network record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: vbc_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this network includes value-based care arrangements with providers (e.g., shared savings, bundled payments, capitation). True if VBC arrangements exist, False otherwise.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this network record. Used for audit and accountability.

products.name: tier
products.description: Defines the tier structure within a provider network — Tier 1 (preferred/lowest cost-share), Tier 2 (standard), Tier 3 (specialty/higher cost-share), and out-of-network designations. Captures tier name, tier rank, cost-share differential rules, member-facing display label, and applicability by specialty or facility type. Used to drive member cost-sharing calculations and EOB generation. Distinct from contract fee schedules (owned by contract domain).

attributes.name: tier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the network tier. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this network tier record.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.provider_network. Business justification: Network tier definitions are scoped to a specific provider network; adding provider_network_id FK establishes the parent relationship.

attributes.name: coinsurance_differential_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage coinsurance differential for this tier. Used when cost_share_differential_type is coinsurance or hybrid. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: copay_differential_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar copay differential for this tier compared to baseline tier. Used when cost_share_differential_type is copay or hybrid. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: cost_share_differential_type
attributes.description: Type of cost-sharing differential applied to this tier (copay, coinsurance, deductible, hybrid, or none). Determines how member out-of-pocket (OOP) costs are calculated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this network tier record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deductible_applies_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan deductible applies to services rendered by providers in this tier before cost-sharing begins.

attributes.name: display_label
attributes.description: Member-facing display label for the tier shown in EOB, member portal, and Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC). May differ from internal tier name for clarity.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this network tier configuration becomes active and applicable to member cost-sharing and provider network assignments.

attributes.name: facility_type_applicability
attributes.description: Defines which facility types this tier applies to (all, hospital, Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF), Durable Medical Equipment (DME), lab, imaging, pharmacy, home health, or custom list). Used to segment tier assignment rules by facility type. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: all|hospital|snf|dme|lab|imaging|pharmacy|home_health|custom — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Internal operational notes or comments about this tier configuration. Not visible to members or external parties.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last modified this network tier record.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this network tier record was last modified.

attributes.name: member_steerage_incentive_description
attributes.description: Description of any member steerage incentives or rewards offered for using providers in this tier (e.g., reduced cost-sharing, waived deductible, wellness credits).

attributes.name: network_adequacy_credit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers in this tier count toward CMS network adequacy standards and state Department of Insurance (DOI) access requirements.

attributes.name: oop_max_applies_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether member cost-sharing for this tier counts toward the plan Maximum Out-of-Pocket (MOOP) limit.

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether services from providers in this tier require Prior Authorization (PA) or Utilization Management (UM) review.

attributes.name: quality_tier_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tier is designated as a quality tier based on HEDIS, STAR ratings, or other quality performance metrics.

attributes.name: referral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must obtain a referral from their Primary Care Provider (PCP) to access providers in this tier. Typically applies to HMO and POS plans.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the state Department of Insurance (DOI) or CMS filing that approved this tier structure. Used for compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: sbc_disclosure_text
attributes.business_glossary_term: Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Disclosure Text
attributes.description: Standardized disclosure text for this tier that appears in the Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) document provided to members under ACA requirements.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage Requirements

attributes.name: specialty_applicability
attributes.description: Defines which provider specialties this tier applies to (all, primary care only, specialist only, facility, ancillary, behavioral health, or custom list). Used to segment tier assignment rules by provider type. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: all|primary_care|specialist|facility|ancillary|behavioral_health|custom — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this network tier configuration is terminated and no longer applicable. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: tier_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the network tier (e.g., TIER1, TIER2, TIER3, OON). Used in system integrations and member communications.

attributes.name: tier_name
attributes.description: Official name of the network tier as defined in plan documents and contracts.

attributes.name: tier_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking of the tier indicating preference and cost-share level. Lower rank indicates preferred tier with lower member cost-sharing (e.g., 1=Tier 1 Preferred, 2=Tier 2 Standard, 3=Tier 3 Specialty, 99=Out-of-Network).

attributes.name: tier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the network tier configuration (active, inactive, pending approval, suspended, or retired).

attributes.name: tier_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tier indicating its strategic purpose within the network design (preferred, standard, specialty, out-of-network, value-based, narrow network).

attributes.name: vbc_arrangement_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tier is eligible for Value-Based Care (VBC) or Accountable Care Organization (ACO) performance incentives and shared savings arrangements.

products.name: network_provider
products.description: Association entity representing the participation of a specific provider (NPI) within a specific provider network, capturing in-network status, effective and termination dates, tier assignment, accepting-new-patients flag, telehealth availability, panel status (open/closed), panel capacity, and credentialing linkage. This is the SSOT for the structural relationship between a provider and a network — distinct from provider identity (provider domain), contract terms (contract domain), and ACO-specific participation (aco_provider). Supports provider directory publication, CMS network adequacy filings, and member eligibility verification.

attributes.name: network_provider_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the network-provider association record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Required for allocating provider network expenses to a cost center for accounting and regulatory expense reporting.

attributes.name: delegated_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credential.delegated_entity. Business justification: When credentialing is delegated, Network Provider must reference the Delegated Credentialing Entity that performed the credentialing, required for the Delegated Credentialing Compliance Report.

attributes.name: liaison_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Network Provider Management: each provider is assigned a liaison employee who oversees contracts and compliance; required for provider relationship reporting.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the provider participating in this network. Links to the provider master entity.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the provider network to which this provider participates. Links to the network master entity.

attributes.name: record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credential.credential_record. Business justification: Network Provider participation requires linking to the specific Credential Record used for credentialing, enabling the Network Participation Report and compliance audit.

attributes.name: telehealth_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Telehealth Service Vendor Tracking records which external vendor supplies the telehealth platform for each network provider.

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this provider is currently accepting new patients from this network. True indicates accepting new patients.

attributes.name: accessibility_ada_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Accessibility Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this provider's facilities meet ADA accessibility requirements for members with disabilities. True indicates ADA compliance.

attributes.name: aco_participant_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this provider participates in an ACO arrangement within this network. True indicates ACO participation.

attributes.name: after_hours_availability_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this provider offers after-hours or extended-hours services to members of this network. True indicates after-hours availability.

attributes.name: continuity_of_care_end_date
attributes.description: The date through which existing members may continue to see this provider under in-network benefits after network termination, per continuity of care requirements.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this network-provider association record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: credentialing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider was most recently credentialed for participation in this network.

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current credentialing status of the provider for participation in this network. Credentialed indicates all requirements met.

attributes.name: current_panel_size
attributes.description: The current number of members assigned to or served by this provider within this network.

attributes.name: directory_last_verified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's directory information was last verified for accuracy. CMS requires quarterly verification.

attributes.name: directory_listing_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this provider should be included in the published provider directory for this network. True indicates directory inclusion.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's participation in this network became or will become effective.

attributes.name: geographic_service_area
attributes.description: The geographic area or region within which this provider serves members of this network. May be county, ZIP code range, or custom service area code.

attributes.name: in_network_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this provider is currently in-network for this network. True indicates in-network status.

attributes.name: language_services_available
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of languages in which this provider offers services to members of this network, supporting cultural and linguistic access requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Culturally and Linguistically Appropriate Services (CLAS) Standards

attributes.name: network_adequacy_category
attributes.description: Classification of this provider's role in meeting network adequacy requirements. Essential indicates critical for minimum adequacy standards.

attributes.name: network_participation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the provider's participation relationship with this network. PAR indicates participating provider with contracted rates; non-PAR indicates non-participating.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify this provider in the network.

attributes.name: panel_capacity
attributes.description: The maximum number of members this provider can serve within this network. Used for network adequacy calculations.

attributes.name: panel_status
attributes.description: Current status of the provider's patient panel for this network. Open indicates capacity for new members; closed indicates no capacity.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the provider's participation in this network. Active indicates the provider is currently in-network and accepting members.

attributes.name: pcp_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this provider serves as a Primary Care Provider within this network. True indicates PCP designation.

attributes.name: quality_tier_designation
attributes.description: Quality-based tier assignment for this provider within the network, based on HEDIS or Star Ratings performance metrics.

attributes.name: record_active_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this network-provider association record is currently active in the system. False indicates a logically deleted or superseded record.

attributes.name: recredentialing_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the provider must complete recredentialing to maintain participation in this network. Typically every 3 years per NCQA standards.

attributes.name: risk_sharing_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this provider participates in risk-sharing financial arrangements within this network. True indicates risk-sharing participation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system from which this network-provider association record originated (e.g., Cactus, ProviderSource, Facets).

attributes.name: specialist_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this provider is designated as a specialist within this network. True indicates specialist designation.

attributes.name: telehealth_available_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this provider offers telehealth services to members of this network. True indicates telehealth availability.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the provider's participation in this network ended or will end. Null for ongoing participation.

attributes.name: termination_initiated_by
attributes.description: Indicates which party initiated the termination of the provider's network participation. Null for active participation.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for termination of the provider's participation in this network. Null for active participation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary|contract_expiration|quality_issues|credentialing_failure|network_restructure|provider_request|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tier_assignment
attributes.description: The benefit tier assigned to this provider within the network, determining member cost-sharing levels. Tier 1 typically represents lowest member cost-sharing.
attributes.references: ACA Summary of Benefits and Coverage (SBC) Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this network-provider association record was most recently updated in the system.

attributes.name: vbc_participant_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this provider participates in value-based care arrangements within this network. True indicates VBC participation.

attributes.name: weekend_availability_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this provider offers weekend services to members of this network. True indicates weekend availability.

products.name: plan_association
products.description: Association entity linking a provider network to one or more health plan products, capturing the effective period, LOB, market segment (individual, small group, large group, Medicare, Medicaid), and whether the network is the primary or supplemental network for that plan. Enables plan-to-network resolution for eligibility verification (270/271 EDI) and claims adjudication routing. Owned by the network domain as the structural bridge between network configurations and plan offerings.

attributes.name: plan_association_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the plan association record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Links each plan‑network association to its annual budget, enabling budget‑vs‑actual variance analysis for network participation.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the health plan product that is associated with this provider network. Links to the plan and benefit domain's plan entity.

attributes.name: network_service_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic service area where this plan-network association is valid. Defines the counties, ZIP codes, or regions where members can access this network under this plan.

attributes.name: primary_plan_cms_filing_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Filing Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: The CMS-assigned identifier for the network adequacy filing or Plan Benefit Package (PBP) submission that includes this plan-network association. Required for Medicare Advantage and Marketplace plans.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider network being associated with the health plan product. Links to the network domain's network configuration entity.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws - Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: aco_participation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan-network association includes participation in an Accountable Care Organization arrangement. True means ACO providers are included in this network for this plan; false means no ACO participation.

attributes.name: adequacy_certification_date
attributes.description: The date when this plan-network association was certified as meeting network adequacy requirements by the regulatory authority or internal compliance review.

attributes.name: adequacy_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent network adequacy review or assessment for this plan-network association. Used to track compliance monitoring cycles.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws - Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: association_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for this plan-to-network association, used in eligibility verification (270/271 EDI transactions) and claims adjudication routing.

attributes.name: association_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for this plan-to-network association, typically combining plan name and network name for operational reference.

attributes.name: association_type
attributes.description: Classification of the network's role for this plan. Primary indicates the main network for member access; supplemental provides additional coverage; specialty covers specific service categories; out-of-area supports members outside primary service area; reciprocal represents shared network arrangements; tertiary provides fallback coverage.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws - Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: auto_assignment_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members can be automatically assigned to providers in this network under this plan. Relevant for Medicaid and some Medicare programs that use auto-assignment for members who do not actively select a provider. True means eligible for auto-assignment; false means member must actively select.
attributes.references: CMS Medicaid Managed Care Auto-Assignment Rules

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference to the master contract or agreement document that governs this plan-network association. Links to contract management systems for terms, rates, and legal provisions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this plan-network association record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: directory_publication_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers in this network for this plan should be published in member-facing provider directories and online search tools. True means include in directory; false means exclude (e.g., for internal or specialty networks).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this plan-to-network association becomes active and members can begin accessing providers in this network under this plan.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business this plan-network association serves. Commercial covers employer-sponsored and individual plans; Medicare includes Medicare Advantage; Medicaid covers state programs; Marketplace represents ACA exchange plans; dual eligible serves Medicare-Medicaid beneficiaries; CHIP covers Children's Health Insurance Program.

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: The market segment this plan-network association targets. Individual covers direct-to-consumer; small group typically 2-50 employees; large group 51-999 employees; jumbo group 1000+ employees; government includes federal and state employee plans; student covers university and college plans.

attributes.name: member_count
attributes.description: The number of members currently enrolled in this plan who have access to this network. Used for network adequacy calculations and capacity planning.

attributes.name: network_adequacy_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan-network association meets regulatory network adequacy standards for provider access, time-and-distance requirements, and specialty coverage. Compliant meets all standards; non-compliant fails requirements; under review is being evaluated; exempt has regulatory waiver; conditional meets standards with restrictions.

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: The tier designation of this network within the plan's tiered network structure. Tier 1 typically offers lowest cost-sharing; tier 2 moderate; tier 3 highest. Preferred, standard, basic, and premium are alternative tier naming conventions used by some plans. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tier_1|tier_2|tier_3|preferred|standard|basic|premium — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special instructions, or contextual information about this plan-network association. Used for operational notes that do not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: out_of_network_coverage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan provides any coverage for out-of-network services when this network is the member's assigned network. True means out-of-network benefits exist (typical for PPO); false means no out-of-network coverage (typical for HMO and EPO).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws - Network Plan Definitions

attributes.name: pcp_selection_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Care Provider (PCP) Selection Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members enrolled in this plan with this network must select a primary care provider. Typically true for HMO and POS plans; false for PPO and EPO plans.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws - Managed Care Plan Requirements

attributes.name: plan_association_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the plan-network association. Active indicates operational; inactive means temporarily disabled; pending awaits regulatory approval or contract execution; suspended indicates temporary hold; terminated means permanently ended.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws - Network Filing Requirements

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether services rendered by providers in this network under this plan require prior authorization. True means PA is required; false means no PA requirement. This is a network-level default that may be overridden by specific service or provider rules.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the priority order of this network when multiple networks are associated with the same plan. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used in claims adjudication routing when a member has access to multiple networks.

attributes.name: provider_count
attributes.description: The number of unique providers (individual practitioners and facilities) participating in this network for this plan. Used for network adequacy reporting and member communications.

attributes.name: referral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must obtain a referral from their primary care provider to access specialists in this network under this plan. Typically true for HMO plans; false for PPO and EPO plans.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws - Managed Care Plan Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_date
attributes.description: The date when the regulatory authority (CMS or state DOI) approved this plan-network association for use. Required before the association can become effective.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Laws - Plan Filing Requirements

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the operational system of record that originated this plan-network association data. Typically the Core Administration Platform (Facets, QNXT) or Provider Management System (Cactus, ProviderSource).

attributes.name: star_rating_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether provider performance in this network impacts the plan's CMS Star Ratings. Applicable primarily to Medicare Advantage plans. True means network performance affects Star metrics; false means no Star impact.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when this plan-to-network association ends. Null indicates an open-ended association. After this date, members can no longer access providers in this network under this plan for new services.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that last modified this plan-network association record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this plan-network association record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: vbc_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this plan-network association operates under a value-based care payment model. True means providers in this network are reimbursed based on quality and outcomes; false means traditional fee-for-service.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user identifier or system account that created this plan-network association record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: network_service_area
products.description: Defines the geographic service area for a provider network — the counties, ZIP codes, or metropolitan statistical areas (MSAs) where the network is available and where members must reside to enroll. Captures state, county FIPS code, ZIP code, service area type (county-based, ZIP-based), CMS service area ID, effective dates, and whether the area is approved for QHP/Medicare Advantage enrollment. Critical for CMS network adequacy filings and state DOI market conduct compliance.
products.reference: CMS Service Area — HIOS Service Area ID

attributes.name: network_service_area_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the geographic service area. Primary key.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the provider network to which this service area belongs.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the regulatory filing (e.g., SERFF filing, CMS HPMS submission) that established or modified this service area.
attributes.references: NAIC SERFF (System for Electronic Rate and Form Filing) / CMS HPMS

attributes.name: cms_service_area_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Service Area ID
attributes.description: CMS-assigned identifier for the service area, used in Medicare Advantage and Marketplace (QHP) filings.

attributes.name: commercial_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service area is approved for commercial (employer-sponsored and individual) plan enrollment.

attributes.name: county_fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code
attributes.description: Five-digit Federal Information Processing Standards code uniquely identifying the county. Null for non-county-based service areas.

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Name of the county included in this service area. Null for non-county-based service areas.
