attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service area record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this service area configuration becomes active and available for member enrollment.

attributes.name: geographic_boundary_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the service area boundaries, used for custom or complex geographic definitions not captured by standard codes.

attributes.name: medicaid_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service area is approved for Medicaid managed care enrollment.

attributes.name: medicare_advantage_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service area is approved for Medicare Advantage plan enrollment.

attributes.name: member_residency_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether members must reside within this service area to be eligible for enrollment in the associated network.
attributes.references: CMS Enrollment Standards / State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: msa_code
attributes.description: Five-digit code identifying the Metropolitan Statistical Area. Null for non-MSA-based service areas.
attributes.references: U.S. Office of Management and Budget (OMB) MSA Definitions

attributes.name: msa_name
attributes.description: Name of the Metropolitan Statistical Area (e.g., 'San Francisco-Oakland-Hayward, CA'). Null for non-MSA-based service areas.
attributes.references: U.S. Office of Management and Budget (OMB) MSA Definitions

attributes.name: network_adequacy_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the network adequacy filing was approved by CMS or the state Department of Insurance for this service area.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards / State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: network_adequacy_filing_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent network adequacy filing was submitted to CMS or the state Department of Insurance for this service area.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards / State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: network_adequacy_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the service area meets CMS and state network adequacy standards for provider access: compliant, non-compliant, under review, waiver granted, or not applicable.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards / State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: network_service_area_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the service area: active (available for enrollment), inactive (not available), pending approval (awaiting regulatory approval), suspended (temporarily unavailable), or terminated (permanently closed).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, exceptions, or special instructions related to this service area configuration.

attributes.name: out_of_area_coverage_allowed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Out of Area Coverage Allowed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the plan allows coverage for services received outside this service area (e.g., for travel or temporary relocation).

attributes.name: population_count
attributes.description: Estimated total population residing in this service area, used for network adequacy calculations and market sizing.

attributes.name: qhp_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service area is approved for Qualified Health Plan (Marketplace/Exchange) enrollment under the Affordable Care Act.
attributes.references: ACA (Affordable Care Act) / CMS Marketplace Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_number
attributes.description: Reference number assigned by CMS or the state Department of Insurance when approving this service area configuration.

attributes.name: service_area_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the service area, used in contracts, filings, and member communications.

attributes.name: service_area_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the service area (e.g., 'Northern California Region', 'Metro Atlanta Service Area').

attributes.name: service_area_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the service area is defined geographically: county-based, ZIP code-based, Metropolitan Statistical Area (MSA)-based, state-based, custom boundary, or multi-state.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state abbreviation where the service area is located (e.g., 'CA', 'TX', 'NY'). For multi-state service areas, this represents the primary state.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this service area configuration is no longer active. Null for currently active service areas.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this service area record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service area record was last modified.

attributes.name: urban_rural_designation
attributes.description: Classification of the service area as urban, suburban, rural, frontier (very low population density), or mixed.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: Five-digit ZIP code included in this service area. Null for non-ZIP-based service areas.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this service area record.

products.name: adequacy_standard
products.description: Reference entity defining all network compliance standards by specialty, facility type, and geographic area — encompassing time-distance standards (e.g., 30 miles/30 minutes for PCPs), provider-to-member ratios, appointment access wait-time standards (routine, urgent, preventive, behavioral health), after-hours availability requirements, and telehealth equivalency rules. Captures regulatory source (CMS, state DOI, NCQA, URAC), standard category (time-distance, provider-ratio, appointment-access, after-hours, telehealth-equivalency), specialty category, geographic classification (urban, suburban, rural, frontier), maximum wait time in days, threshold values, and after-hours availability flag. This is the single source of truth for all network adequacy and access compliance standards — both geographic access (time-distance, ratios) and appointment access (wait times, after-hours). Used to evaluate compliance in adequacy assessments, access surveys, and CMS/state regulatory filings.
products.reference: CMS Network Adequacy Time-Distance Standards — 42 CFR 438.68

attributes.name: adequacy_standard_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the network adequacy standard record. Primary key.

attributes.name: adequacy_standard_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this adequacy standard: active (currently enforced), inactive (not currently enforced), proposed (pending regulatory approval), superseded (replaced by newer standard), or under-review (being evaluated for changes).

attributes.name: after_hours_availability_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether after-hours availability (evenings, weekends, holidays) is required for this specialty and geography. True if after-hours access is mandated, false otherwise.
attributes.references: NCQA Accreditation Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: after_hours_definition
attributes.description: Definition of what constitutes after-hours for this standard (e.g., weekdays after 5pm, weekends, 24/7 access). Null if after-hours availability is not required.

attributes.name: appointment_type
attributes.description: Type of appointment this wait-time standard applies to: routine (non-urgent care), urgent (same-day/next-day need), preventive (wellness visits), behavioral-health (mental health/substance abuse), specialist (referral appointments), or emergency. Null if standard is not appointment-access based.
attributes.references: NCQA Appointment Access Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: compliance_reporting_frequency
attributes.description: How often compliance with this standard must be assessed and reported to regulators: annual, semi-annual, quarterly, monthly, or on-demand (event-triggered).
attributes.references: CMS Reporting Requirements, State DOI Filing Schedules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this adequacy standard record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this adequacy standard becomes effective and must be met. Standards change over time as regulations evolve.
attributes.references: CMS Regulatory Effective Dates, State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: exception_criteria
attributes.description: Conditions under which an exception or waiver to this standard may be granted (e.g., provider shortage area designation, rural exception, temporary hardship). Null if no exceptions allowed.
attributes.references: CMS Waiver Process, State DOI Exception Policies

attributes.name: geographic_classification
attributes.description: Geographic area classification for which this standard applies: urban (metropolitan areas), suburban (surrounding metro areas), rural (non-metropolitan), or frontier (very low population density areas). Standards vary by geography.
attributes.references: CMS Geographic Classification, HRSA Rural Health Definitions

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this adequacy standard record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Health insurance line of business this standard applies to: medicare-advantage (MA plans), medicaid (state programs), commercial (employer-sponsored), marketplace (ACA exchange plans), dual-eligible (Medicare-Medicaid), or all (applies to all LOBs).

attributes.name: maximum_distance_miles
attributes.description: Maximum allowable distance in miles from member residence to nearest in-network provider of this specialty in this geographic area. Null if standard is not distance-based.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Time and Distance Standards

attributes.name: maximum_travel_time_minutes
attributes.description: Maximum allowable travel time in minutes from member residence to nearest in-network provider of this specialty in this geographic area. Null if standard is not time-based.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Time and Distance Standards

attributes.name: maximum_wait_time_days
attributes.description: Maximum allowable wait time in days from appointment request to appointment date for this appointment type and specialty. Null if standard is not appointment-access based.
attributes.references: NCQA Appointment Access Standards, CMS CAHPS Survey Requirements

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: Description of how compliance with this standard is measured (e.g., GeoAccess analysis, member survey, claims-based appointment tracking, provider attestation). Defines the assessment approach.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Reporting Requirements, NCQA Standards

attributes.name: minimum_provider_count
attributes.description: Absolute minimum number of providers of this specialty required in the network for this geography, regardless of member count. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, clarifications, or special instructions related to this adequacy standard. May include implementation guidance, historical context, or regulatory interpretation.

attributes.name: penalty_for_non_compliance
attributes.description: Description of regulatory penalties or consequences for failing to meet this standard (e.g., corrective action plan, fines, enrollment suspension, Star rating impact). Null if no specific penalty defined.
attributes.references: CMS Enforcement Actions, State DOI Sanctions

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Type of health plan this standard applies to: HMO (Health Maintenance Organization), PPO (Preferred Provider Organization), EPO (Exclusive Provider Organization), POS (Point of Service), HDHP (High Deductible Health Plan), or all (applies to all plan types). Standards may vary by plan structure.
attributes.references: CMS Plan Type Definitions, NAIC Model Laws

attributes.name: provider_to_member_ratio
attributes.description: Required ratio of providers to members for this specialty and geography, expressed as ratio string (e.g., 1:2000 for PCPs, 1:5000 for specialists). Null if standard is not ratio-based.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Provider Ratio Standards, NCQA Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_source
attributes.description: Governing body or regulatory authority that mandates this standard: CMS (Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services), state-DOI (State Department of Insurance), NCQA (National Committee for Quality Assurance), URAC, ACA (Affordable Care Act), or internal (company-defined standard exceeding regulatory minimums).
attributes.references: CMS, State DOI, NCQA, URAC, ACA

attributes.name: service_area_type
attributes.description: Geographic unit for which this standard is defined: county (county-level), zip (ZIP code level), state (state-wide), region (multi-state region), or national (nationwide standard).

attributes.name: specialty_category
attributes.description: Provider specialty or facility type this standard applies to (e.g., PCP, cardiology, behavioral-health, hospital, SNF, DME). May be broad category or specific specialty code.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Taxonomy, AMA Specialty Codes

attributes.name: standard_category
attributes.description: Classification of the adequacy standard type: time-distance (geographic access), provider-ratio (provider-to-member ratios), appointment-access (wait time standards), after-hours (availability requirements), telehealth-equivalency (virtual care standards), or network-composition (network mix requirements).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NCQA Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: standard_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the adequacy standard (e.g., PCP_URBAN_TIME, BH_RURAL_RATIO). Used for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: standard_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the adequacy standard (e.g., Primary Care Physician Urban Time-Distance Standard).

attributes.name: standard_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this standard, used to track changes over time (e.g., 2024.1, v3.0). Supports historical analysis and regulatory audit trails.

attributes.name: telehealth_equivalency_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether telehealth/virtual care providers can be counted toward meeting this adequacy standard. True if telehealth equivalency is permitted, false if only in-person providers count.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Policy, State DOI Telehealth Parity Laws

attributes.name: telehealth_percentage_cap
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of the adequacy requirement that can be met through telehealth providers (e.g., 25.00 means up to 25% of required providers can be telehealth-only). Null if no cap or telehealth not allowed.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Policy, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date when this adequacy standard is no longer in effect, either due to regulatory change or supersession by a new standard. Null if currently active with no planned end date.
attributes.references: CMS Regulatory Updates, State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: threshold_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of members or geographic area that must meet this standard (e.g., 90.00 means 90% of members must have access within the specified time/distance). Used for compliance measurement.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

products.name: adequacy_assessment
products.description: Transactional record of a network compliance evaluation — including network adequacy assessments, access surveys, mystery shopper studies, and gap identification. Captures assessment type (adequacy, access-survey, mystery-shopper), assessment date, regulatory submission type (CMS, state DOI), specialty/facility type evaluated, provider counts, member-to-provider ratios, time-distance compliance results, wait-time measurements, survey method (member survey, secret shopper call), appointment type requested, telehealth offered flag, and overall compliance outcome. Includes detail-level gap findings as child records: specific specialty or facility type shortfalls within a geographic area, gap severity, number of providers available vs. required, remediation actions taken, and resolution status. Supports CMS network adequacy filings, NCQA HEDIS access measures (Getting Care Quickly), CAHPS survey supplementation, and targeted network development. This is the SSOT for all network compliance evaluations and their associated gap findings.
products.reference: CMS Network Adequacy Filing — HPMS Submission

attributes.name: adequacy_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the network adequacy assessment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: adequacy_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.adequacy_standard. Business justification: Each adequacy assessment applies a specific adequacy standard; linking via adequacy_standard_id enables reference to the standard definition.

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Adequacy assessments are performed to meet a specific regulatory obligation for network adequacy compliance.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.provider_contract. Business justification: Adequacy assessments are performed per contract to verify network adequacy obligations; link enables contract‑level performance dashboards.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Captures costs of network adequacy assessments in a cost center to support regulatory cost reporting.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the health plan associated with this network adequacy assessment.

attributes.name: network_service_area_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the geographic service area evaluated in this assessment.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the provider network being assessed for adequacy compliance.

attributes.name: risk_pool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.pool. Business justification: Network adequacy assessments require risk pool data to evaluate member health risk distribution for compliance and planning.

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers in the assessed specialty or facility type are accepting new patients. True if accepting, False otherwise.

attributes.name: appointment_type_requested
attributes.description: Type of appointment requested during mystery shopper or survey assessment: routine care, urgent care, preventive visit, follow-up visit, new patient intake, or specialist referral.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Getting Care Quickly Measure

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the network adequacy assessment was conducted or completed.

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the adequacy assessment, used for external reference and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: assessment_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the evaluation period covered by this assessment.

attributes.name: assessment_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the evaluation period covered by this assessment.

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Type of network compliance evaluation performed: adequacy (provider count and ratio), access-survey (member experience survey), mystery-shopper (secret shopper call study), gap-analysis (deficiency identification), time-distance (geographic access compliance), or appointment-availability (wait time measurement).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NCQA HEDIS Access Measures

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or team responsible for conducting the network adequacy assessment.

attributes.name: assessor_organization
attributes.description: Organization or department that conducted the assessment (e.g., internal network management team, third-party consultant, regulatory auditor).

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or context related to the network adequacy assessment, including qualitative findings or special circumstances.

attributes.name: compliance_outcome
attributes.description: Overall compliance result of the network adequacy assessment: compliant (meets all standards), non-compliant (fails standards), partially-compliant (meets some but not all standards), under-review (pending final determination), or remediation-required (corrective action needed).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the adequacy assessment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Type of healthcare facility evaluated in this assessment (e.g., hospital, urgent care, skilled nursing facility (SNF), ambulatory surgery center, imaging center).
attributes.references: CMS Provider Taxonomy, NAIC Facility Classification

attributes.name: gap_identified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether network gaps or deficiencies were identified during the assessment. True if gaps exist, False otherwise.

attributes.name: gap_severity
attributes.description: Severity level of identified network gaps: critical (immediate member access risk), high (significant access limitation), moderate (minor access concern), or low (minimal impact).
attributes.references: Internal Risk Assessment Framework, CMS Compliance Standards

attributes.name: member_to_provider_ratio
attributes.description: Calculated ratio of enrolled members to available providers in the assessed specialty or facility type, expressed as members per provider.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: provider_count_available
attributes.description: Number of in-network providers or facilities available in the assessed specialty or facility type within the service area.

attributes.name: provider_count_required
attributes.description: Minimum number of providers or facilities required by regulatory standards to meet network adequacy thresholds for the assessed specialty or facility type.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_type
attributes.description: Type of regulatory body or framework for which this assessment is being conducted: CMS Medicare, CMS Marketplace, State Department of Insurance (DOI), NCQA accreditation, internal monitoring, or ACA Qualified Health Plan (QHP) certification.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Requirements, State DOI Regulations, NCQA Standards, ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: remediation_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of corrective actions taken to address identified network gaps, such as provider recruitment, contract expansion, telehealth deployment, or member outreach.

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which remediation actions must be completed to resolve identified network gaps and achieve compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Corrective Action Plan Requirements, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of remediation efforts: not-started (action plan pending), in-progress (corrective actions underway), completed (actions finished), verified (compliance confirmed), or overdue (past due date).

attributes.name: specialty_type
attributes.description: Medical specialty or provider type being evaluated in this assessment (e.g., primary care, cardiology, orthopedics, behavioral health, pediatrics).
attributes.references: AMA Physician Specialty Codes, CMS Provider Taxonomy

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the network adequacy assessment was submitted to the regulatory body (CMS, State DOI, NCQA).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Filing Deadlines, State DOI Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: submission_status
attributes.description: Status of the regulatory submission: draft (not yet submitted), submitted (under review), accepted (approved by regulator), rejected (not approved), or resubmission-required (corrections needed).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Filing Process, State DOI Submission Standards

attributes.name: survey_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to conduct the assessment: member survey (CAHPS or custom), secret shopper call (mystery shopper study), provider survey (direct provider inquiry), administrative data (claims and enrollment analysis), or geospatial analysis (GIS mapping).
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications, CAHPS Survey Protocol

attributes.name: telehealth_offered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether telehealth or virtual care options were offered as an alternative during the assessment. True if telehealth was available, False otherwise.
attributes.references: CMS Telehealth Expansion Guidelines, ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: time_distance_compliance_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of members in the service area who have access to the assessed provider specialty or facility type within the required time and distance standards.

attributes.name: time_distance_standard_miles
attributes.description: Maximum distance in miles that members should travel to access the assessed provider specialty or facility type, as defined by regulatory standards.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Time and Distance Standards

attributes.name: time_distance_standard_minutes
attributes.description: Maximum travel time in minutes that members should travel to access the assessed provider specialty or facility type, as defined by regulatory standards.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Time and Distance Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the adequacy assessment record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: wait_time_days_routine
attributes.description: Average number of days members wait for a routine appointment with the assessed provider specialty, measured through survey or mystery shopper methodology.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Getting Care Quickly Measure, CAHPS Survey

attributes.name: wait_time_days_urgent
attributes.description: Average number of days members wait for an urgent appointment with the assessed provider specialty, measured through survey or mystery shopper methodology.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Getting Care Quickly Measure, CAHPS Survey

products.name: adequacy_gap
products.description: Captures individual network adequacy gaps identified during an adequacy assessment — specific specialty or facility type shortfalls within a geographic area that fail to meet the applicable adequacy standard. Records gap type, affected specialty, geographic area, number of providers available vs. required, gap severity, remediation action taken (e.g., provider recruitment, access plan exception), and resolution status. Enables targeted network development and regulatory gap closure tracking.
products.reference: Network Adequacy Gap — CMS Corrective Action

attributes.name: adequacy_gap_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the network adequacy gap record. Primary key.

attributes.name: adequacy_assessment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent network adequacy assessment that identified this gap.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.provider_contract. Business justification: Identified adequacy gaps are addressed within the context of the specific provider contract; required for remediation tracking.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the health plan affected by this network adequacy gap.

attributes.name: network_service_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the geographic service area where this adequacy gap exists.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider network in which this adequacy gap exists.

attributes.name: actual_resolution_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which this adequacy gap was resolved and the network met the applicable adequacy standard. Null if gap remains unresolved.

attributes.name: affected_member_count
attributes.description: Estimated number of plan members residing in the affected geographic area who are impacted by this adequacy gap.

attributes.name: available_provider_count
attributes.description: Number of providers or facilities of the specified type currently available in the network in this geographic area. Null if standard is not count-based.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this adequacy gap record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: exception_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory exception or access plan waiver was approved by CMS or the state DOI. Null if no exception has been granted.

attributes.name: exception_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the granted regulatory exception or access plan waiver expires and the network must meet the full adequacy standard. Null if no exception has been granted or if exception is permanent.

attributes.name: exception_granted_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory exception or access plan waiver has been granted by CMS or the state DOI for this adequacy gap.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: exception_justification
attributes.description: Business rationale and supporting documentation for the regulatory exception or access plan waiver request (e.g., rural area with limited provider availability, specialty shortage area designation, alternative access arrangements).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: exception_request_date
attributes.description: Date on which a regulatory exception or access plan waiver was formally requested for this adequacy gap. Null if no exception has been requested.

attributes.name: exception_requested_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a regulatory exception or access plan waiver has been requested from CMS or the state DOI for this adequacy gap.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: gap_magnitude
attributes.description: Numeric difference between required and available provider count (required minus available). Positive values indicate shortfall. Null if standard is not count-based.

attributes.name: gap_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the adequacy gap, used for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: gap_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the adequacy gap based on magnitude of shortfall, number of affected members, and criticality of the specialty or service type. Used to prioritize remediation efforts.

attributes.name: gap_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the adequacy gap indicating whether it has been identified, is being remediated, has been resolved, or has received a regulatory exception or waiver.

attributes.name: gap_type
attributes.description: Classification of the adequacy gap by the dimension of network adequacy that fails to meet standards (specialty provider shortage, facility type shortage, geographic coverage gap, time and distance standard violation, appointment wait time standard violation, or essential community provider requirement shortfall).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NAIC Model Act #74

attributes.name: geographic_area_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific geographic area affected by this adequacy gap (e.g., FIPS county code, ZIP code, CBSA code).
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau FIPS Codes, USPS ZIP Codes

attributes.name: geographic_area_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the geographic area affected by this adequacy gap (e.g., county name, city name, region name).

attributes.name: geographic_area_type
attributes.description: Type of geographic unit used to define the area affected by this adequacy gap (county, ZIP code, Core-Based Statistical Area, service area, or custom region).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, U.S. Census Bureau Geographic Standards

attributes.name: identified_date
attributes.description: Date on which this network adequacy gap was first identified during an adequacy assessment.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: Line of business to which this adequacy gap applies (Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Marketplace/Exchange, or Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan). Different LOBs may have different adequacy standards.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes, context, or commentary regarding this adequacy gap, remediation efforts, or regulatory interactions.

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which this adequacy gap applies and must be remediated (e.g., 2024, 2025). Network adequacy is assessed and certified annually.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adequacy gap must be disclosed in regulatory filings to CMS, state DOI, or other governing bodies (e.g., QHP certification, network adequacy annual report).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, ACA Section 1311, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: remediation_action
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action plan or strategy being implemented to close this adequacy gap (e.g., targeted provider recruitment, contract expansion, telehealth deployment, access plan exception request).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: remediation_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual, team, or department responsible for executing the remediation action and closing this adequacy gap.

attributes.name: required_provider_count
attributes.description: Number of providers or facilities of the specified type required to meet the adequacy standard in this geographic area. Null if standard is not count-based.

attributes.name: specialty_code
attributes.description: Standard taxonomy code for the provider specialty or facility type that is deficient (e.g., NUCC taxonomy code for specialty providers, facility type code for facilities). Null if gap is not specialty-specific.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy, CMS Provider Specialty Codes

attributes.name: specialty_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the provider specialty or facility type that is deficient (e.g., Cardiology, Skilled Nursing Facility, Primary Care Physician). Null if gap is not specialty-specific.

attributes.name: standard_threshold
attributes.description: The regulatory or contractual adequacy standard threshold that must be met (e.g., '30 miles or 30 minutes', '1 PCP per 2000 members', '95% within 10 business days'). Format varies by standard type.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: standard_type
attributes.description: Type of network adequacy standard that this gap violates (time and distance, provider-to-member ratio, appointment availability, or essential community provider percentage requirement).
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NAIC Model Act #74, ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: target_resolution_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which this adequacy gap is expected to be resolved or mitigated to meet the applicable standard.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this adequacy gap record was last modified in the system.

products.name: provider_directory
products.description: Published provider directory record representing the member-facing view of a provider's network participation, including full verification lifecycle tracking. Captures provider name, specialty, practice location, phone, accepting-new-patients status, telehealth availability, languages spoken, accessibility features (ADA compliance), last verified date, and directory publication channel (online, print, API). Embeds complete verification history as child records — including verification method (outbound call, online attestation, EHR/HIE data match, claims-based inference), verification date, verified fields (address, phone, accepting-new-patients, specialty), verification outcome (confirmed, updated, unable to reach), and verifying agent/system. Supports CMS directory accuracy requirements (42 CFR 422.111), No Surprises Act compliance, the 90-day directory update mandate, and quarterly verification tracking. This is the SSOT for member-facing directory data and its verification audit trail.
products.reference: CMS Provider Directory — 42 CFR 422.111 / No Surprises Act

attributes.name: provider_directory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider directory record. Primary key for the published provider directory entry representing the member-facing view of a provider's network participation.

attributes.name: directory_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Provider Directory Vendor Management ensures directory data is sourced from a specific vendor, required for compliance audit.

attributes.name: maintaining_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Provider Directory Maintenance: assigns an employee who updates directory entries, required for data quality and audit trails.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider master record. Links this directory entry to the provider identity in the provider domain.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the network configuration. Identifies which network this provider participates in for member directory searches.

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is currently accepting new patients. Critical field for member directory searches and CMS directory accuracy compliance.

attributes.name: accessibility_features
attributes.description: Description of specific accessibility features available at the practice location, such as wheelchair ramps, accessible parking, or assistive listening devices.

attributes.name: ada_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the practice location is ADA-compliant and accessible to individuals with disabilities. Supports member searches for accessible facilities.
attributes.references: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), Section 1557 ACA

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the practice location. First line of the physical address where the provider sees patients.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite, floor, or building number. Optional address component for practice location.

attributes.name: board_certification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider is board-certified in their specialty. Used for quality assessment and member directory filtering.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City name of the practice location. Used for geographic search and network adequacy reporting.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County name of the practice location. Used for CMS network adequacy reporting and geographic access standards.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this provider directory record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Calculated data quality score for this directory entry based on completeness, accuracy, and recency of verification. Range 0.00 to 100.00. Supports directory quality monitoring.

attributes.name: directory_publication_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which this directory entry is published and accessible to members. Supports multi-channel directory distribution tracking.

attributes.name: directory_status
attributes.description: Current status of the provider directory entry. Indicates whether the entry is actively published, pending verification, or suspended from member-facing display.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this provider directory entry was terminated or became inactive. Null for currently active entries. Supports historical directory analysis.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this provider directory entry became effective and available for member searches. Supports historical tracking of directory changes.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Email contact for the practice location. Used for electronic communication and directory verification outreach.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the practice location. Used for prior authorization and medical records transmission.

attributes.name: gender
attributes.description: Gender of the provider. Used for member preference-based directory searches, particularly for gender-specific care.

attributes.name: hospital_affiliation
attributes.description: Name of the hospital or health system with which the provider has admitting privileges or affiliation. Supports continuity of care and member decision-making.

attributes.name: languages_spoken
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of languages spoken by the provider or available at the practice location. Supports culturally competent care and member language preference searches.
attributes.references: CMS Cultural Competency Standards, Section 1557 ACA

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this provider directory record was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_verification_method
attributes.description: Method used for the most recent directory verification. Tracks how the provider information was validated for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: last_verification_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent verification attempt. Indicates whether information was confirmed, updated, or if verification was unsuccessful.

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date when the provider directory information was last verified. Critical for CMS 90-day directory update mandate and No Surprises Act compliance.
attributes.references: CMS Directory Accuracy Requirements, 42 CFR 422.111, No Surprises Act

attributes.name: next_verification_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next directory verification must be completed. Supports compliance with CMS 90-day update mandate and quarterly verification tracking.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS. Used for provider identification in claims and directory searches.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the practice location. Ten-digit phone number displayed in member directory for appointment scheduling.

attributes.name: practice_location_name
attributes.description: Name of the practice location or facility where the provider sees patients. Displayed in member directory for location identification.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this directory record originated. Examples include ProviderSource, Cactus, or manual entry. Supports data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: specialty_primary
attributes.description: The primary medical specialty or taxonomy classification of the provider. Used for member search and filtering in the directory.

attributes.name: specialty_secondary
attributes.description: Additional specialty or sub-specialty of the provider. Supports multi-specialty provider directory searches.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: Two-letter state abbreviation of the practice location. Used for geographic filtering and state-level network adequacy compliance.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations, CMS Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: telehealth_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider offers telehealth or virtual visit services. Supports member search for remote care options.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason why the provider directory entry was terminated or inactivated. Examples include provider left network, practice closed, or data quality issue.

attributes.name: verified_fields
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of fields that were verified during the last verification event. Examples include address, phone, accepting_new_patients, specialty.

attributes.name: verifying_agent
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or system that performed the last verification. Used for audit trail and quality assurance.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Website address for the provider or practice location. Displayed in member directory for additional provider information.

attributes.name: zip_code
attributes.description: Five-digit or nine-digit ZIP code of the practice location. Used for proximity-based member searches and geographic access analysis.

products.name: network_directory_verification
products.description: Transactional record of a provider directory data verification event — capturing the verification method (outbound call, online attestation, EHR/HIE data match, claims-based inference), verification date, verified fields (address, phone, accepting-new-patients, specialty), verification outcome (confirmed, updated, unable to reach), and the agent or system that performed the verification. Supports CMS requirement for quarterly directory accuracy verification and tracks compliance with the 90-day directory update mandate.

attributes.name: network_directory_verification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider directory verification event. Primary key for the directory verification record.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or system user who performed the directory verification. Links to workforce or user management system. Nullable for automated system verifications.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the health plan associated with this directory verification, if verification is plan-specific. Nullable for network-wide verifications.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider whose directory information is being verified. Links to the provider master record in the provider domain.
attributes.references: Provider Management System - Cactus or ProviderSource

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the network in which the provider directory listing is being verified. Links to the network configuration record.

attributes.name: verification_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Directory Verification Vendor Audit tracks which external vendor performed verification for each provider directory entry.

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients_status
attributes.description: Current status of whether the provider is accepting new patients as verified during this event. Accepting indicates open to new patients, not accepting indicates closed panel, accepting existing only indicates existing patient family members only, waitlist indicates accepting with delay, unknown indicates status could not be determined.

attributes.name: accepting_new_patients_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider accepting new patients status was verified during this verification event. True if status was confirmed or updated, false if not verified or unable to verify. Critical for member access and network adequacy reporting.

attributes.name: accuracy_score
attributes.description: Calculated accuracy score for this verification event, expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Represents the proportion of verified fields that were accurate without requiring updates. Used for CMS directory accuracy reporting and network adequacy metrics.

attributes.name: address_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider practice address was verified during this verification event. True if address was confirmed or updated, false if not verified or unable to verify.

attributes.name: change_summary
attributes.description: Free-text summary of changes identified during verification. Describes what directory fields were updated and the nature of the changes. Nullable if no changes were identified.

attributes.name: changes_identified
attributes.description: Indicates whether any changes to directory information were identified during this verification event. True if updates were needed, false if all information was confirmed as accurate.

attributes.name: cms_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this verification event counts toward CMS directory accuracy reporting requirements. True if the verification meets CMS reporting criteria, false if excluded (e.g., duplicate verification within same quarter).

attributes.name: compliance_quarter
attributes.description: Calendar quarter for which this verification counts toward CMS quarterly verification compliance requirements. Format YYYY-Q# (e.g., 2024-Q1). Used for regulatory reporting and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: compliance_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which this verification counts toward annual directory accuracy compliance requirements. Used for regulatory reporting and multi-year trend analysis.

attributes.name: contact_attempt_count
attributes.description: Number of contact attempts made before achieving verification outcome. Tracks effort required to reach provider and supports operational efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this directory verification record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: directory_update_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the provider directory was updated based on verification findings. Nullable if no directory update was required. Used to track compliance with CMS 90-day update requirement.

attributes.name: directory_updated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider directory was updated as a result of this verification. True if changes were applied to the directory, false if no updates were made. Tracks compliance with 90-day directory update mandate.

attributes.name: first_contact_attempt_date
attributes.description: Date of the first contact attempt for this verification cycle. Used to measure time-to-verification and operational efficiency.

attributes.name: last_contact_attempt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent contact attempt for this verification cycle. Used to track verification completion timeline.

attributes.name: next_verification_due_date
attributes.description: Calculated date by which the next directory verification must be completed to maintain CMS quarterly verification compliance. Typically 90 days from current verification date.

attributes.name: npi_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider National Provider Identifier was verified during this verification event. True if NPI was confirmed, false if not verified. NPI is the unique provider identifier required by HIPAA.
attributes.references: HIPAA National Provider Identifier Standard - 45 CFR 162.410

attributes.name: phone_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider phone number was verified during this verification event. True if phone was confirmed or updated, false if not verified or unable to verify.

attributes.name: prior_verification_date
attributes.description: Date of the previous directory verification for this provider in this network. Used to track compliance with quarterly verification frequency requirements.

attributes.name: provider_response_time_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours between initial contact attempt and provider response. Used to measure provider engagement and operational efficiency. Nullable if provider did not respond.

attributes.name: specialty_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider specialty information was verified during this verification event. True if specialty was confirmed or updated, false if not verified or unable to verify.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that last modified this directory verification record. Audit field for accountability and change tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this directory verification record was last modified. Audit field for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: verification_agent_name
attributes.description: Name of the person or system that performed the directory verification. For manual verifications, this is the employee name; for automated verifications, this is the system name.

attributes.name: verification_channel
attributes.description: Communication channel used to conduct the verification. Phone indicates telephone call, email indicates electronic mail, portal indicates provider self-service portal, mail indicates postal mail, fax indicates facsimile, in person indicates face-to-face verification, automated indicates system-to-system verification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: phone|email|portal|mail|fax|in_person|automated — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the directory verification was performed. Used to track compliance with CMS quarterly verification requirements and 90-day directory update mandate.

attributes.name: verification_language
attributes.description: Language used to conduct the verification interaction. Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code (e.g., ENG for English, SPA for Spanish). Supports cultural competency tracking and language access compliance.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify provider directory information. Outbound call indicates phone verification, online attestation indicates provider portal self-service, EHR/HIE match indicates electronic health record data validation, claims inference indicates verification based on recent claims activity, mail survey indicates postal verification, email confirmation indicates electronic mail verification.

attributes.name: verification_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes captured during the verification process. Includes details about contact interactions, provider responses, issues encountered, or additional context relevant to the verification outcome.

attributes.name: verification_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the directory verification event. Human-readable unique reference number used for tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: verification_source_document
attributes.description: Reference to the source document or evidence supporting the verification. Examples include call recording ID, attestation form ID, EHR data extract reference, claims report ID. Supports audit trail and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the directory verification attempt. Confirmed indicates all information validated as accurate, updated indicates changes were made, unable to reach indicates contact attempt failed, provider declined indicates provider refused verification, invalid contact indicates contact information is incorrect, pending response indicates awaiting provider response.

attributes.name: verification_system
attributes.description: Name of the system or platform used to perform the verification. Examples include provider portal, call center system, automated verification engine, EHR integration platform, claims analytics system.
attributes.references: Provider Management System - Cactus or ProviderSource

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the directory verification event occurred. Provides audit trail for compliance reporting and operational tracking.

attributes.name: verified_fields
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specific directory fields that were verified during this event. Examples include address, phone, accepting_new_patients, specialty, office_hours, languages_spoken, accessibility_features. Tracks granular verification coverage.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that created this directory verification record. Audit field for accountability and compliance tracking.

products.name: vbc_arrangement
products.description: Master entity representing Value-Based Care (VBC) programs and their participation arrangements — covering both program design (program type, sponsoring entity, quality measure set, risk model, benchmark methodology) and specific ACO/VBC participation instances (ACO name, CMS ACO ID, arrangement dates, shared savings/risk terms, participating provider groups). Supports MSSP, Next Gen, REACH, commercial P4P, episode-based payment, and capitation models. Records may represent a program definition (template) or a specific arrangement instance (participation record), distinguished by record type. Owned by the network domain as the structural participation record — financial settlement terms are owned by the contract domain.
products.reference: CMS ACO — Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP)

attributes.name: vbc_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for vbc_arrangement

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Tracks VBC shared‑savings and risk‑adjustment costs against a specific cost center for financial consolidation.

attributes.name: vbc_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.vbc_program. Business justification: A VBC arrangement implements a defined VBC program; adding vbc_program_id FK ties arrangement to its program definition.

attributes.name: arrangement_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the VBC arrangement or ACO program (e.g., 'Metro Health ACO MSSP Track 1', 'Regional P4P Quality Incentive Program').

attributes.name: arrangement_number
attributes.description: Business identifier or contract number assigned to this VBC arrangement. Externally-known reference used in communications with providers and CMS.

attributes.name: arrangement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the VBC arrangement. Tracks progression from draft through active participation to termination or completion.

attributes.name: arrangement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the VBC arrangement model. Distinguishes between Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) tracks, Next Generation ACO, Realizing Equity Access and Community Health (REACH) ACO, commercial pay-for-performance (P4P), episode-based payment, capitation, bundled payment, or other VBC models. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mssp_track_1|mssp_track_2|mssp_track_3|next_gen_aco|reach_aco|commercial_p4p|episode_based_payment|capitation|bundled_payment|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Innovation Center VBC Model Taxonomy

attributes.name: attributed_member_count
attributes.description: Number of health plan members or Medicare beneficiaries attributed to this ACO or VBC arrangement for the performance period. Used for PMPM calculations and risk adjustment.

attributes.name: attribution_methodology
attributes.description: Method used to assign members to the ACO or provider group. Prospective assigns at year start; retrospective assigns at year end based on utilization; voluntary alignment allows member choice; claims-based uses historical claims patterns.

attributes.name: benchmark_amount
attributes.description: Target cost or quality benchmark value established for the performance period. Expressed in dollars for cost benchmarks or as a quality score for quality benchmarks.

attributes.name: benchmark_methodology
attributes.description: Method used to establish the cost or quality benchmark against which performance is measured. Options include historical baseline (prior year costs), regional average, national trend, risk-adjusted PMPM, or episode target price.

attributes.name: care_coordination_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the VBC arrangement requires formal care coordination programs (care management, transitional care, chronic disease management). True if required; False if optional or not applicable.

attributes.name: cms_aco_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) ACO ID
attributes.description: CMS-assigned identifier for Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) or other federally-recognized ACO arrangements. Null for commercial VBC programs.

attributes.name: cms_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this arrangement requires formal reporting to Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS). True for all Medicare ACOs; False for commercial-only VBC programs.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VBC arrangement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_sharing_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal data sharing agreement exists between the health plan and the ACO or provider group for claims, clinical, and quality data exchange. True if agreement is in place; False otherwise.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the VBC arrangement ends or is scheduled to end. Null for open-ended arrangements. Aligns with CMS performance year end for Medicare ACOs.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the VBC arrangement becomes active and performance measurement begins. Aligns with CMS performance year start for Medicare ACOs.

attributes.name: health_it_certification_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Information Technology (IT) Certification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether participating providers must use certified Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and meet health IT standards. True if required; False if not required.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VBC arrangement record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: minimum_loss_rate
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of cost overruns before shared losses are assessed. Provides a buffer zone for two-sided risk arrangements.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Minimum Loss Rate Standards

attributes.name: minimum_savings_rate
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of cost savings required before shared savings are paid. Acts as a threshold to ensure savings are statistically significant.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Minimum Savings Rate Standards

attributes.name: participating_aco_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the Accountable Care Organization or provider group participating in this VBC arrangement. Null for program template records.

attributes.name: participating_provider_count
attributes.description: Number of individual providers (physicians, specialists, facilities) participating in this ACO or VBC arrangement. Used for network adequacy and capacity planning.

attributes.name: participating_tin
attributes.description: Tax Identification Number of the participating ACO or provider organization. Used for financial settlement and IRS reporting.

attributes.name: performance_guarantee_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of financial guarantee or bond required from the ACO or provider group to participate in two-sided risk arrangements. Ensures ability to repay shared losses.

attributes.name: performance_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which performance is measured and financial reconciliation is calculated. Aligns with CMS performance year for Medicare ACOs.

attributes.name: primary_care_physician_count
attributes.description: Number of primary care physicians participating in this ACO or VBC arrangement. Critical for attribution and care coordination requirements.

attributes.name: quality_measure_set
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the quality measure set used to evaluate clinical performance (e.g., 'CMS ACO Quality Measures', 'HEDIS Comprehensive', 'Custom Commercial P4P Measures').
attributes.references: CMS ACO Quality Reporting Standards, NCQA HEDIS

attributes.name: quality_performance_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum quality performance score required to earn shared savings or avoid penalties. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 70.00 for 70th percentile).

attributes.name: reconciliation_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which financial performance is reconciled and shared savings or losses are calculated and settled. Most Medicare ACOs reconcile annually; commercial arrangements may reconcile more frequently.

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Distinguishes whether this record represents a program definition template (reusable VBC program design) or a specific participation instance (actual arrangement with a provider group or ACO).

attributes.name: risk_model
attributes.description: Financial risk-sharing model of the arrangement. One-sided risk allows shared savings only; two-sided risk includes shared savings and losses; upside-only is gain-sharing; downside risk is penalty-only; full capitation transfers all risk.

attributes.name: service_area_description
attributes.description: Geographic description of the service area covered by this VBC arrangement (e.g., 'Statewide California', 'Metro Atlanta Region', 'National Medicare Population').

attributes.name: shared_loss_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of cost overruns above benchmark that the ACO or provider group is responsible for under two-sided risk models. Null for one-sided risk arrangements.

attributes.name: shared_savings_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of cost savings below benchmark that the ACO or provider group earns as shared savings. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 50.00 for 50%).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this VBC arrangement record originated (e.g., 'Cactus Provider Management', 'Custom VBC Platform', 'CMS ACO Portal').

attributes.name: specialist_physician_count
attributes.description: Number of specialist physicians participating in this ACO or VBC arrangement. Used for network adequacy and specialty care access analysis.

attributes.name: sponsoring_entity_name
attributes.description: Name of the organization sponsoring or administering the VBC program (e.g., health plan name, CMS for federal programs, employer group for commercial arrangements).

attributes.name: stop_loss_limit
attributes.description: Maximum financial loss amount the ACO or provider group is responsible for under two-sided risk arrangements. Provides downside risk protection. Null for one-sided risk or full capitation models.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date the VBC arrangement was terminated or withdrawn. Null for active or completed arrangements. Distinct from effective_end_date which is the scheduled end.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for early termination of the VBC arrangement (e.g., 'Poor Financial Performance', 'Provider Withdrawal', 'Regulatory Non-Compliance', 'Mutual Agreement'). Null for arrangements that completed their term.

products.name: aco_provider
products.description: Association entity linking individual providers (by NPI) or provider groups (by TIN) to an ACO arrangement, capturing participation role (primary care, specialist, facility), effective dates, attribution methodology (prospective, retrospective), panel size, and active status. Enables attribution of members to ACO providers for shared savings calculations and quality reporting. Distinct from network_provider (which tracks network participation) — this tracks ACO-specific participation roles.
products.reference: ACO Provider Participation — CMS MSSP TIN/NPI Roster

attributes.name: aco_provider_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ACO provider association record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Assigns ACO provider‑related expenses and shared‑savings allocations to a cost center for proper accounting.

attributes.name: service_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary service location or facility where this provider delivers care under the ACO arrangement. Used for geographic attribution and network adequacy.

attributes.name: vbc_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent ACO arrangement that this provider participates in. Links to the ACO contract or arrangement entity.

attributes.name: attributed_member_count
attributes.description: The number of members currently attributed to this provider for ACO performance measurement and shared savings calculations.

attributes.name: attribution_methodology
attributes.description: The method used to assign members to this provider for ACO performance measurement and shared savings calculations.

attributes.name: care_coordination_tier
attributes.description: The tier level assigned to this provider for care coordination responsibilities and support services within the ACO. Higher tiers indicate greater care management obligations.

attributes.name: cost_efficiency_score
attributes.description: The cost efficiency or resource utilization score for this provider within the ACO arrangement. Used for shared savings calculations. Expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ACO provider participation record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: The credentialing status of this provider for ACO participation. Providers must maintain active credentialing to remain eligible for attribution and shared savings.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this provider's participation in the ACO arrangement becomes active and member attribution begins.

attributes.name: ehr_integration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider's EHR system is integrated with the ACO's health information exchange for care coordination and quality reporting. True if integrated.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date when the provider formally enrolled or was onboarded into the ACO arrangement. May differ from effective_date if there is a waiting period.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal comments, special instructions, or contextual information about this provider's ACO participation. Not shared externally.

attributes.name: last_credentialing_date
attributes.description: The date when the provider's credentials were last verified for ACO participation. Used to track recredentialing cycles.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system identifier of the person or process that most recently modified this ACO provider participation record. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ACO provider participation record was most recently modified. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: next_credentialing_date
attributes.description: The date when the provider's credentials are due for renewal or recredentialing for continued ACO participation.

attributes.name: panel_size_limit
attributes.description: The maximum number of members that can be attributed to this provider under the ACO arrangement. Null if no limit is defined.

attributes.name: participation_role
attributes.description: The functional role this provider plays within the ACO structure. Determines attribution rules and quality measure accountability.

attributes.name: participation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the provider's participation in the ACO arrangement. Determines whether the provider is eligible for attribution and shared savings.

attributes.name: participation_type
attributes.description: The level of financial risk and participation commitment for this provider within the ACO arrangement.

attributes.name: performance_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this provider participation record applies. Used for year-over-year performance tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: primary_care_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider serves as a primary care physician (PCP) for attribution purposes within the ACO. True if the provider is eligible to be an attribution anchor.

attributes.name: provider_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier for the individual provider participating in the ACO. Used when the participant is an individual practitioner.

attributes.name: provider_tin
attributes.description: The 9-digit Tax Identification Number for the provider group or organization participating in the ACO. Used when the participant is a group practice or facility.

attributes.name: quality_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider is required to submit quality measure data as part of ACO performance reporting. True if the provider must report HEDIS or CMS Star measures.

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: The composite quality performance score for this provider within the ACO arrangement. Used for performance-based incentive calculations. Expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00).

attributes.name: risk_sharing_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of financial risk (upside and downside) that this provider assumes under the ACO arrangement. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 25.00 for 25%).

attributes.name: shared_savings_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this provider is eligible to receive shared savings distributions based on ACO performance. True if the provider participates in financial upside.

attributes.name: specialty_code
attributes.description: The primary specialty or taxonomy code for this provider within the ACO context. Used for role-based performance measurement and network adequacy assessment.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when this provider's participation in the ACO arrangement ends. Null if participation is ongoing.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: The reason code indicating why the provider's participation in the ACO was terminated. Null if participation is active or pending.

attributes.name: vbc_track
attributes.description: The specific CMS MSSP track or value-based care program track that this provider participates in under the ACO arrangement. Determines risk level and savings methodology.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) Tracks

attributes.name: created_by

products.name: exception
products.description: Transactional record of a network adequacy exception or access plan filed with a regulator when a network cannot meet standard adequacy thresholds in a specific geographic area or specialty. Captures exception type (time-distance waiver, rural exception, access plan), affected network, specialty, geographic area, regulatory body (CMS, state DOI), filing date, approval status, approved exception terms, and expiration date. Supports CMS HPMS exception filings and state DOI access plan submissions.

attributes.name: exception_id

attributes.name: case_id

products.name: change_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing all material changes to provider network composition — provider additions, terminations (voluntary, for-cause, contract non-renewal, credentialing revocation), tier reassignments, panel status changes, and service area modifications. For terminations, captures termination type, continuity-of-care obligation period, termination reason code, member transition planning, notice date, and member notification status. For all change types, records change type, effective date, impacted provider NPI, change reason, member impact count, and regulatory reporting status. Supports CMS 30-day member notification requirements, state DOI network change and termination notification filings, continuity-of-care compliance under the No Surprises Act, and network stability monitoring. This is the SSOT for all network composition changes including terminations — replaces the need for a separate termination entity.
