products.name: access_standard
products.description: Reference entity defining appointment access and availability standards for the network — capturing standard type (routine, urgent, preventive, behavioral health), specialty category, maximum wait time in days, after-hours availability requirement, telehealth equivalency flag, and the regulatory or accreditation source (NCQA, URAC, state DOI, CMS). Distinct from adequacy_standard (which governs time-distance and provider-to-member ratios) — access_standard governs appointment availability and wait time compliance.
products.reference: NCQA Access and Availability Standards — HEDIS Access Measures

attributes.name: access_standard_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the access standard record. Primary key.

attributes.name: superseded_by_standard_access_standard_id
attributes.description: Reference to the access_standard_id of the newer standard that replaces this one, if status is superseded. Enables version tracking and historical compliance analysis.

attributes.name: access_standard_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the access standard: active (in force and monitored), inactive (no longer enforced), draft (under development), pending_approval (awaiting regulatory or executive approval), superseded (replaced by a newer version).

attributes.name: after_hours_availability_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether providers must offer after-hours (evening, weekend, or holiday) appointment availability to meet this access standard. True for urgent care, behavioral health crisis, and certain primary care standards; false for routine specialty care.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Access and Availability Standards, CMS Medicare Advantage Network Adequacy

attributes.name: appointment_type_scope
attributes.description: Defines whether this access standard applies to new patient appointments, established patient follow-ups, specialist consultations, or all appointment types. New patient access is typically more stringent than follow-up access.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Access and Availability Standards

attributes.name: compliance_measurement_method
attributes.description: The method used to measure and audit compliance with this access standard: appointment_log_audit (review of provider scheduling systems), member_survey (CAHPS or custom surveys), secret_shopper (test calls to provider offices), provider_attestation (self-reported compliance), claims_analysis (time between referral and service date in claims data).
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications, CMS CAHPS Survey Protocols, State DOI Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this access standard record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this access standard becomes enforceable. Aligns with regulatory effective dates, contract year start, or accreditation cycle.
attributes.references: CMS Regulatory Effective Dates, NCQA Accreditation Cycle, State DOI Rule Adoption Dates

attributes.name: exception_criteria
attributes.description: Conditions under which this access standard may be waived or modified (e.g., rural service area with documented provider shortage, member preference for delayed appointment, specialist unavailability due to leave). Used for compliance reporting and grievance resolution.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Exception Process, State DOI Rural Health Exemptions

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, implementation guidance, or context for network management and compliance teams. Not disclosed to members or regulators.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: The user ID or system account that last modified this access standard record.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this access standard record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: line_of_business_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of lines of business to which this access standard applies (e.g., Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Exchange/QHP). Some standards are federally mandated for Medicare/Medicaid; others are state-specific or voluntary for commercial plans.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Medicaid Managed Care Regulations, State DOI Commercial Market Rules, ACA QHP Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: maximum_wait_time_days
attributes.description: The maximum number of calendar days allowed between the member's request for an appointment and the scheduled appointment date. For urgent care, this is typically 1-2 days; for routine care, 7-30 days depending on specialty and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Access and Availability Standards, State DOI Network Adequacy Rules, CMS Medicare Advantage and Medicaid Managed Care Access Standards

attributes.name: maximum_wait_time_hours
attributes.description: For emergent or crisis access standards, the maximum number of hours allowed for appointment availability (e.g., behavioral health crisis must be seen within 6 hours). Null for standards measured in days.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Behavioral Health Access Standards, State Mental Health Parity Requirements

attributes.name: member_age_group
attributes.description: The member age cohort to which this access standard applies: pediatric (under 18), adult (18-64), geriatric (65+), or all. Pediatric and geriatric populations often have stricter access requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage and Medicaid Managed Care Access Standards, NCQA HEDIS Age Stratification

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: How often compliance with this access standard is measured and reported: monthly (for high-risk or CMS-mandated standards), quarterly (typical for HEDIS and accreditation), semi_annual, annual (for internal benchmarks), or continuous (real-time monitoring via appointment systems).
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Reporting Schedule, CMS Quality Reporting Timelines, State DOI Annual Filing Requirements

attributes.name: network_adequacy_credit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether meeting this access standard contributes to network adequacy compliance calculations for regulatory filings. True for standards tied to CMS or state DOI network adequacy requirements; false for internal quality benchmarks.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Requirements 42 CFR 438.68, State DOI Network Adequacy Filing Requirements

attributes.name: penalty_for_noncompliance
attributes.description: Description of the consequences for failing to meet this access standard: regulatory sanctions, accreditation downgrade, member grievance escalation, provider contract breach, financial penalties, or corrective action plan requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Compliance and Enforcement, NCQA Accreditation Standards, State DOI Market Conduct Rules

attributes.name: regulatory_citation

attributes.name: regulatory_source

attributes.name: specialty_category

attributes.name: standard_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the access standard, used for external reference and reporting (e.g., ROUTINE_PCP, URGENT_SPEC, BH_CRISIS).

attributes.name: standard_name

attributes.name: standard_type
attributes.description: Classification of the access standard by care urgency and category: routine (non-urgent scheduled care), urgent (same-day or next-day need), emergent (immediate life-threatening), preventive (wellness and screening), behavioral_health (mental health and substance use), specialty (specialist consultation).

products.name: filing
products.description: Transactional record of a regulatory network filing submitted to CMS, state DOI, or other governing body — including network adequacy filings, service area filings, provider directory submissions, access plan filings, and adequacy exception/waiver requests. Captures filing type, regulatory body, submission date, filing period, submission method (HPMS, state portal), filing status (submitted, accepted, deficiency issued, approved), deficiency description, response due date, and exception-specific attributes (exception type, affected specialty/geography, approved terms, expiration date). Serves as the compliance audit trail for all network-related regulatory submissions.
products.reference: CMS HPMS Network Adequacy Filing — State DOI Network Submission

attributes.name: filing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory network filing record.

attributes.name: compliance_regulatory_obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Regulatory filing must reference the specific regulatory obligation it satisfies, required for CMS network adequacy reporting.

attributes.name: plan_benefit_package_id
attributes.description: CMS Plan Benefit Package identifier for Medicare Advantage plans, or equivalent plan identifier for other lines of business.
attributes.references: CMS PBP Standards, HIOS Plan ID Standards

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider network that is the subject of this regulatory filing.

attributes.name: adequacy_standard_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the network meets the applicable time-and-distance or provider-to-member ratio adequacy standards for the filing period.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards 42 CFR 422.116, State DOI Adequacy Requirements

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory body officially approved the network filing.
attributes.references: CMS Approval Notifications, State DOI Approval Letters

attributes.name: approval_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the regulatory body upon approval of the filing.
attributes.references: CMS Approval Tracking, State DOI Approval Registry

attributes.name: attestation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the authorized representative signed the network adequacy attestation.
attributes.references: CMS Attestation Process, State DOI Certification Requirements

attributes.name: attestation_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the health plan provided a formal attestation of network adequacy compliance as part of the filing.
attributes.references: CMS Attestation Requirements, State DOI Certification Standards

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: CMS-assigned contract identifier for Medicare Advantage or Part D plans, or state-assigned contract identifier for Medicaid or commercial plans.
attributes.references: CMS Contract Numbering Standards, State DOI Contract Registration

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this filing record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deficiency_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the deficiencies identified by the regulatory body and the corrective actions required.
attributes.references: CMS Deficiency Notices, State DOI Review Findings

attributes.name: deficiency_issued_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory body issued the deficiency notice to the health plan.
attributes.references: CMS Deficiency Timeline, State DOI Review Process

attributes.name: deficiency_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the regulatory body issued a deficiency notice requiring additional information or corrections to the filing.
attributes.references: CMS Deficiency Process, State DOI Review Standards

attributes.name: exception_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory body approved the adequacy exception or waiver.
attributes.references: CMS Approval Notifications, State DOI Decision Letters

attributes.name: exception_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicator of whether the regulatory body approved the adequacy exception or waiver request.
attributes.references: CMS Approval Process, State DOI Decision Standards

attributes.name: exception_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the approved adequacy exception or waiver expires and must be renewed or resolved.
attributes.references: CMS Exception Term Limits, State DOI Waiver Duration Standards

attributes.name: exception_geography
attributes.description: Geographic area (county, ZIP code, or service area) for which an adequacy exception or waiver applies.
attributes.references: CMS Service Area Standards, FIPS County Codes

attributes.name: exception_justification
attributes.description: Detailed business rationale and supporting evidence for the adequacy exception or waiver request.
attributes.references: CMS Exception Documentation Requirements, State DOI Waiver Guidelines

attributes.name: exception_specialty
attributes.description: Provider specialty or service category for which an adequacy exception or waiver is being requested.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Taxonomy, AMA Specialty Codes

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Category of network adequacy exception or waiver being requested, such as specialty shortage, geographic barrier, or low utilization.
attributes.references: CMS Exception and Waiver Guidelines, State DOI Exception Processes

attributes.name: filing_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier assigned by the regulatory body or internal tracking system for this filing submission.
attributes.references: CMS HPMS Filing Standards, State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current state of the filing in the regulatory review and approval workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|deficiency_issued|resubmitted|approved|rejected|withdrawn — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Filing Review Process, State DOI Approval Workflows

attributes.name: filing_type
attributes.description: Category of regulatory filing submission indicating the nature of the network-related compliance requirement being addressed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: network_adequacy|service_area|provider_directory|access_plan|adequacy_exception|adequacy_waiver|network_certification|network_amendment — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, NAIC Model Laws, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this filing record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Product line or market segment to which this network filing applies, such as Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, or commercial insurance.
attributes.references: CMS LOB Definitions, NAIC Market Segment Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Internal notes and comments regarding the filing submission, review process, or follow-up actions.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: Ending date of the coverage period or plan year for which this filing applies.
attributes.references: CMS Plan Year Standards, ACA Coverage Period Requirements

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: Beginning date of the coverage period or plan year for which this filing applies.
attributes.references: CMS Plan Year Standards, ACA Coverage Period Requirements

attributes.name: plan_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which the network configuration and adequacy filing is applicable.
attributes.references: CMS Plan Year Standards, ACA Annual Enrollment Periods

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Governing authority to which this filing is submitted for review and approval.
attributes.references: CMS, State Departments of Insurance, NAIC, HHS, NCQA

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: State or federal jurisdiction under which this filing is governed, typically a two-letter state code or FEDERAL for CMS submissions.
attributes.references: State DOI Jurisdictions, CMS Federal Oversight

attributes.name: rejection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory body officially rejected the network filing.
attributes.references: CMS Rejection Process, State DOI Denial Notifications

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation provided by the regulatory body for the rejection of the filing.
attributes.references: CMS Rejection Criteria, State DOI Denial Standards

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the health plan must submit a response or corrected filing to address the deficiency.
attributes.references: CMS Response Deadlines, State DOI Cure Period Standards

attributes.name: response_submitted_date
attributes.description: Date on which the health plan submitted its response or corrected filing to address the deficiency.
attributes.references: CMS Resubmission Process, State DOI Cure Submission

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body representative assigned to review this filing.
attributes.references: CMS Reviewer Assignment, State DOI Review Team

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the filing was officially submitted to the regulatory body.
attributes.references: CMS HPMS Submission Deadlines, State DOI Filing Calendars

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: Channel or system through which the filing was submitted to the regulatory authority.
attributes.references: CMS HPMS System, NAIC SERFF System, State DOI Portals

attributes.name: submitted_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or department responsible for submitting the filing to the regulatory body.

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the health plan voluntarily withdrew the filing from regulatory review.
attributes.references: CMS Withdrawal Process, State DOI Withdrawal Procedures

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason

products.name: vbc_program
products.description: Master entity representing a Value-Based Care (VBC) program design — the template or program structure under which ACO arrangements, pay-for-performance contracts, and shared savings models are organized. Captures program name, program type (MSSP, REACH, commercial P4P, episode-based payment, capitation), sponsoring entity (CMS, state Medicaid, commercial), program year, quality measure set, risk model (upside-only, two-sided), and benchmark methodology. Distinct from aco_arrangement (which is a specific participation instance) — vbc_program is the program definition.
products.reference: CMS Innovation Center VBC Programs — CMMI

attributes.name: vbc_program_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the value-based care program. Primary key.

attributes.name: attribution_methodology
attributes.description: The method used to assign members or patients to providers or ACOs for performance measurement and accountability.

attributes.name: benchmark_methodology
attributes.description: The method used to calculate the cost or quality benchmark against which performance is measured. PMPM = Per Member Per Month.

attributes.name: benchmark_year
attributes.description: The base year or period used to establish the performance benchmark for this program.

attributes.name: care_coordination_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether participating providers must implement formal care coordination programs as a condition of participation.

attributes.name: cms_program_identifier
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Program Identifier
attributes.description: The official CMS-assigned identifier for this VBC program, used for regulatory reporting and tracking. CMS = Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for inquiries and communications regarding this VBC program.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this VBC program record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date when this VBC program design becomes active and available for provider participation.

attributes.name: eligible_provider_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of provider types eligible to participate in this VBC program (e.g., PCP, Specialist, Hospital, SNF). PCP = Primary Care Provider, SNF = Skilled Nursing Facility.

attributes.name: health_it_requirement
attributes.description: Description of health IT capabilities required for participation (e.g., EHR certification, HIE connectivity, data reporting). EHR = Electronic Health Record, HIE = Health Information Exchange.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal operational notes, special considerations, or program-specific guidance.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this record.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this VBC program record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The insurance product line or market segment to which this VBC program applies. LOB = Line of Business.

attributes.name: minimum_loss_rate
attributes.description: The minimum percentage loss threshold that must be exceeded before shared losses are assessed. MLR = Minimum Loss Rate. Distinct from Medical Loss Ratio.

attributes.name: minimum_member_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum number of attributed members required for a provider or ACO to participate in or qualify for this VBC program.

attributes.name: minimum_savings_rate
attributes.description: The minimum percentage savings threshold that must be achieved before shared savings are paid. MSR = Minimum Savings Rate.

attributes.name: performance_period_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the performance measurement period for this VBC program ends.

attributes.name: performance_period_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the performance measurement period for this VBC program begins.

attributes.name: program_category
attributes.description: Broad category of value-based arrangement that this program represents. ACO = Accountable Care Organization.
attributes.value_regex: ACO|Bundled Payment|Shared Savings|Pay for Performance|Capitation|Population Health

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the VBC program used across systems and external reporting.

attributes.name: program_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the VBC program objectives, structure, and key features.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the value-based care program.

attributes.name: program_owner
attributes.description: The internal business unit or department responsible for managing and administering this VBC program.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the VBC program.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the VBC program model. MSSP = Medicare Shared Savings Program, REACH = Realizing Equity Access and Community Health, NextGen = Next Generation ACO, P4P = Pay for Performance.

attributes.name: program_url
attributes.description: Web address for the program information page, provider portal, or documentation site.

attributes.name: program_year
attributes.description: The calendar or performance year for which this VBC program design is configured.

attributes.name: quality_measure_set
attributes.description: The standardized set of quality measures used to evaluate performance (e.g., HEDIS, STAR, CMS Quality Measures). HEDIS = Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set.

attributes.name: quality_performance_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum quality score threshold required to qualify for shared savings or incentive payments, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the regulatory filing or approval associated with this VBC program.

attributes.name: risk_model
attributes.description: The financial risk arrangement structure. Upside Only = shared savings only, Two-Sided = shared savings and losses, Downside Only = shared losses only.

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: How often financial reconciliation and shared savings/loss settlements are calculated and paid.

attributes.name: shared_loss_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of losses above benchmark that is shared with participating providers, expressed as a percentage. Null for upside-only models.

attributes.name: shared_savings_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of savings below benchmark that is shared with participating providers, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 50.00 for 50%).

attributes.name: sponsoring_entity
attributes.description: The organization or regulatory body that sponsors and governs this VBC program. CMS = Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when this VBC program design is terminated or discontinued. Null for active programs.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this record.

products.name: network_recruitment
products.description: Transactional record tracking provider recruitment activities to address network adequacy gaps or strategic expansion. Captures target provider NPI/TIN, target specialty, target geographic area, recruitment reason (adequacy gap closure, strategic expansion, member request, competitor response), outreach date, outreach method, recruiter assigned, provider response, contracting referral date, and disposition (contracted, declined, no response). Links to adequacy assessment gap findings for remediation tracking. Supports network development pipeline management and regulatory gap closure evidence.

attributes.name: network_recruitment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider recruitment activity record.

attributes.name: adequacy_assessment_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this recruitment activity to a specific network adequacy gap assessment finding that triggered the recruitment need.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the provider contract that resulted from successful recruitment, if applicable.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Records recruitment expenses for network provider outreach against a cost center for budgeting and expense tracking.

attributes.name: primary_network_cms_filing_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Filing ID
attributes.description: The CMS filing identifier associated with the network adequacy gap that this recruitment addresses, if applicable.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the provider network for which recruitment is being conducted.

attributes.name: recruiter_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the recruiter assigned to manage this recruitment activity.

attributes.name: risk_pool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.pool. Business justification: Provider recruitment decisions use risk pool characteristics to prioritize filling gaps for high‑risk member segments, supporting network adequacy.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Provider Recruitment Vendor Management links recruitment activities to external recruiting vendors for reporting and cost allocation.

attributes.name: adequacy_gap_type
attributes.description: The specific type of network adequacy gap this recruitment is intended to address, if applicable.

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: The effective date of the provider contract resulting from this recruitment, if successfully contracted.

attributes.name: contracting_referral_date
attributes.description: The date when the recruitment activity was referred to the contracting team for formal contract negotiation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recruitment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: disposition
attributes.description: The final outcome or current status of the recruitment activity.

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: The date when the recruitment activity reached its final disposition.

attributes.name: disposition_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation or reason code for the final disposition outcome (e.g., rate disagreement, geographic mismatch, credentialing issues).

attributes.name: estimated_annual_claims_volume
attributes.description: Projected annual claims volume in dollars expected from this provider if successfully recruited.

attributes.name: estimated_member_impact
attributes.description: Estimated number of members who would benefit from adding this provider to the network.

attributes.name: follow_up_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for follow-up contact with the provider.

attributes.name: lob
attributes.description: The line of business for which this provider recruitment is being conducted.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, conversation details, or special considerations related to the recruitment activity.

attributes.name: outreach_date
attributes.description: The date when initial outreach was made to the target provider.

attributes.name: outreach_method
attributes.description: The communication channel or method used for initial provider outreach.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: The urgency or priority assigned to this recruitment activity based on business need and regulatory risk.

attributes.name: provider_response
attributes.description: The initial response received from the target provider following outreach.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: The primary business reason driving this recruitment activity.

attributes.name: recruiter_assigned
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the network development recruiter assigned to this recruitment activity.

attributes.name: recruitment_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the recruitment activity, typically formatted as REC-YYYYMMDD or similar convention.

attributes.name: recruitment_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the recruitment activity in the pipeline.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether successful recruitment of this provider requires a regulatory filing or network adequacy update with state or federal authorities.

attributes.name: response_date
attributes.description: The date when the provider responded to the recruitment outreach.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this recruitment data originated (e.g., Provider Management System, CRM).

attributes.name: target_county_fips
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code
attributes.description: The 5-digit FIPS code identifying the target county for recruitment.

attributes.name: target_geographic_area
attributes.description: The geographic area or service area where the provider is needed, typically defined by county, ZIP code, or Metropolitan Statistical Area (MSA).

attributes.name: target_provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the provider or provider organization being recruited.

attributes.name: target_provider_npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the specific provider being recruited, if known at outreach time.

attributes.name: target_provider_tin
attributes.description: The 9-digit Tax Identification Number (TIN) of the provider organization or practice being recruited.

attributes.name: target_specialty
attributes.description: The medical specialty or provider type being recruited to address network adequacy gaps (e.g., Cardiology, Primary Care, Pediatrics).

attributes.name: target_zip_code
attributes.description: The 5-digit ZIP code identifying the target geographic area for recruitment.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that last updated this recruitment record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this recruitment record was last modified.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User identifier or system account that created this recruitment record.

products.name: termination
products.description: Transactional record capturing the formal termination of a provider from a network — including voluntary and involuntary terminations. Records termination type (voluntary, for-cause, contract non-renewal, credentialing revocation), effective date, notice date, termination reason code, member impact count, continuity-of-care obligation period, member notification status, and regulatory reporting status. Supports CMS and state DOI termination notification requirements and continuity-of-care compliance under the No Surprises Act.
products.reference: Provider Termination — No Surprises Act / 42 CFR 422.111

attributes.name: termination_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the provider network termination record. Primary key for the termination entity.

attributes.name: case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to appeal.appeal_case. Business justification: Termination Appeal Process allows providers or members to appeal a termination; the termination record must reference the related appeal case.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.provider_contract. Business justification: Termination of network participation is tied to the underlying provider contract; needed for settlement and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Allocates termination settlement and related financial impacts to a cost center for accurate financial statements.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Party that initiated the termination: provider (voluntary), health plan (involuntary), mutual (both parties agreed), or regulatory authority (mandated by state DOI or CMS).

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider being terminated from the network.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider network from which the provider is being terminated.

attributes.name: active_treatment_count
attributes.description: Number of members currently in active treatment episodes (e.g., ongoing therapy, pregnancy, post-surgical care) with the terminated provider. These members may be eligible for extended continuity-of-care benefits.

attributes.name: appeal_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the provider appeal: upheld (termination stands), overturned (termination reversed), modified (terms changed), withdrawn (provider withdrew appeal), or pending (not yet resolved).

attributes.name: appeal_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which any provider appeal or grievance was resolved. Null if no appeal was filed or if appeal is still pending.

attributes.name: appeals_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider filed an appeal or grievance contesting the termination. True = appeal filed; False = no appeal filed.

attributes.name: claims_runout_end_date
attributes.description: Final date through which claims for pre-termination services will be accepted at in-network rates. Calculated as termination effective date plus claims runout period days.

attributes.name: claims_runout_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after termination effective date during which claims for services rendered prior to termination will be accepted and processed at in-network rates. Typically 90-180 days per contract terms.
attributes.references: Claims Processing Standards, Network Contract Terms

attributes.name: continuity_of_care_end_date
attributes.description: Date through which existing patients may continue to receive in-network benefits from the terminated provider under continuity-of-care provisions. Required under No Surprises Act and state regulations.
attributes.references: No Surprises Act, State DOI Continuity of Care Requirements

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Final date of the underlying provider contract. May differ from termination effective date if contract allows for early termination or extension provisions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the termination record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for compliance and operational tracking.

attributes.name: credentialing_related_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination was due to credentialing issues such as license revocation, malpractice history, sanctions, or failure to meet credentialing standards. True = credentialing-related; False = other reason.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider termination becomes effective and the provider is no longer considered in-network for new services. Critical for claims adjudication and member communication.
attributes.references: Network Contract Standards, CMS Network Adequacy Requirements

attributes.name: financial_settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which final financial settlement was completed between the health plan and terminated provider.

attributes.name: financial_settlement_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial settlement or reconciliation is required between the health plan and provider upon termination. True = settlement required; False = no settlement required. Common for capitated or risk-sharing arrangements.

attributes.name: for_cause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination was for-cause due to contract breach, quality issues, fraud, or other serious violations. True = for-cause termination; False = without-cause termination.

attributes.name: last_updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last updated the termination record. Part of audit trail.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the termination record. Part of audit trail for compliance and operational tracking.

attributes.name: member_impact_count
attributes.description: Number of active members assigned to or receiving care from the terminated provider at the time of termination. Used to assess continuity-of-care obligations and member notification requirements.

attributes.name: member_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which affected members were notified of the provider termination. Required for regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: member_notification_method
attributes.description: Method used to notify affected members of the termination: mail (postal letter), email, member portal, phone call, or multiple channels.

attributes.name: member_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether member notification is required by regulation or contract. True = notification required; False = no notification required. CMS and state DOI regulations mandate notification for certain termination types.
attributes.references: CMS Member Communication Requirements, State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: network_adequacy_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination impacts network adequacy standards for time-and-distance or provider-to-member ratios. True = adequacy impact; False = no adequacy impact. Triggers network adequacy re-assessment.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards, State DOI Network Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, internal notes, or special handling instructions related to the termination. May include details of negotiations, legal considerations, or operational impacts.

attributes.name: notice_date
attributes.description: Date on which formal written notice of termination was provided to the provider or plan, as required by contract terms and regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: Ten-digit unique identifier assigned by CMS to healthcare providers. Denormalized for operational efficiency and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: provider_directory_removal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the provider was removed from online and printed provider directories. CMS requires directory updates within specified timeframes.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the specific reason for termination. Examples include quality concerns, credentialing failure, contract breach, provider relocation, retirement, network restructuring, or regulatory action.

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the termination reason, providing context beyond the reason code. May include specific incidents, performance issues, or business rationale.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the termination was reported to the applicable regulatory authority (state DOI, CMS, NCQA). Required for compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: regulatory_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or confirmation code from the regulatory authority acknowledging receipt of the termination report.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the termination must be reported to regulatory authorities such as state DOI or CMS. True = reporting required; False = no reporting required. For-cause and credentialing-related terminations typically require reporting.
attributes.references: State DOI Reporting Requirements, CMS Oversight Standards

attributes.name: replacement_provider_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the health plan must recruit a replacement provider to maintain network adequacy. True = replacement required; False = no replacement required.

attributes.name: termination_number
attributes.description: Business-assigned unique reference number for the termination event, used for tracking and correspondence.

attributes.name: termination_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the termination record: pending (awaiting approval), approved (authorized but not yet effective), effective (termination is active), completed (all post-termination obligations fulfilled), cancelled (termination rescinded).

attributes.name: termination_type
attributes.description: Classification of the termination event indicating whether it was voluntary (provider-initiated), involuntary (plan-initiated), for-cause (breach or quality issue), contract non-renewal, credentialing revocation, or mutual agreement.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created the termination record. Part of audit trail.

products.name: par_agreement
products.description: Provider participation agreement record — the formal agreement a provider signs to participate in a network. Captures agreement type (individual, group), signature date, effective date, termination provisions, and agreement version. Distinct from the broader provider_contract which covers reimbursement terms.

attributes.name: par_agreement_id
attributes.description: System-generated unique identifier for the provider participation agreement.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.provider_contract. Business justification: PAR agreements are executed under a specific provider contract; linking enables contract‑level reporting and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the health plan associated with the agreement, if plan‑specific.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the provider participating in the network.

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the provider network to which the agreement applies.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: External reference number assigned to the agreement by the health plan.

attributes.name: agreement_scope_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the services, specialties, and geographic areas covered.

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classifies the agreement as individual provider, group practice, or other entity.

attributes.name: agreement_version
attributes.description: Version identifier for the agreement document (e.g., v1, v2).

attributes.name: amendment_effective_date
attributes.description: Date the amendment becomes effective.

attributes.name: amendment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents an amendment to a prior agreement.

products.name: group_plan_offering
products.description: The set of health plan products offered by an employer group to its eligible employees during a plan year — the single source of truth for what plans are available, how the employer contributes, and what participation rules apply. Captures which QHP, HMO, PPO, EPO, HDHP, dental, and vision plans are available; employer contribution strategy per plan including contribution type (flat dollar, percentage of premium, tiered by coverage tier), employee-only vs family contribution amounts, HSA/HRA employer seed amounts, and contribution effective date ranges; minimum participation percentage, minimum enrolled headcount, waiver eligibility criteria (e.g., spousal coverage waivers), measurement period, and participation compliance status; and the open enrollment window linkage. Links employer groups to the plan catalog and drives the enrollment eligibility matrix, premium billing split calculations, and ACA affordability compliance testing.

products.name: group_renewal
products.description: Annual renewal lifecycle record and single source of truth for all group configuration changes — both at renewal and between renewal cycles. Captures renewal effective date, prior year vs renewal year premium rates, rate change percentage, benefit modifications, participation requirement outcomes, renewal status (pending, proposed, accepted, declined), and retention outcome. Also captures mid-year and off-cycle amendments including amendment type (benefit change, plan add/drop, contribution change, address update, contact change), amendment effective date, reason code, approval status, and before/after values of changed attributes. Consolidates group amendments as lifecycle events within the renewal record — amendments are tracked against the current plan year's renewal. Provides complete audit trail for group retention management, regulatory compliance, and configuration change history.
