products.name: broker_agreement
products.description: Master reference table for broker_agreement. Referenced by agreement_id.

attributes.name: broker_agreement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for broker_agreement

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the broker agreement, used in correspondence, commission statements, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the broker agreement indicating the nature of the intermediary relationship (e.g., general agent, broker, sub-broker, managing general agent, consultant, or third-party administrator).

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal amendments or addenda that have been executed against this broker agreement since its original effective date.

attributes.name: appointment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the broker was formally appointed by the carrier to represent and sell its health insurance products.

attributes.name: appointment_status
attributes.description: Status of the broker's formal appointment with the carrier, indicating whether the broker is currently appointed, pending appointment, lapsed, or revoked.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the broker agreement automatically renews at the end of each term period without requiring explicit re-execution.

attributes.name: base_commission_rate
attributes.description: Standard base commission rate (expressed as a decimal percentage, e.g., 0.0500 = 5%) applicable under this agreement for new business production.

attributes.name: broker_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the broker or producer entity that is party to this agreement.

attributes.name: broker_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the broker or brokerage firm associated with this agreement, as registered with the state department of insurance.

attributes.name: broker_npn
attributes.description: National Producer Number assigned by the National Insurance Producer Registry (NIPR), uniquely identifying the licensed producer across all states.

attributes.name: broker_tin
attributes.description: Federal Taxpayer Identification Number (EIN or SSN) of the broker, used for IRS 1099 reporting of commission payments.

attributes.name: commission_schedule_type
attributes.description: Type of commission schedule governing broker compensation under this agreement, such as flat rate, tiered, percentage of premium, per-member-per-month, bonus-eligible, or override commission.

attributes.name: compensation_method
attributes.description: Method by which the broker is compensated under this agreement, such as commission-based, fee-for-service, salary, or a hybrid arrangement.

attributes.name: compliance_certification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent compliance certification or attestation completed by the broker, confirming adherence to carrier policies, ACA requirements, and anti-fraud provisions.

attributes.name: contract_version
attributes.description: Version number of the broker agreement contract template used, supporting tracking of contract amendments and revisions over time.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the broker agreement becomes legally binding and the broker is authorized to solicit and sell health insurance products on behalf of the carrier.

attributes.name: employer_group_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific employer group account this broker agreement is associated with, if the agreement is group-specific rather than a general agency agreement.

attributes.name: errors_omissions_expiry
attributes.description: Expiration date of the broker's current Errors and Omissions (E&O) insurance policy on file with the carrier.

attributes.name: errors_omissions_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the broker is required to maintain Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability insurance as a condition of this agreement.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is an exclusive agreement where the broker is restricted from selling competing carriers' products in the same market segment and territory.

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the broker agreement was formally signed and executed by both parties.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the broker agreement is scheduled to expire. Nullable for open-ended or evergreen agreements that auto-renew.

attributes.name: general_agent_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the general agent or managing general agent under whose hierarchy this broker agreement falls, if applicable.

attributes.name: market_segment
attributes.description: Health insurance market segment that the broker is authorized to sell under this agreement, such as small group, large group, individual, Medicare, Medicaid, or exchange marketplace.

attributes.name: minimum_production_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum annual premium production volume or number of enrolled lives the broker must achieve to maintain active status under this agreement.

attributes.name: non_compete_period_months
attributes.description: Duration in months of the non-compete or non-solicitation clause that applies after termination of this agreement.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the broker agreement, capturing special terms, negotiated exceptions, or administrative remarks.

attributes.name: override_commission_rate
attributes.description: Override or bonus commission rate paid to general agents or managing brokers on production generated by sub-brokers under their hierarchy.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which commission payments are disbursed to the broker under this agreement.

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: Line of health insurance products the broker is authorized to sell under this agreement, such as medical, dental, vision, life, disability, or supplemental coverage.

attributes.name: renewal_commission_rate
attributes.description: Commission rate applicable to renewal business under this agreement, often different from the new business rate.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Next scheduled renewal date for the broker agreement, used for renewal management workflows and commission schedule reviews.

attributes.name: state_of_licensure
attributes.description: Two-letter state code where the broker holds an active insurance producer license, as required for this agreement to be valid.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the broker agreement indicating whether it is draft, active, suspended, terminated, expired, or pending renewal.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date the broker agreement was terminated, if terminated prior to the scheduled expiration date. Null if the agreement has not been terminated.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for early termination of the broker agreement, such as voluntary withdrawal, for-cause termination, non-renewal, regulatory action, mutual agreement, or carrier-initiated cancellation.

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the geographic sales territory or service area in which the broker is authorized to operate under this agreement.

attributes.name: parent_broker_agreement_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on broker_agreement (parent_broker_agreement_id)

domains.name: contract
domains.description: Manages provider contracts, reimbursement agreements, capitation arrangements, fee schedules, value-based care (VBC) contracts, ACO agreements, risk-sharing models, contract terms, amendments, and contract lifecycle. Tracks contract effective dates, rate tables, and payment methodologies (fee-for-service, capitation, bundled payments). SSOT for all contractual and reimbursement terms between the health plan and providers.

products.name: contract_provider_contract
products.description: Master record for all contractual agreements between the health plan and providers (physicians, hospitals, clinics, ancillary providers, DME suppliers), including formal contracts, Letters of Agreement (LOAs), Letters of Intent (LOIs), single-case agreements (SCAs), and out-of-network gap-fill arrangements. Captures contract type (fee-for-service, capitation, bundled payment, VBC/ACO, LOA, SCA), contract status, effective and termination dates, line of business (LOB) applicability, TPA/ASO designations, auto-renewal flags, contract tier, owning network, template reference, payment methodology classification, and service scope definitions (covered/excluded service categories, CPT/HCPCS ranges, revenue code ranges, DRG ranges, carve-out indicators, inclusion/exclusion flags). SSOT for all provider reimbursement agreements, interim arrangements, and contracted service scope. Sourced from Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource) and Core Administration Platform (Facets/QNXT).

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the provider contract record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for all contractual agreements between the health plan and providers.

attributes.name: contract_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Required for Contract Owner assignment report; links each provider contract to the employee responsible for its management.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Budgeting process assigns each provider contract to a cost center for expense allocation and financial reporting; insurers track contract costs by cost center.

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: GL posting of payments and adjustments under a provider contract uses a specific ledger; accounting requires contract‑to‑ledger mapping for audit trails.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider (physician, hospital, clinic, ancillary provider, or DME supplier) who is party to this contract. Sourced from Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource).

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider network that owns or administers this contract (e.g., HMO network, PPO network, EPO network). Determines which network directory listings are governed by this contract.
attributes.references: Provider Management System - Cactus/ProviderSource; NCQA Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credential.credential_record. Business justification: Contract underwriting ties each provider contract to the credential record reviewed for compliance; needed for audit, renewal, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: risk_pool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.pool. Business justification: UNDERWRITING: Provider contracts must be tied to a risk pool for rate setting and risk‑adjustment reporting required by CMS.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Claims outsourcing uses a TPA vendor; provider contract must reference the TPA vendor for payment methodology, audit, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: amendment_date
attributes.description: Effective date of the most recent amendment to this contract. Used to determine which contract terms apply for a given date of service. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Contract Filing Requirements

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the most recent amendment to this contract. Null for original, unamended contracts. Tracks the amendment sequence for audit and compliance purposes. Sourced from Cactus/ProviderSource.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Contract Filing Requirements

attributes.name: aso_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract operates under an Administrative Services Only (ASO) arrangement where the employer self-funds claims and the health plan provides administrative services only. True = ASO arrangement.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 3(1); DOL ASO Regulations; NAIC Model Act

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract is configured to automatically renew upon reaching its termination date without requiring re-execution. True = auto-renews; False = requires manual renewal action.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Contract Filing Requirements

attributes.name: capitation_rate_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capitation Rate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Fixed monthly payment amount per enrolled member (Per Member Per Month - PMPM) paid to the provider under capitation contracts. Applicable only when payment_methodology = capitation. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: CMS Capitation Rate Setting Guidelines; NAIC Model Contract Standards; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP) No. 49

attributes.name: carve_out_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether specific services or benefit categories are carved out of this contract and managed under a separate arrangement (e.g., behavioral health carve-out, pharmacy carve-out). True = carve-outs exist.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Carve-Out Guidance; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: contract_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the contract as recorded in the Provider Management System. Used for display in contracting workflows, provider communications, and reporting dashboards.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable contract identifier assigned by the health plan contracting department. Used in correspondence, amendments, and provider communications. Sourced from Cactus/ProviderSource contract module.
attributes.references: Provider Management System - Cactus/ProviderSource; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the provider contract. Drives eligibility verification, claims adjudication routing, and provider directory inclusion. Values: draft, pending_execution, active, suspended, terminated, expired, under_amendment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_execution|active|suspended|terminated|expired|under_amendment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Core Administration Platform - Facets/QNXT; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: contract_tier
attributes.description: Tiering classification assigned to this contract, reflecting the provider's preferred status and associated member cost-sharing levels. Tier 1/preferred providers typically have lower member cost-sharing. Used in benefit design and member-facing provider directory.
attributes.references: NCQA Network Adequacy Standards; CMS Tiered Network Guidance

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contractual arrangement by payment and relationship structure. Determines reimbursement methodology and applicable rate tables. Values: fee_for_service (FFS), capitation, bundled_payment, value_based_care (VBC/ACO), letter_of_agreement (LOA), single_case_agreement (SCA), out_of_network_gap_fill. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fee_for_service|capitation|bundled_payment|value_based_care|letter_of_agreement|single_case_agreement|out_of_network_gap_fill — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Payment Methodology Guidelines; NAIC Model Contract Standards; ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: cpt_range_end
attributes.description: Ending CPT or HCPCS procedure code defining the upper bound of the service scope covered under this contract. Used with cpt_range_start to define the range of covered procedures.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Code Set; CMS HCPCS Level II Codes; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162.1002

attributes.name: cpt_range_start
attributes.description: Starting CPT or HCPCS procedure code defining the lower bound of the service scope covered under this contract. Used with cpt_range_end to define the range of covered procedures. Sourced from AMA CPT code set.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Code Set; CMS HCPCS Level II Codes; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162.1002

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this provider contract record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.312 (Audit Controls); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: credentialing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider must maintain active credentialing status as a condition of this contract. True = credentialing is a contractual requirement. Linked to NCQA credentialing standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Credentialing Standards; State DOI Credentialing Requirements

attributes.name: delegation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether credentialing, utilization management, or other health plan functions have been delegated to the provider organization under this contract. True = delegation arrangement exists. Requires NCQA delegation oversight.
attributes.references: NCQA Delegation Standards; URAC Delegation Standards; CMS Delegation Requirements 42 CFR Part 422.504

attributes.name: drg_range_end
attributes.description: Ending Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) code defining the upper bound of inpatient service scope covered under this contract. Used with drg_range_start to define the range of covered DRGs.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Classification System; ICD-10-CM/PCS; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: drg_range_start
attributes.description: Starting Diagnosis Related Group (DRG) code defining the lower bound of inpatient service scope covered under this contract. Applicable for hospital contracts with DRG-based payment methodology.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Classification System; ICD-10-CM/PCS; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract becomes legally binding and reimbursement terms take effect. Used in claims adjudication to determine applicable rate schedule. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment and Certification; NAIC Model Contract Standards; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date on which all parties signed and the contract was fully executed. May differ from effective_date for retroactive or prospective contracts. Sourced from Cactus/ProviderSource contract module.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Contract Filing Requirements

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fee schedule (rate table) governing reimbursement amounts for specific CPT/HCPCS procedure codes under this contract. Applicable for fee-for-service and bundled payment contracts.
attributes.references: CMS Physician Fee Schedule; AMA CPT Code Set; Core Administration Platform - Facets/QNXT

attributes.name: lob_applicability
attributes.description: Line of Business (LOB) to which this contract applies. Determines which member populations and benefit plans are governed by this contract's reimbursement terms. Values: commercial, medicare_advantage, medicaid, marketplace, cobra, tricare, all. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|medicare_advantage|medicaid|marketplace|cobra|tricare|all — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR Part 422; CMS Medicaid Managed Care 42 CFR Part 438; ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the contracting provider as assigned by CMS NPPES. 10-digit unique identifier used in EDI transactions (837/835) and claims adjudication to identify the contracted provider.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162.406; CMS NPPES NPI Registry

attributes.name: payment_methodology
attributes.description: Specific reimbursement calculation methodology governing how the health plan pays the provider under this contract. Distinct from contract_type in that it specifies the payment calculation approach. Examples: fee_for_service (FFS), capitation (PMPM), per_diem, case_rate, DRG-based, bundled, Reference Based Pricing (RBP), global_budget, salary. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fee_for_service|capitation|per_diem|case_rate|drg_based|bundled|rbp|global_budget|salary — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Payment Methodology Guidelines; NAIC Model Contract Standards; ACA Section 1311

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contracted provider entity type. Drives applicable reimbursement rules, credentialing requirements, and service scope definitions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: physician|hospital|clinic|ancillary|dme_supplier|behavioral_health|skilled_nursing|home_health|laboratory|radiology — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NPI National Plan and Provider Enumeration System (NPPES); NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: quality_incentive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract includes quality-based incentive payments tied to HEDIS, STAR ratings, CAHPS, or other quality performance measures. True = quality incentive provisions exist in the contract.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Measures; CMS Star Ratings Program; CAHPS Survey Standards

attributes.name: raf_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) / Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) coding obligations apply to the provider under this contract. True = provider has contractual HCC coding and encounter data submission requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment 42 CFR Part 422.310; CMS RAPS/EDPS; HCC Model Documentation

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to the termination date by which either party must provide written notice of intent not to renew. Contractually mandated notice period for non-renewal. Typically 30, 60, or 90 days.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Contract Filing Requirements

attributes.name: revenue_code_range_end
attributes.description: Ending UB-04 revenue code defining the upper bound of facility service categories covered under this contract. Used with revenue_code_range_start to define the range of covered revenue codes.
attributes.references: NUBC UB-04 Revenue Code Set; CMS Facility Billing Guidelines; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: revenue_code_range_start
attributes.description: Starting UB-04 revenue code defining the lower bound of facility service categories covered under this contract. Used for hospital and facility contracts to define covered service lines.
attributes.references: NUBC UB-04 Revenue Code Set; CMS Facility Billing Guidelines; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: risk_sharing_model
attributes.description: Specifies the financial risk-sharing arrangement between the health plan and provider under VBC or ACO contracts. Determines how savings and losses are allocated. Values: none, shared_savings, shared_risk, full_risk, upside_only, downside_only.
attributes.references: CMS Innovation Center ACO Models; CMS Medicare Shared Savings Program 42 CFR Part 425; NCQA VBC Standards

attributes.name: service_exclusion_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of specific services, procedures, or conditions explicitly excluded from the scope of this contract. Supplements the CPT/DRG/revenue code ranges with narrative exclusion details.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; CMS Managed Care Coverage Exclusion Guidelines

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this contract record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between Provider Management System and Core Administration Platform.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.312 (Audit Controls)

attributes.name: source_system_contract_reference
attributes.description: Native contract identifier from the originating operational system (Cactus, ProviderSource, Facets, or QNXT). Enables traceability and reconciliation back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Provider Management System - Cactus/ProviderSource; Core Administration Platform - Facets/QNXT; Internal Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Federal Tax Identification Number (TIN) or Employer Identification Number (EIN) of the contracting provider entity. Used for 1099 reporting, payment processing, and IRS compliance. 9-digit numeric value.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: template_code
attributes.description: Reference to the standard contract template used as the basis for this agreement. Enables tracking of which template version governs the contract terms and supports template-level compliance audits.
attributes.references: Provider Management System - Cactus/ProviderSource; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contract ceases to be binding. Null for open-ended contracts. Used to determine provider in-network status for claims with dates of service at or before this date. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment and Certification; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance written notice required by either party to terminate the contract for convenience (without cause). Distinct from renewal_notice_days which applies at contract expiry.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Contract Filing Requirements; CMS Provider Termination Notice Requirements

attributes.name: tpa_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract is administered by a Third Party Administrator (TPA) on behalf of the health plan. True = TPA-administered; False = directly administered by the health plan. Relevant for ASO arrangements.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 3(16); DOL TPA Regulations; NAIC Model TPA Act

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this provider contract record was last modified in the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for incremental load detection and change data capture. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.312 (Audit Controls); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: vbc_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract includes Value-Based Care (VBC) components such as quality bonuses, shared savings, or risk-sharing arrangements beyond standard fee-for-service reimbursement.
attributes.references: CMS Innovation Center VBC Models; ACA Section 3022 (ACO); NCQA VBC Standards

products.name: party
products.description: Identifies all parties bound by a provider contract — the health plan entity, the contracting provider (individual NPI or organizational NPI), group practice, IPA, ACO, or hospital system. Tracks party role (payer, provider, delegated entity), NPI, TIN, legal entity name, signatory authority, and party effective dates. Supports multi-party and delegated contracting arrangements.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each party record in the provider contract domain. Serves as the primary key for all contractual party references across the health plan enterprise.
attributes.references: HIPAA Administrative Simplification; CMS Provider Enrollment Standards

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider contract this party is bound by. Links the party record to its governing contractual agreement within the contract domain.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credential.credential_record. Business justification: Party represents a provider entity in a contract; linking to its credential record enables tracking of credential status and compliance per party.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor. Business justification: Contract Party Management report requires linking party records to vendor master to identify vendor parties (e.g., TPAs) for compliance and payment processing.

attributes.name: aco_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is an Accountable Care Organization (ACO) participating in a value-based care (VBC) arrangement. Triggers ACO-specific contract terms, shared savings calculations, and CMS reporting requirements.
attributes.references: CMS ACO Regulations 42 CFR Part 425; CMS Shared Savings Program; ACA Section 3022

attributes.name: capitation_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is eligible to receive capitation payments (Per Member Per Month - PMPM) under the contract. Drives capitation payment processing and actuarial PMPM rate application.
attributes.references: CMS Capitation Payment Standards; CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR Part 422; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: contract_party_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to this party within the contract management system (e.g., Cactus or ProviderSource provider contract number). Used for cross-system reconciliation, EDI transactions, and provider directory publication.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; HIPAA EDI Transaction Standards; Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource)

attributes.name: credentialing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party was most recently credentialed or re-credentialed by the health plan. NCQA requires re-credentialing every 36 months. Used to trigger re-credentialing workflows and network compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: credentialing_status
attributes.description: Current credentialing status of the party as maintained in the Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource). Determines whether the party is eligible to provide services to plan members. Credentialing must be current for claims to be adjudicated as in-network.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; CMS Provider Enrollment; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: delegation_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is a delegated entity authorized to perform functions on behalf of the health plan (e.g., credentialing, utilization management, claims processing). Triggers delegation oversight and audit requirements per NCQA and state DOI standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Delegation Standards; State DOI Delegation Requirements; URAC Standards

attributes.name: delegation_scope
attributes.description: Specifies the functional scope of delegation authority granted to this party. Applicable only when delegation_indicator is true. Defines which health plan functions the delegated entity is authorized to perform on behalf of the payer.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Delegation Standards; State DOI Delegation Requirements; URAC Standards

attributes.name: doing_business_as_name
attributes.description: Trade name or DBA name under which the party operates, if different from the legal entity name. Commonly used for group practices and hospital systems that operate under a brand name distinct from their legal registration.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this party's participation in the contract becomes effective. Drives claims adjudication eligibility windows, network directory publication, and provider credentialing timelines.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the contracting party as registered with state or federal authorities. Used for contract execution, credentialing, and regulatory reporting. May be an individual provider name, group practice name, IPA, ACO, or hospital system name.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162; CMS Provider Enrollment; NAIC Model Law

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party's primary state professional or business license expires. Triggers credentialing re-verification workflows and may result in contract suspension if not renewed. Critical for NCQA and URAC credentialing compliance.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation where the party holds its primary professional or business license. Used for network adequacy reporting, credentialing, and state-specific regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviation Standards; State DOI Licensing Requirements; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Health plan line of business under which this party is contracted. Determines applicable regulatory requirements, reimbursement methodologies, and network adequacy standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|medicare_advantage|medicaid|marketplace|cobra|fehb — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR Part 422; CMS Medicaid Regulations; ACA Marketplace Rules

attributes.name: malpractice_coverage_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party maintains active professional liability (malpractice) insurance coverage as required by the contract. Failure to maintain coverage may trigger contract suspension or termination per NCQA credentialing standards.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; State DOI Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: malpractice_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the party's professional liability (malpractice) insurance policy expires. Triggers credentialing re-verification and contract compliance monitoring workflows.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; State DOI Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: network_participation_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party is a participating (PAR) in-network provider, a non-participating (non-PAR) provider, or an out-of-network provider. Drives member cost-sharing calculations, claims adjudication rules, and EOB generation.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards; NCQA Network Standards; ACA 45 CFR Part 156

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing supplemental information about the party that does not fit structured attributes. May include contract negotiation notes, special arrangement details, or credentialing exceptions. Classified as confidential due to potential inclusion of sensitive business information.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: npi
attributes.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier assigned by CMS to uniquely identify the provider party. Type 1 NPI for individual providers; Type 2 NPI for organizational providers. Required for all HIPAA-covered transactions including 837 claims and 270/271 eligibility inquiries.
attributes.references: HIPAA NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162.406; CMS NPI Registry; AMA Provider Standards

attributes.name: npi_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the NPI is Type 1 (individual/solo practitioner) or Type 2 (organizational entity such as group practice, hospital, or IPA). Determines credentialing requirements and contract structure.
attributes.references: HIPAA NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162.406; CMS NPI Registry

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party appears on the OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE). Excluded parties are prohibited from participating in Medicare, Medicaid, and other federal healthcare programs. Checked monthly per CMS compliance requirements.
attributes.references: OIG LEIE; 42 USC 1320a-7; CMS Provider Enrollment; HIPAA Compliance

attributes.name: party_role
attributes.description: Functional role of this party within the contract relationship. Identifies whether the party is the health plan (payer), a contracting provider, a delegated entity, an Independent Practice Association (IPA), an Accountable Care Organization (ACO), a hospital system, or a group practice. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: payer|provider|delegated_entity|ipa|aco|hospital_system|group_practice — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment; NCQA Credentialing Standards; NAIC Model Law

attributes.name: party_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the party within the contract. Indicates whether the party is actively bound by the contract, pending execution, suspended, terminated, or inactive. Drives eligibility verification and claims adjudication routing.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law; NCQA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: party_type
attributes.description: Classifies the party as an individual (natural person, e.g., solo practitioner with individual NPI) or an organization (legal entity, e.g., group practice, hospital, IPA, ACO). Drives NPI type assignment and credentialing workflow.
attributes.references: HIPAA NPI Final Rule 45 CFR Part 162.406; CMS NPI Registry

attributes.name: primary_specialty_code
attributes.description: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code representing the party's primary clinical specialty. Used for network adequacy analysis, claims routing, prior authorization rules, and provider directory classification.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; CMS Provider Enrollment; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: raf_applicable_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) scoring applies to this party's contract arrangement. Relevant for Medicare Advantage and ACA marketplace contracts where Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) risk scores drive capitation payments.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Regulations 42 CFR Part 422; CMS RAPS/EDPS; ACA Section 1343

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting requirements. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 164; Enterprise Data Governance Standards; SOC 2 Audit Requirements

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this party record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports change data capture, audit trail, and SCD Type 2 processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 164; Enterprise Data Governance Standards; SOC 2 Audit Requirements

attributes.name: recredentialing_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the party must complete re-credentialing to maintain active network participation. Calculated as 36 months from the credentialing_date per NCQA standards. Drives automated re-credentialing workflow initiation.
attributes.references: NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: sanction_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the party has an active sanction, exclusion, or adverse action recorded by OIG, SAM, or state licensing boards. A true value triggers contract suspension review and claims payment hold per CMS and HIPAA compliance requirements.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Database; SAM.gov Exclusions; CMS Provider Enrollment; HIPAA 42 CFR Part 1001

attributes.name: secondary_specialty_code
attributes.description: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code representing the party's secondary clinical specialty, if applicable. Supports multi-specialty provider contracting and network adequacy reporting.
attributes.references: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy Code Set; CMS Provider Enrollment; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: service_area_state
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation representing the primary state in which this party provides services under the contract. Used for network adequacy reporting, state regulatory compliance, and geographic claims routing.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards; State DOI Service Area Requirements; ACA 45 CFR Part 156

attributes.name: service_area_zip_code
attributes.description: Primary ZIP code of the party's principal service location. Used for network adequacy geo-mapping, member-to-provider distance calculations, and CMS network adequacy submissions.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards; NCQA Network Standards; ACA 45 CFR Part 156

attributes.name: signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the authorized individual who signed or has authority to sign the contract on behalf of this party. Required for contract execution validation and legal enforceability. Typically the CEO, CMO, or designated contracting officer.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Law; State DOI Contract Requirements; ERISA

attributes.name: signatory_title
attributes.description: Official title or position of the authorized signatory (e.g., Chief Executive Officer, Medical Director, Contracting Officer). Validates the authority level of the individual executing the contract on behalf of the party.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Law; State DOI Contract Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this party record originated (e.g., Cactus, ProviderSource, Facets, QNXT). Supports data lineage tracking, reconciliation, and ETL audit in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Standards; HIPAA Data Integrity Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_party_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this party record in the originating operational system (e.g., Cactus provider ID, ProviderSource contract party key). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability from the Silver Layer back to the system of record.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Standards; HIPAA Data Integrity Requirements

attributes.name: state_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued professional or business license number for the contracting party. Required for credentialing verification and network participation. For individual providers, this is the state medical license; for organizations, the state business license or certificate of authority.
attributes.references: State DOI Licensing Requirements; NCQA Credentialing Standards; URAC Standards

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this party's participation in the contract ends. Null for open-ended or currently active parties. Used to determine network participation windows, claims payment eligibility, and member notification requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Enrollment Standards; NCQA Credentialing Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: tin
attributes.description: Federal Tax Identification Number (EIN or SSN) used for payment processing, 1099 reporting, and IRS compliance. Critical for remittance and premium payment routing. Stored as 9-digit numeric string without hyphens.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162; CMS Provider Enrollment

attributes.name: vbc_arrangement_type
attributes.description: Specifies the payment methodology or value-based care arrangement type applicable to this party under the contract. Drives reimbursement calculation logic, risk-sharing model application, and financial reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fee_for_service|capitation|bundled_payment|shared_savings|global_risk — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Care Programs; CMS ACO Regulations 42 CFR Part 425; NAIC Model Contract Law

products.name: term
products.description: Defines the specific terms, conditions, obligations, and reimbursement policies within a provider contract. Captures term type (payment methodology, exclusivity, termination clause, audit rights, hold-harmless, indemnification, confidentiality, HIPAA BAA, reimbursement rule), term text, effective date, expiration date, and whether the term is negotiable or standard boilerplate. For reimbursement rule terms: captures policy sub-type (multiple procedure reduction, bilateral procedure, assistant surgeon, global surgery, unbundling rules, place-of-service differential), applicable CPT/HCPCS ranges, reduction percentage, and LOB applicability. Enables granular tracking of contractual obligations, compliance checkpoints, and reimbursement adjudication rules. Bridges contract terms to claims adjudication logic in Facets/QNXT.

attributes.name: term_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a contract term record in the provider contract management system (Facets/QNXT or Provider Management System). Serves as the primary key for the term entity.

attributes.name: amendment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contract amendment that introduced or modified this term, if applicable. Null if the term originates from the base contract rather than an amendment.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent provider contract to which this term belongs. Links the term to its governing contract in the Provider Network Management system.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fee schedule associated with this term when payment_methodology is fee_for_service. Links to the rate table governing allowed amounts for procedure codes under this term.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule; Provider Network Management — Cactus/ProviderSource

attributes.name: audit_rights_period_years
attributes.description: The number of years the health plan retains the right to audit provider records under this audit rights term. Typically 7 years per HIPAA and CMS requirements. Applicable when term_type is 'audit_rights'.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR 164.530(j); CMS Medicare Advantage Audit Requirements (42 CFR 422.504); ERISA 29 CFR 2520

attributes.name: auto_renew
attributes.description: Indicates whether this term automatically renews upon expiration without requiring renegotiation (True). Supports contract lifecycle management and renewal notification workflows.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; Provider Network Management — Cactus/ProviderSource

attributes.name: capitation_rate
attributes.description: The Per Member Per Month (PMPM) capitation rate defined by this term when payment_methodology is capitation. Represents the fixed monthly payment per enrolled member to the provider regardless of services rendered. Classified confidential as proprietary pricing.
attributes.references: CMS Capitation Rate Setting Guidelines; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: compliance_checkpoint_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next compliance review or audit checkpoint associated with this term. Used by the compliance team to track regulatory obligations, CMS audit readiness, and DOI examination preparation.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Compliance Program Requirements (42 CFR 422.503); State DOI Market Conduct Examination Standards

attributes.name: cpt_range_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) / Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Range End
attributes.description: The ending CPT or HCPCS procedure code of the range to which this reimbursement rule term applies. Used in conjunction with cpt_range_start to define the applicable procedure code range for adjudication.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Editorial Panel; CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Guidelines

attributes.name: cpt_range_start
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) / Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) Range Start
attributes.description: The starting CPT or HCPCS procedure code of the range to which this reimbursement rule term applies. Used in conjunction with cpt_range_end to define the applicable procedure code range for adjudication.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Editorial Panel; CMS HCPCS Level II Coding Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract term record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record retention requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR 164.312(b); CMS Medicare Advantage Audit Requirements; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: The contractually agreed method for resolving disputes arising under this term: Arbitration, Mediation, Litigation, or Internal Review. Applicable for hold-harmless, indemnification, and audit rights terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; ERISA 29 CFR Part 2560; State DOI Dispute Resolution Requirements

attributes.name: drg_grouper_version
attributes.description: The DRG grouper version (e.g., 'MS-DRG v41.0', 'APR-DRG v39') applicable to this term when payment_methodology is 'drg_based'. Ensures adjudication uses the correct DRG weight tables for inpatient reimbursement.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Grouper; 3M APR-DRG Grouper; CMS IPPS Final Rule

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this contract term becomes legally binding and operationally enforceable. Used to determine applicability during claims adjudication in Facets/QNXT.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Agreement Guidelines; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this contract term ceases to be binding. Null for open-ended terms with no defined end date. Used in adjudication date-range checks.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Agreement Guidelines; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: governing_state
attributes.description: The two-letter US state code whose laws govern this contract term. Determines applicable state DOI regulations, insurance code requirements, and state-specific provider contract mandates.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Regulations; ERISA 29 CFR Part 2520

attributes.name: hipaa_baa_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Business Associate Agreement (BAA) Required Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this term constitutes or requires a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA) (True). Triggers compliance tracking and ensures Protected Health Information (PHI) handling obligations are documented per HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR 164.502(e); 45 CFR 164.504(e); OCR HIPAA Enforcement

attributes.name: icd_version
attributes.description: Specifies the ICD diagnosis coding version applicable to this term when the term references diagnosis-based reimbursement rules or Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) risk adjustment provisions.
attributes.references: WHO ICD Classification System; CMS ICD-10-CM/PCS Coding Guidelines

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: The maximum dollar amount of quality incentive payment available to the provider under this term upon meeting quality_metric_threshold. Applicable for VBC, ACO, and pay-for-performance contract terms. Classified confidential as proprietary financial terms.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Purchasing Program; CMS ACO Shared Savings Program

attributes.name: is_adjudication_rule
attributes.description: Indicates whether this term directly drives claims adjudication logic in Facets/QNXT (True). When True, the term's reimbursement_policy_subtype, cpt_range_start/end, and reduction_percentage are loaded into the adjudication engine.
attributes.references: Core Administration Platform — Facets/QNXT Claims Adjudication Module

attributes.name: is_negotiable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract term is open to negotiation (True) or is standard non-negotiable boilerplate language (False). Supports contract negotiation workflow and template management.
attributes.references: Provider Network Management — Cactus/ProviderSource; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: is_standard_boilerplate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this term is sourced from the organization's standard contract template library (True) or is a custom-negotiated term specific to this contract (False). Supports template governance and deviation tracking.
attributes.references: Provider Network Management — Cactus/ProviderSource; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: lob_applicability
attributes.description: Specifies which Line of Business (LOB) this contract term applies to. Enables selective application of reimbursement rules and contractual obligations across Commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, Marketplace (ACA/QHP), or all lines of business.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage (42 CFR Part 422); CMS Medicaid (42 CFR Part 438); ACA 45 CFR Part 156

attributes.name: mac_pricing_basis
attributes.description: The drug pricing benchmark used for pharmacy reimbursement terms: Average Wholesale Price (AWP), Wholesale Acquisition Cost (WAC), Maximum Allowable Cost (MAC), National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC), or a custom contracted rate. Applicable for terms covering pharmacy benefits.
attributes.references: CMS Medicaid Drug Rebate Program; PBM Contracting Standards; NAIC Model Pharmacy Benefit Standards

attributes.name: payment_methodology
attributes.description: The reimbursement payment methodology defined by this term when term_type is 'payment_methodology' or 'reimbursement_rule'. Drives adjudication logic in Facets/QNXT. Includes Fee-for-Service (FFS), Capitation, Bundled Payment, Case Rate, Per Diem, Diagnosis Related Group (DRG)-based, Reference Based Pricing (RBP), and Value-Based Care (VBC). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fee_for_service|capitation|bundled_payment|case_rate|per_diem|drg_based|rbp|vbc — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Provider Agreement Guidelines; CMS Medicare Advantage Payment Methodology

attributes.name: pos_code
attributes.description: The CMS Place of Service (POS) code to which this term's reimbursement differential applies, when reimbursement_policy_subtype is 'pos_differential'. Two-digit code per CMS POS code set (e.g., '11' for Office, '21' for Inpatient Hospital).
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Code Set; CMS Claims Processing Manual (Pub. 100-04, Ch. 26)

attributes.name: quality_metric_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum quality performance threshold (expressed as a percentage or score) that the provider must achieve to qualify for incentive payments or avoid penalties under quality incentive terms. Linked to HEDIS or STAR measures.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Star Ratings Methodology; URAC Quality Standards

attributes.name: reduction_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage reduction applied to the allowed amount under this reimbursement rule term (e.g., 50.00 for a 50% reduction on secondary procedures under multiple procedure reduction policy). Applicable when reimbursement_policy_subtype is set. Classified confidential as it represents proprietary pricing.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Editorial Panel Guidelines; CMS Claims Processing Manual (Pub. 100-04); NCCI

attributes.name: reimbursement_policy_subtype
attributes.description: Granular sub-classification of the reimbursement rule when term_type is 'reimbursement_rule'. Specifies the specific adjudication policy: Multiple Procedure Reduction, Bilateral Procedure, Assistant Surgeon, Global Surgery, Unbundling Rules, Place-of-Service (POS) Differential, or Modifier Impact. Directly maps to adjudication logic in Facets/QNXT. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: multiple_procedure_reduction|bilateral_procedure|assistant_surgeon|global_surgery|unbundling|pos_differential|modifier_impact — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AMA CPT Editorial Panel Guidelines; CMS Claims Processing Manual (Pub. 100-04); NCCI (National Correct Coding Initiative)

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days prior to expiration_date by which either party must provide notice of intent not to renew this term. Applicable when auto_renew is True.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Contract Requirements

attributes.name: risk_sharing_model
attributes.description: Defines the risk-sharing arrangement under Value-Based Care (VBC) or Accountable Care Organization (ACO) contract terms. Specifies whether the provider participates in shared savings only (upside), shared risk (two-sided), or full risk (global capitation).
attributes.references: CMS ACO Shared Savings Program (42 CFR Part 425); CMS Medicare Advantage Value-Based Insurance Design

attributes.name: source_system_term_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this term record in the originating operational system (e.g., Cactus contract clause ID, QNXT reimbursement rule ID, or ProviderSource term reference). Supports data lineage and reconciliation with source systems.
attributes.references: Provider Network Management — Cactus/ProviderSource; Core Administration Platform — Facets/QNXT

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: Plain-language operational summary of the term's intent and impact, authored by the contracting team. Used for training, audits, and quick reference without reading full legal text.

attributes.name: term_number
attributes.description: Human-readable external identifier for the term, typically formatted as a section or clause reference (e.g., 'TERM-2024-0042' or 'Section 4.2.1'). Used in contract documents and correspondence.

attributes.name: term_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the contract term. 'active' indicates the term is currently in force; 'superseded' indicates it has been replaced by an amendment; 'expired' indicates the effective period has lapsed.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; CMS Provider Agreement Guidelines

attributes.name: term_text
attributes.description: Full verbatim legal text of the contract term as negotiated and executed. Contains the binding contractual language. Classified confidential as it represents proprietary reimbursement and legal obligations.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; ERISA 29 CFR Part 2520

attributes.name: term_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the contract term defining its legal or operational purpose. Drives downstream adjudication logic and compliance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reimbursement_rule|payment_methodology|exclusivity|termination_clause|audit_rights|hold_harmless|indemnification|confidentiality|hipaa_baa|quality_incentive — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164 (BAA requirements); CMS Provider Agreement Guidelines

attributes.name: termination_cause_type
attributes.description: Specifies the basis under which termination is permitted by this term: For Cause (material breach, fraud, license revocation), Without Cause (convenience), Mutual Agreement, or Regulatory (required by law or CMS/DOI directive).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; CMS Provider Agreement Guidelines (42 CFR 422.202)

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days of advance written notice required to terminate the contract under this termination clause term. Applicable when term_type is 'termination_clause'. Typically 30, 60, or 90 days per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Contract Requirements; CMS Provider Agreement Guidelines

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short descriptive title of the contract term as it appears in the contract document (e.g., 'Multiple Procedure Reduction Policy', 'Termination for Cause Clause'). Supports search and display in contract management UIs.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract term record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR 164.312(b); Internal Data Governance Standard; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: withhold_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of reimbursement withheld from provider payments pending quality performance or risk settlement under VBC or capitation arrangements. Classified confidential as proprietary financial terms.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Payment Methodology; CMS ACO Shared Savings Program

products.name: amendment
products.description: Tracks all formal amendments, addenda, and modifications to an existing provider contract. Captures amendment number, amendment type (rate change, term modification, LOB addition, network tier change), effective date, reason for amendment, negotiation outcome, approval status, and the specific contract sections modified. Maintains full amendment history for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: amendment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each provider contract amendment record. Primary key for the amendment entity.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Needed for Amendment Approval audit; ties each amendment to the employee who approved it, satisfying compliance tracking.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent provider contract that this amendment modifies. Links the amendment to its originating contract record.
attributes.references: Provider Network Management Standard; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fee schedule record activated or superseded by this amendment. Links the amendment to the specific rate table used for claims adjudication under the amended terms.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Agreement Standards; Facets/QNXT Fee Schedule Module

attributes.name: regulatory_change_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_change. Business justification: Required: Amendments are often triggered by regulatory changes; linking tracks the change that caused the amendment.

attributes.name: superseded_amendment_id
attributes.description: Reference to a prior amendment record that this amendment replaces or supersedes. Enables traversal of the full amendment history chain for a given contract. Null if this is the first amendment or does not supersede a prior amendment.
attributes.references: Internal Contract Lifecycle Management Policy; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: vbc_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated Accountable Care Organization (ACO) agreement when this amendment relates to an ACO or Value-Based Care (VBC) arrangement. Nullable for non-ACO amendments.
attributes.references: CMS Shared Savings Program (MSSP); ACA Section 3022

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable sequential identifier for the amendment (e.g., AMD-2024-001234-001). Used in correspondence, audit trails, and regulatory submissions. Unique within the parent contract.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Law; CMS Provider Agreement Standards

attributes.name: amendment_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the amendment indicating the nature of the modification. Drives downstream processing workflows and audit categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rate_change|term_modification|lob_addition|network_tier_change|scope_change|termination|capitation_change|bundled_payment_change|vbc_modification|addendum — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: initiating_party

attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Law; Internal Contract Lifecycle Management Policy

attributes.name: internal_notes

attributes.name: lob_code

attributes.name: negotiation_notes

attributes.name: negotiation_outcome

attributes.name: network_tier

attributes.name: payment_methodology

attributes.name: plan_signatory_name

attributes.name: prior_auth_impact_flag

attributes.name: provider_signatory_name

attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Law; ERISA Contract Execution Standards

attributes.name: rate_change_pct

attributes.references: CMS Provider Agreement Standards; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: rate_effective_date

attributes.references: CMS Provider Agreement Standards; Facets/QNXT Fee Schedule Configuration

attributes.name: reason

attributes.name: regulatory_mandate_flag

attributes.name: regulatory_reference

attributes.references: CMS Provider Agreement Standards; HHS Regulatory Guidance; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: retroactive_flag

attributes.references: CMS Provider Agreement Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: retroactive_start_date
attributes.description: The earliest date from which retroactive amendment terms apply, when retroactive_flag is true. Defines the claims reprocessing window for financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Agreement Standards; NAIC Model Contract Law

attributes.name: risk_share_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of financial risk shared between the health plan and the provider under risk-sharing or Value-Based Care (VBC) arrangements established by this amendment. Confidential commercial negotiation data.
attributes.references: CMS Shared Savings Program; ACA Section 3022; NAIC Risk-Sharing Standards

attributes.name: sections_modified
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list or narrative description of the specific contract sections, exhibits, or schedules modified by this amendment (e.g., 'Exhibit A - Fee Schedule, Section 4.2 - Term'). Supports targeted audit and compliance review.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Law; Internal Contract Lifecycle Management Policy

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the amendment was formally submitted for internal review and approval. Marks the start of the amendment approval workflow.

attributes.name: title

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule (45 CFR Part 164); NAIC Record Retention Standards

attributes.name: vbc_target_metric
attributes.description: The primary quality or cost performance metric targeted under a Value-Based Care (VBC) or Accountable Care Organization (ACO) arrangement established by this amendment (e.g., HEDIS measure, readmission rate, cost per episode). Applicable when payment_methodology is vbc.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Programs; NCQA HEDIS Measures; ACA Section 3022 (ACO)

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version counter tracking revisions to the amendment record during the drafting and negotiation process. Supports amendment history and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Internal Contract Lifecycle Management Policy; NAIC Record Retention Standards

products.name: fee_schedule
products.description: Master fee schedule defining reimbursement rates for covered services under a provider contract. Captures fee schedule name, version, effective and termination dates, payment basis (% of Medicare, % of billed charges, flat rate, RVU-based), geographic modifier applicability, LOB scope, and fee schedule type (professional, institutional, ancillary, DME, lab). SSOT for all fee-for-service reimbursement rates. Sourced from Facets/QNXT Benefits Configuration.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the fee schedule record in the contract domain. Primary key for the fee_schedule data product.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider contract under which this fee schedule is established. Links the fee schedule to its governing contractual agreement.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific health plan or benefit plan to which this fee schedule is scoped. Enables plan-level fee schedule assignment in Facets/QNXT Benefits Configuration.
attributes.references: Internal Plan Configuration Standards; CMS Plan ID Requirements

attributes.name: ledger_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ledger. Business justification: Fee schedules generate revenue entries that must be posted to a designated ledger for accurate financial statements.

attributes.name: provider_contract_id
attributes.description: FK to contract.provider_contract.provider_contract_id — Fee schedules must resolve to their governing provider contract for rate lookup during claim adjudication and contract compliance auditing.

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider or provider group for whom this fee schedule defines reimbursement rates. Sourced from the Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource).
attributes.references: NPI Registry; NPPES National Plan and Provider Enumeration System

attributes.name: provider_network_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider network (e.g., HMO, PPO, EPO, POS) to which this fee schedule applies. Determines in-network vs. out-of-network reimbursement applicability.
attributes.references: Internal Network Management Standards; CMS Network Adequacy Standards

attributes.name: risk_pool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.pool. Business justification: RATE_DEVELOPMENT: Fee schedules are applied within a specific risk pool; linking enables actuarial rate calculations and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: superseded_by_fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fee_schedule_id of the newer fee schedule that replaced this one when schedule_status is 'superseded'. Enables fee schedule version chain navigation and historical rate lookups.

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the contract amendment that introduced or modified this fee schedule version. Null for the original fee schedule. Enables traceability between fee schedule versions and contract amendments.

attributes.name: anesthesia_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee schedule includes anesthesia service reimbursement, which uses base units plus time units multiplied by a conversion factor rather than standard CPT-based rates.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Anesthesia Guidelines; CMS Anesthesia Fee Schedule

attributes.name: anesthesia_conversion_factor
attributes.description: Dollar amount per anesthesia unit (base units + time units) used to calculate anesthesia reimbursement when anesthesia_applicable is True. Negotiated rate specific to this fee schedule.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Anesthesia Guidelines; CMS Anesthesia Fee Schedule

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fee schedule was formally approved by the authorized contracting officer or governance body. Required for audit and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Contract Governance Policy; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: cms_fee_schedule_year
attributes.description: The CMS Medicare fee schedule calendar year used as the basis or benchmark for this fee schedule when fee_schedule_source is 'cms_medicare'. Enables tracking of which CMS annual update cycle the rates are derived from.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule Annual Updates; CMS IPPS Annual Rule

attributes.name: conversion_factor
attributes.description: Dollar amount multiplied by the total Relative Value Units (RVUs) to calculate the reimbursement amount for RVU-based fee schedules. Applicable when payment_basis is 'rvu_based'. Sourced from CMS RBRVS conversion factor or negotiated contract rate.
attributes.references: CMS RBRVS; AMA RVU Guidelines; CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule

attributes.name: coordination_of_benefits_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether Coordination of Benefits (COB) rules apply to claims adjudicated under this fee schedule. When True, COB logic determines primary vs. secondary payer responsibilities.
attributes.references: NAIC COB Model Regulation; CMS COB Guidelines; HIPAA COB Standards

attributes.name: cpt_code_range_end
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) Code Range End
attributes.description: Ending CPT procedure code in the range of services covered by this fee schedule. Used in conjunction with cpt_code_range_start to define the scope of applicable procedure codes.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Code Set; CMS HCPCS Level II Codes

attributes.name: cpt_code_range_start
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology (CPT) Code Range Start
attributes.description: Starting CPT procedure code in the range of services covered by this fee schedule. Used in conjunction with cpt_code_range_end to define the scope of applicable procedure codes. Null if the fee schedule applies to all CPT codes or uses ICD/DRG-based scoping.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Code Set; CMS HCPCS Level II Codes

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fee schedule record was first created in the system. Audit field capturing the initial record creation event in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Audit Policy; HIPAA Security Rule Audit Controls

attributes.name: drg_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee schedule uses Diagnosis Related Group (DRG)-based reimbursement for inpatient facility claims. When True, DRG weights and base rates govern payment rather than individual procedure codes.
attributes.references: CMS DRG Classification System; CMS IPPS (Inpatient Prospective Payment System)

attributes.name: drg_base_rate
attributes.description: The negotiated base dollar rate per DRG weight unit used for inpatient facility reimbursement when drg_applicable is True. Multiplied by the DRG relative weight to calculate the total inpatient payment.
attributes.references: CMS IPPS DRG Base Rate; CMS Medicare DRG Rates

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fee schedule becomes effective and applicable for claim adjudication and reimbursement calculations. Inclusive start date of the fee schedule validity period.
attributes.references: CMS Fee Schedule Effective Date Standards; HIPAA 837 Transaction Standards

attributes.name: fee_schedule_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the fee schedule, including its purpose, scope, special provisions, or notes relevant to adjudication staff and contract analysts.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_source
attributes.description: Identifies the origin or benchmark source of the fee schedule rates: cms_medicare (based on CMS Medicare fee schedule), cms_medicaid (based on state Medicaid fee schedule), negotiated (directly negotiated with provider), custom (health plan proprietary rates), rbp_benchmark (Reference Based Pricing benchmark).
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule; CMS Medicaid Fee Schedule; Internal Contracting Policy

attributes.name: geographic_modifier_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether geographic adjustment factors (e.g., CMS Geographic Practice Cost Indices - GPCI) are applied to rates under this fee schedule. True when locality-based adjustments are in effect; False for flat national rates.
attributes.references: CMS Geographic Practice Cost Indices (GPCI); CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule

attributes.name: global_surgery_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether global surgery payment rules apply under this fee schedule, bundling pre-operative, intra-operative, and post-operative services into a single reimbursement amount.
attributes.references: CMS Global Surgery Policy; AMA CPT Global Surgery Guidelines

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: Identifies the Line of Business (LOB) to which this fee schedule applies (e.g., commercial, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, ACA Marketplace, COBRA, FEHB). Determines which member populations and plan types are subject to this fee schedule during adjudication.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations; ACA Marketplace Standards; NAIC LOB Classification

attributes.name: locality_code
attributes.description: CMS Medicare locality code identifying the geographic pricing area applicable to this fee schedule when geographic_modifier_applicable is True. Used to apply GPCI adjustments to RVU-based rates.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule Locality Codes; CMS GPCI

attributes.name: medicare_crossover_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fee schedule applies to Medicare crossover claims where Medicare is the primary payer and the health plan is the secondary payer. Relevant for Medicare Advantage and Medigap plans.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Secondary Payer (MSP) Regulations; CMS Crossover Claim Guidelines

attributes.name: modifier_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether CPT or HCPCS modifiers affect reimbursement rates under this fee schedule (e.g., modifier 26 for professional component, modifier TC for technical component, modifier 50 for bilateral procedures).
attributes.references: AMA CPT Modifier Guidelines; CMS HCPCS Modifier Codes

attributes.name: outlier_threshold_amt
attributes.description: Dollar threshold above which a claim qualifies as a cost outlier, triggering additional reimbursement beyond the standard DRG or bundled payment. Applicable for institutional fee schedules with outlier payment provisions.
