attributes.references: CMS IPPS Outlier Payment Policy; CMS Medicare Outlier Regulations

attributes.name: payment_basis
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate reimbursement amounts under this fee schedule. Options include: pct_medicare (percentage of Medicare allowable), pct_billed_charges (percentage of provider billed charges), flat_rate (fixed dollar amount per service), rvu_based (Relative Value Unit-based), bundled (bundled payment for episode of care), capitation (per-member per-month), rbp (Reference Based Pricing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pct_medicare|pct_billed_charges|flat_rate|rvu_based|bundled|capitation|rbp — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule; CMS RBRVS; AMA RVU Guidelines; CMS Bundled Payment Models

attributes.name: payment_basis_pct
attributes.description: The percentage rate applied when payment_basis is 'pct_medicare' or 'pct_billed_charges' (e.g., 110.0000 for 110% of Medicare). Null when payment_basis is flat_rate, rvu_based, bundled, or capitation. Stored as a decimal percentage value.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule; Internal Contracting Policy

attributes.name: prior_authorization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Prior Authorization (PA) is required for services reimbursed under this fee schedule. When True, claims must have an approved PA on file before adjudication at the scheduled rates.
attributes.references: CMS Prior Authorization Rules; URAC Utilization Management Standards; Internal UM Policy

attributes.name: referral_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a primary care physician (PCP) referral is required for services covered under this fee schedule. Applicable primarily for HMO and POS plan types.
attributes.references: Internal Plan Design Standards; CMS HMO Regulations

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the fee schedule within the Core Administration Platform (Facets/QNXT). Used in EDI transactions and cross-system references.
attributes.references: Facets/QNXT Benefits Configuration; HIPAA EDI Standards

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name identifying the fee schedule (e.g., 'Commercial PPO Professional 2024', 'Medicare Advantage Institutional Q1 2024'). Used for display and reporting in Facets/QNXT Benefits Configuration.
attributes.references: Internal Naming Convention; CMS Fee Schedule Standards

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the fee schedule. 'draft' indicates under review; 'active' indicates currently in use for adjudication; 'suspended' indicates temporarily inactive; 'terminated' indicates permanently closed; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version.

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the fee schedule by the type of services covered: professional (physician/practitioner), institutional (hospital/facility), ancillary (therapy/home health), DME (Durable Medical Equipment), lab (laboratory), or pharmacy. Drives claim adjudication logic in Facets/QNXT.
attributes.references: CMS Fee Schedule Classification; AMA CPT Guidelines; CMS DME Fee Schedule

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: Broad clinical or administrative category of services covered by this fee schedule (e.g., 'Evaluation and Management', 'Surgery', 'Radiology', 'Pathology', 'Inpatient Facility', 'Outpatient Facility', 'Home Health', 'Behavioral Health'). Supports fee schedule segmentation and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: evaluation_management|surgery|radiology|pathology|inpatient_facility|outpatient_facility|home_health|behavioral_health|physical_therapy|dme — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AMA CPT Category Structure; CMS Service Category Classifications

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code indicating the geographic scope of this fee schedule. Used for state-specific rate variations and regulatory compliance with State Departments of Insurance (DOI) requirements.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviation Standards; NAIC State Regulation; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: stop_loss_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a stop-loss provision applies to this fee schedule, capping the health plan's reimbursement liability per claim or per member. Relevant for risk-sharing and capitation arrangements.
attributes.references: Internal Contracting Policy; NAIC Stop-Loss Model Act

attributes.name: stop_loss_threshold_amt
attributes.description: Dollar amount per claim or per member above which the stop-loss provision activates, limiting the health plan's reimbursement exposure. Applicable when stop_loss_applicable is True.
attributes.references: Internal Contracting Policy; NAIC Stop-Loss Model Act

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the fee schedule expires and is no longer applicable for claim adjudication. Null indicates an open-ended fee schedule with no defined end date.
attributes.references: CMS Fee Schedule Standards; Internal Contract Lifecycle Management Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fee schedule record was last modified. Audit field supporting change tracking, data lineage, and regulatory audit requirements.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Audit Policy; HIPAA Security Rule Audit Controls

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the fee schedule, enabling tracking of amendments and updates over time (e.g., '1.0', '2.1', '3.0'). Incremented when rates or terms are modified. Supports fee schedule history and audit trail.
attributes.references: Internal Version Control Policy; CMS Fee Schedule Update Cycles

products.name: fee_schedule_rate
products.description: Line-level reimbursement rates within a fee schedule. Each record defines the allowed amount or rate for a specific procedure code (CPT/HCPCS), revenue code, DRG, or service category. Captures procedure code, modifier, place of service, allowed amount, MAC/AWP/WAC reference, RBP rate, effective date, and rate derivation method. Enables adjudication systems to price claims against contracted rates.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each fee schedule rate line record in the contract domain. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider contract under which this fee schedule rate is established. Links the rate line to the governing contractual agreement.

attributes.name: fee_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fee schedule header that this rate line belongs to. Links the rate to its governing fee schedule agreement.
attributes.references: CMS Fee Schedule Standards; HIPAA EDI 835 Transaction

attributes.name: prior_rate_fee_schedule_rate_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the previous version of this rate record that was superseded by the current record. Enables full rate history chain traversal for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: Internal Contract Lifecycle Management; CMS Audit Requirements

attributes.name: allowed_amount
attributes.description: The contracted allowed amount or maximum reimbursable dollar amount for the specified procedure code, modifier, and place of service combination. This is the principal monetary value used by adjudication systems to price claims against contracted rates. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: CMS Fee Schedule; HIPAA 835 ERA Transaction; Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: awp_percent
attributes.description: When rate_derivation_method is AWP_PCT, this field stores the percentage of the Average Wholesale Price (AWP) used to derive the drug or supply reimbursement rate. For example, 0.8500 represents AWP minus 15%. Commonly used in pharmacy and DME fee schedules.
attributes.references: AWP Drug Pricing Standard; CMS Part B Drug Pricing; PBM Contract Terms

attributes.name: bilateral_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate applies to a bilateral procedure (performed on both sides of the body). When true, the allowed amount may be adjusted per CMS bilateral surgery payment rules (150% of the unilateral rate).
attributes.references: CMS Bilateral Surgery Payment Policy; AMA CPT Bilateral Modifier Guidelines

attributes.name: bundled_payment_amount
attributes.description: Single episode-of-care payment amount covering all services within a defined clinical episode (e.g., joint replacement, maternity). Applicable when payment_methodology is BUNDLED. Supports Value-Based Care (VBC) and ACO payment models.
attributes.references: CMS Bundled Payments for Care Improvement (BPCI); VBC Contract Standards; ACO Agreement Terms

attributes.name: capitation_rate_pmpm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capitation Rate Per Member Per Month (PMPM)
attributes.description: Fixed monthly payment per enrolled member paid to a provider under a capitation arrangement, regardless of services rendered. Expressed as a Per Member Per Month (PMPM) dollar amount. Applicable only when payment_methodology is CAPITATION.
attributes.references: CMS Capitation Payment Guidelines; NCQA Standards; Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fee schedule rate record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: HIPAA Audit Requirements; NAIC Record Retention Standards; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: drg_code
attributes.description: CMS Diagnosis Related Group code used for inpatient hospital reimbursement. When the payment methodology is DRG-based, this code identifies the patient classification group that determines the base payment rate.
attributes.references: CMS MS-DRG Grouper; IPPS Final Rule; ICD-10-CM/PCS

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this fee schedule rate becomes effective and applicable for claims adjudication. Claims with service dates on or after this date and before the termination_date will be priced using this rate.
attributes.references: CMS Fee Schedule Effective Date Policy; HIPAA EDI 835; Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market area to which this rate applies. Rates may vary by state, CMS locality, metropolitan statistical area (MSA), or health plan-defined region. Expressed as a state code, CMS locality code, or internal region identifier.
attributes.references: CMS Geographic Practice Cost Index (GPCI); CMS Locality Codes; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: global_surgery_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the global surgery period for surgical procedure codes. Defines the pre-operative and post-operative period during which related services are bundled into the surgical payment (0=endoscopic/minor, 10=minor, 90=major surgery).
attributes.references: CMS Global Surgery Policy; AMA CPT Global Period Guidelines; CMS Claims Processing Manual

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: The Line of Business (LOB) to which this fee schedule rate applies. Rates are often differentiated by LOB as Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial plans have distinct reimbursement structures and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare/Medicaid Program Requirements; ACA Marketplace Rules; NAIC LOB Classification

attributes.name: mac_amount
attributes.description: The Maximum Allowable Cost (MAC) dollar amount set as the ceiling for reimbursement of a specific drug or service. When rate_derivation_method is MAC, this value represents the maximum the plan will pay regardless of billed charges.
attributes.references: MAC Pricing Policy; CMS Drug Pricing Guidelines; NAIC Model Act

attributes.name: max_units_per_day
attributes.description: Maximum number of units of this procedure code that will be reimbursed per day per member. Used to enforce utilization limits during claims adjudication and prevent overbilling.
attributes.references: CMS National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI); Claims Editing Standards

attributes.name: max_units_per_year
attributes.description: Maximum number of units of this procedure code that will be reimbursed per benefit year per member. Enforces annual utilization limits during adjudication for services with frequency restrictions.
attributes.references: CMS Benefit Limitation Policy; ACA Essential Health Benefits; Plan Benefit Design

attributes.name: medicare_fee_schedule_pct
attributes.description: When rate_derivation_method is MEDICARE_PCT, this field stores the percentage of the applicable Medicare fee schedule rate used to derive the allowed amount. For example, 1.1500 represents 115% of Medicare. Used for rate benchmarking and contract analytics.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Physician Fee Schedule (MPFS); CMS OPPS; Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: ncci_edit_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) Edit Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procedure code is subject to National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) bundling edits during claims adjudication. When true, the adjudication system will apply NCCI column 1/column 2 and mutually exclusive code edits.
attributes.references: CMS National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) Policy Manual; HIPAA Claims Processing

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Identifies the provider network tier to which this rate applies. Rates differ by network participation level: IN_NETWORK (contracted), OUT_OF_NETWORK (non-contracted), or tiered preferred network levels (TIER_1, TIER_2, TIER_3, PREFERRED). Drives member cost-sharing calculations.
attributes.references: NCQA Network Adequacy Standards; ACA Network Requirements; Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: payment_methodology
attributes.description: The reimbursement methodology governing how the provider is paid for this service. FFS=Fee-for-Service (fixed allowed amount per procedure), CAPITATION=fixed PMPM regardless of utilization, BUNDLED=single payment for episode of care, DRG=Diagnosis Related Group inpatient payment, PER_DIEM=daily rate for facility stays, PERCENT_OF_BILLED=percentage of submitted charges, RBP=Reference Based Pricing, CASE_RATE=flat rate per case. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FFS|CAPITATION|BUNDLED|DRG|PER_DIEM|PERCENT_OF_BILLED|RBP|CASE_RATE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Reimbursement Methodology; NAIC Model Act; Provider Contract Standards

attributes.name: per_diem_rate
attributes.description: Daily reimbursement rate paid to a facility provider for each day of an inpatient or residential stay. Applicable when payment_methodology is PER_DIEM. May vary by level of care (e.g., ICU vs. medical/surgical).
attributes.references: CMS Inpatient Prospective Payment System; Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: place_of_service_code
attributes.description: CMS two-digit place of service code indicating the setting where the service was rendered (e.g., 11=Office, 21=Inpatient Hospital, 22=Outpatient Hospital, 23=Emergency Room). Rates may vary by place of service.
attributes.references: CMS Place of Service Code Set; HIPAA 837P Transaction

attributes.name: procedure_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Procedural Terminology / Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (CPT/HCPCS) Procedure Code
attributes.description: The CPT or HCPCS procedure code identifying the specific medical service, procedure, or supply for which this rate applies. Core identifier used in claims adjudication to match services to contracted rates.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Code Set; CMS HCPCS Level II; HIPAA Transaction Standards

attributes.name: procedure_code_type
attributes.description: Classifies the coding system used for the procedure_code field. Distinguishes between CPT (physician services), HCPCS Level II (supplies/DME), CDT (dental), ICD-10-PCS (inpatient procedures), Revenue Code (facility billing), DRG (diagnosis-related group), APC (ambulatory payment classification), or NDC (drug). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CPT|HCPCS_II|CDT|ICD_PCS|REVENUE|DRG|APC|NDC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AMA CPT; CMS HCPCS; WHO ICD-10-PCS; CMS DRG Grouper; CMS APC

attributes.name: procedure_modifier_1
attributes.description: First CPT or HCPCS modifier code appended to the procedure code to indicate special circumstances affecting the service (e.g., bilateral procedure, assistant surgeon, professional component). Modifiers can alter the allowed reimbursement amount.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Modifier Guidelines; CMS HCPCS Modifier Policy

attributes.name: procedure_modifier_2
attributes.description: Second CPT or HCPCS modifier code when multiple modifiers apply to the same procedure code. Used in conjunction with procedure_modifier_1 for complex billing scenarios.
attributes.references: AMA CPT Modifier Guidelines; CMS HCPCS Modifier Policy

attributes.name: product_type
attributes.description: The health plan product type to which this rate applies. HMO=Health Maintenance Organization, PPO=Preferred Provider Organization, EPO=Exclusive Provider Organization, POS=Point of Service, HDHP=High Deductible Health Plan, INDEMNITY=traditional indemnity plan. Rates may vary by product type.
attributes.references: NAIC Health Plan Product Classification; ACA QHP Standards; DOI Regulations

attributes.name: provider_type
attributes.description: Classification of the provider type to which this rate applies. Distinguishes between physician/professional services, facility (hospital/SNF), ancillary services, Durable Medical Equipment (DME) suppliers, pharmacy, and behavioral health providers.
attributes.references: NUCC Provider Taxonomy; CMS Provider Classification; HIPAA NPI Registry

attributes.name: rate_derivation_method
attributes.description: Describes how the allowed amount was derived or calculated. MEDICARE_PCT=percentage of Medicare fee schedule, AWP_PCT=percentage of Average Wholesale Price, WAC_PCT=percentage of Wholesale Acquisition Cost, MAC=Maximum Allowable Cost, RBP=Reference Based Pricing benchmark, NEGOTIATED=directly negotiated flat rate, COST_PLUS=cost plus margin, BILLED_PCT=percent of billed charges. Critical for audit and rate validation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MEDICARE_PCT|AWP_PCT|WAC_PCT|MAC|RBP|NEGOTIATED|COST_PLUS|BILLED_PCT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Fee Schedule; AWP/WAC Drug Pricing Standards; MAC Policy; RBP Methodology

attributes.name: rate_line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number identifying the position of this rate record within the parent fee schedule. Used for ordering and referencing individual rate lines.

attributes.name: rate_note
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context about this fee schedule rate, such as special billing instructions, exceptions, or conditions under which the rate applies. Used by contracting and claims operations staff.

attributes.name: rate_percent_of_billed
attributes.description: Reimbursement rate expressed as a percentage of the provider's billed charges, used when the payment methodology is percent-of-billed rather than a fixed allowed amount. For example, 0.8500 represents 85% of billed charges.
attributes.references: Provider Contract Terms; CMS Reimbursement Methodology Guidelines

attributes.name: rate_source
attributes.description: Identifies the origin or source of this fee schedule rate. CONTRACT=directly negotiated in provider contract, CMS_PUBLISHED=derived from published CMS fee schedule, CROSSWALK=mapped from another code or schedule, MANUAL=manually entered by contracting staff, SYSTEM_GENERATED=automatically generated by the fee schedule management system.
attributes.references: Internal Fee Schedule Management Standards; CMS Fee Schedule Publication

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this fee schedule rate record. ACTIVE=currently in effect and used for adjudication, INACTIVE=not currently in use, PENDING=approved but not yet effective, SUPERSEDED=replaced by a newer rate version, TERMINATED=permanently ended.
attributes.references: Internal Contract Lifecycle Management Standards; CMS Fee Schedule Administration

attributes.name: rate_version
attributes.description: Incrementing version number tracking amendments and updates to this fee schedule rate line. Version 1 is the original rate; subsequent amendments increment this counter. Supports rate history and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Internal Contract Amendment Standards; CMS Fee Schedule Version Control

attributes.name: rbp_reference_amount
attributes.description: The benchmark dollar amount used as the basis for Reference Based Pricing (RBP) reimbursement. Typically anchored to Medicare rates or a cost-based benchmark. The actual allowed amount is derived as a percentage of this reference amount.
attributes.references: RBP Methodology Standards; CMS Medicare Benchmark; Provider Contract Terms

attributes.name: revenue_code
attributes.description: Four-digit UB-04 revenue code identifying the type of accommodation, ancillary service, or billing classification for facility claims. Used in conjunction with or as an alternative to procedure codes for hospital and facility fee schedule rates.
attributes.references: NUBC UB-04 Revenue Code Set; CMS Hospital Outpatient Prospective Payment System

attributes.name: service_category
attributes.description: Broad clinical or administrative category grouping the service type covered by this rate (e.g., Evaluation and Management, Surgery, Radiology, Laboratory, Anesthesia, Durable Medical Equipment, Behavioral Health, Preventive Care). Used for rate analytics and reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AMA CPT Category Structure; CMS Benefit Category Definitions

attributes.name: specialty_code
attributes.description: CMS three-digit provider specialty code indicating the clinical specialty for which this rate applies. Rates may be differentiated by provider specialty (e.g., 01=General Practice, 06=Cardiology, 93=Emergency Medicine). Null if rate applies to all specialties.
attributes.references: CMS Provider Specialty Code List; NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code identifying the state jurisdiction in which this fee schedule rate is applicable. Used for state-specific rate differentiation and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviation Standard; NAIC State Jurisdiction; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which this fee schedule rate expires and is no longer applicable for claims adjudication. Null indicates the rate is open-ended with no defined end date. Claims with service dates after this date will not be priced using this rate.
attributes.references: CMS Fee Schedule Policy; Provider Contract Terms; HIPAA EDI 835

attributes.name: units_of_service
attributes.description: The number of units of service to which the allowed_amount applies. For most procedure codes, this is 1 unit. For time-based codes or quantity-based services, this may represent the standard unit quantity (e.g., 15-minute increments for therapy codes).
attributes.references: AMA CPT Unit Billing Guidelines; CMS Claims Processing Manual

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this fee schedule rate record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update for change management, audit trail, and data synchronization purposes. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: HIPAA Audit Requirements; NAIC Record Retention Standards; Internal Data Governance

products.name: capitation_arrangement
products.description: Defines capitation payment arrangements where providers receive a fixed PMPM (Per Member Per Month) payment to cover a defined scope of services. Captures capitation rate, covered service categories, risk pool participation, stop-loss thresholds, carve-out services, attributed member population criteria, LOB applicability, and payment frequency. Supports HMO and managed care capitation models.

attributes.name: capitation_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the capitation arrangement record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent provider contract under which this capitation arrangement is established. Links to the contract master record.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Capitation arrangements are budgeted and tracked via a cost center to manage per‑member‑per‑month payments and related expenses.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the health plan or benefit plan product associated with this capitation arrangement. Determines the member population eligible for attribution.
attributes.references: CMS Plan Benefit Package (PBP) Requirements; ACA Section 1301

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capitated provider or provider group receiving the Per Member Per Month (PMPM) payment under this arrangement.
attributes.references: CMS NPI Registry; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 162

attributes.name: risk_pool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.pool. Business justification: CAPITATION_PAYMENT: Each capitation arrangement draws funding from a designated risk pool for compliance and financial reporting.

attributes.name: aco_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capitation arrangement is part of an Accountable Care Organization (ACO) or integrated delivery network model, which may have additional shared savings or risk-sharing components.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Shared Savings Program 42 CFR Part 425; CMS Innovation Center ACO Models

attributes.name: aggregate_stop_loss_threshold
attributes.description: Total dollar amount for the attributed member population above which the health plan assumes financial responsibility for claims costs. Protects the provider from population-level adverse risk. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; NAIC Stop-Loss Model Act

attributes.name: amendment_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the most recent contract amendment that modified this capitation arrangement. Tracks the amendment history for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438

attributes.name: annual_rate_escalator
attributes.description: Contractually agreed annual percentage increase applied to the PMPM rate at each rate renewal period (e.g., 3.50 for 3.5% annual escalation). Used for multi-year capitation arrangements.
attributes.references: CMS Actuarial Soundness Requirements 42 CFR Part 438.4; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the capitation arrangement was formally approved by the health plan's contracting authority. Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the contracting authority who approved this capitation arrangement. Supports audit trail and delegation-of-authority compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; SOC 2 Type II Audit Requirements

attributes.name: arrangement_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the capitation arrangement (e.g., 'Primary Care Capitation - HMO Commercial 2024'), used in reporting and provider communications.

attributes.name: arrangement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the capitation arrangement, used in provider communications, payment remittances, and reconciliation processes. Assigned by the Core Administration Platform (Facets/QNXT).
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438

attributes.name: arrangement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the capitation arrangement. Controls whether PMPM payments are generated and whether members can be attributed to this arrangement.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438

attributes.name: arrangement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the capitation arrangement by scope of covered services. Global capitation covers all services; primary care capitation covers PCP services only; specialty capitation covers specialist services; institutional covers facility-based care. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: global_capitation|primary_care_capitation|specialty_capitation|institutional_capitation|behavioral_health_capitation|pharmacy_capitation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; NCQA Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: attributed_member_count
attributes.description: Current number of members attributed to this capitation arrangement for the active payment period. Used to calculate total monthly capitation payment disbursement.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; NCQA Attribution Methodology Standards

attributes.name: attribution_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to attribute members to this capitation arrangement. PCP assignment uses enrollment data; claims-based uses plurality of visits; voluntary selection allows member choice; geographic assigns by service area.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Shared Savings Program Attribution Rules; NCQA PCMH Standards

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capitation arrangement automatically renews at the end of the contract term unless either party provides notice of termination within the contractually specified notice period.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Contract Filing Requirements

attributes.name: carve_out_services
attributes.description: Description of services explicitly excluded from the capitation scope and reimbursed separately (e.g., 'Mental Health, Substance Abuse, Transplants, Neonatal ICU'). Carve-outs are paid fee-for-service or under separate capitation arrangements.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capitation arrangement record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory compliance requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.312 Audit Controls; SOC 2 Type II; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the capitation arrangement becomes binding and PMPM payments begin. Aligns with the contract effective period.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: geographic_service_area
attributes.description: Description or code of the geographic service area (county, state, or region) within which this capitation arrangement applies. Members outside this area may not be attributed to this arrangement.
attributes.references: CMS Service Area Requirements 42 CFR Part 422.2; State DOI Service Area Filings

attributes.name: individual_stop_loss_threshold
attributes.description: Dollar amount per member per year above which the health plan assumes financial responsibility for claims costs, protecting the provider from catastrophic individual member costs. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; NAIC Stop-Loss Model Act

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: Line of Business to which this capitation arrangement applies (e.g., Commercial HMO, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid Managed Care). Determines regulatory requirements and rate-setting methodology.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR Part 422; CMS Medicaid Managed Care 42 CFR Part 438; ACA Section 1301

attributes.name: network_tier
attributes.description: Network tier classification of the provider under this capitation arrangement. Tier 1 providers typically receive higher capitation rates in exchange for meeting quality and cost-efficiency benchmarks.
attributes.references: CMS Network Adequacy Standards 42 CFR Part 438.68; NCQA Network Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which capitation payments are disbursed to the provider. Monthly is standard for most capitation arrangements; quarterly or annual may apply for certain specialty or institutional arrangements.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: payment_methodology
attributes.description: Specific payment calculation methodology applied to this capitation arrangement. Pure capitation pays flat PMPM; withhold arrangements retain a percentage pending performance; risk-adjusted capitation applies RAF multipliers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pure_capitation|capitation_with_withhold|capitation_with_bonus|risk_adjusted_capitation|tiered_capitation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Risk Adjustment 42 CFR Part 422.308; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications

attributes.name: pmpm_rate
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount paid to the provider per attributed member per calendar month, regardless of services rendered. The core financial parameter of the capitation arrangement. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: CMS Actuarial Soundness Requirements 42 CFR Part 438.4; NAIC Model Actuarial Standards

attributes.name: pmpm_rate_currency
attributes.business_glossary_term: Per Member Per Month (PMPM) Rate Currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the PMPM rate (typically USD for domestic health plans). Required for multi-currency reporting and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: quality_withhold_release_criteria
attributes.description: Description of the quality performance benchmarks or HEDIS/STAR measure thresholds that must be met for the provider to receive release of withheld capitation amounts. Defines the performance contract terms.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Star Ratings Methodology; CMS Medicare Advantage Quality Bonus Program

attributes.name: raf_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the base PMPM rate to account for the relative health risk of the attributed member population. A RAF above 1.0 indicates a sicker-than-average population; below 1.0 indicates healthier-than-average.
attributes.references: CMS HCC Risk Adjustment Model; CMS RAPS/EDPS Submission Requirements

attributes.name: rate_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current PMPM rate became effective. Supports rate history tracking when rates are renegotiated mid-contract without creating a new arrangement record.
attributes.references: CMS Actuarial Soundness Requirements 42 CFR Part 438.4; NAIC Model Actuarial Standards

attributes.name: rate_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current PMPM rate expires and is subject to renegotiation or automatic escalation. Null if the rate is open-ended for the arrangement term.
attributes.references: CMS Actuarial Soundness Requirements 42 CFR Part 438.4; NAIC Model Actuarial Standards

attributes.name: risk_adjustment_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PMPM rate is subject to risk adjustment based on the attributed member population's Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) scores. Applicable primarily for Medicare Advantage and ACA Exchange arrangements.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment 42 CFR Part 422.308; HHS HCC Risk Adjustment Methodology

attributes.name: risk_pool_participant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the provider participates in a shared risk pool under this capitation arrangement. Risk pool participants share in surpluses or deficits relative to the capitation budget.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; NAIC Model Risk-Sharing Standards

attributes.name: risk_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of risk pool surplus or deficit allocated to the provider under this capitation arrangement. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Applicable only when risk_pool_participant is True.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; NAIC Model Risk-Sharing Standards

attributes.name: service_category_scope
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list or narrative description of the covered service categories included under this capitation arrangement (e.g., 'Primary Care, Preventive Services, Lab, Radiology'). Defines the scope of services the provider is financially responsible for under capitation.
attributes.references: CMS Essential Health Benefits 45 CFR Part 156; NCQA Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this capitation arrangement record was sourced (e.g., FACETS, QNXT for Core Administration Platform; CACTUS or PROVIDER_SOURCE for Provider Management System).
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; EDI HIPAA 834 Transaction Standards

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the operational source system (Facets, QNXT, or Provider Management System) for this capitation arrangement. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and back-referencing to the system of record.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164 Audit Controls

attributes.name: stop_loss_type
attributes.description: Type of stop-loss protection included in the capitation arrangement. Individual stop-loss limits exposure per member; aggregate stop-loss limits total population exposure; both applies both thresholds.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; NAIC Stop-Loss Model Act

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the capitation arrangement ends and PMPM payments cease. Null for open-ended arrangements. Distinct from contract termination date when partial termination applies.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; NAIC Model Contract Standards

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days advance notice required by either party to terminate this capitation arrangement without cause. Typically 90–180 days for managed care capitation contracts.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; NAIC Model Contract Standards; State DOI Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capitation arrangement record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change data capture, incremental processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: HIPAA 45 CFR Part 164.312 Audit Controls; SOC 2 Type II; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: vbc_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capitation arrangement includes Value-Based Care (VBC) performance incentive components such as quality bonuses, shared savings, or outcome-based adjustments beyond the base PMPM.
attributes.references: CMS Innovation Center VBC Models; NCQA HEDIS Quality Measures

attributes.name: withhold_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the PMPM rate withheld from each payment cycle pending performance or quality metric achievement. Withheld amounts are returned upon meeting contractual benchmarks. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00).
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Quality Bonus Program; NCQA HEDIS Performance Standards

products.name: capitation_payment
products.description: Transactional record of each capitation payment disbursed to a provider under a capitation arrangement. Captures payment period (month/year), attributed member count, PMPM rate applied, gross payment amount, adjustments (retroactive enrollment changes, risk pool settlements, stop-loss recoveries), net payment amount, payment date, payment status, and remittance advice reference. Feeds accounts payable, provider remittance reporting (835 ERA), and contract financial summary reconciliation.

attributes.name: capitation_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each capitation payment disbursement record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Ensures each capitation payment is tied to the employee who authorized it, supporting payment audit and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: capitation_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific capitation arrangement or rate schedule within the contract, identifying the applicable PMPM rate table, risk pool configuration, and attributed population definition.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; NAIC Model Managed Care Plan Network Adequacy Act

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capitation contract under which this payment is made. Links to the provider contract master defining the capitation arrangement, PMPM rates, and risk-sharing terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the health plan or benefit product under which the attributed members are enrolled. Determines the applicable benefit structure and capitation rate tier.
attributes.references: CMS Plan Benefit Package (PBP) Standards; ACA Section 1301 QHP Requirements

attributes.name: original_payment_capitation_payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original capitation payment record that this record adjusts, reverses, or supplements. Populated only when prior_period_adjustment_flag is True. Enables audit trail linking of adjustment chains.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438.6; GAAP ASC 954; Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: provider_id
attributes.description: Reference to the provider (PCP, specialist group, IPA, or ACO) receiving the capitation payment. Corresponds to the credentialed provider entity in the Provider Management System (Cactus/ProviderSource).
attributes.references: NPI Registry; CMS Provider Enrollment; NAIC Provider Standards

attributes.name: ap_voucher_number
attributes.description: Accounts Payable (AP) voucher or invoice number assigned in Oracle Financials when the capitation payment is posted as a payable. Links the capitation disbursement to the AP subledger for financial reporting and audit trail.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 954; SAP Statement 107; Oracle Financials AP Module Standards

attributes.name: attributed_member_count
attributes.description: Total number of members attributed to the provider for the payment period. This is the primary driver of the gross capitation payment calculation (attributed_member_count × pmpm_rate = gross_payment_amount).
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438.6; NCQA Attribution Methodology Standards

attributes.name: capitation_rate_tier
attributes.description: Rate tier or member category applied to determine the PMPM rate for this payment (e.g., adult, pediatric, senior, ESRD, dual-eligible). Different member demographics may attract different PMPM rates under the same contract.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438.6; CMS Medicare Advantage Rate Announcement

attributes.name: check_eft_trace_number
attributes.description: Check number or EFT/ACH trace number assigned by the financial institution for the actual disbursement of this capitation payment. Used for bank reconciliation in Oracle Financials (AP module) and provider payment dispute resolution.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation E; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capitation payment record was first created in the Silver Layer data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SLA monitoring for payment processing cycles.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 164; SOC 2 Type II Audit Standards; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this capitation payment record. Typically USD for domestic health insurance operations. Required for multi-currency financial reconciliation and GAAP/SAP reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP ASC 830 Foreign Currency; SAP Statement 23

attributes.name: enrollment_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar adjustment to the gross payment resulting from retroactive enrollment changes (late enrollments, disenrollments, or eligibility corrections) identified after the initial payment calculation. Can be positive (additional payment) or negative (recoupment).
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438.6; HIPAA 834 Transaction Standards

attributes.name: gl_cost_center
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) cost center code in Oracle Financials to which this capitation payment expense is allocated. Supports financial reporting by LOB, product, and organizational unit per GAAP and SAP statutory reporting requirements.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 954; SAP Statement 107; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Oracle Financials GL Standards

attributes.name: gross_payment_amount
attributes.description: Total gross capitation payment amount before any adjustments, calculated as attributed_member_count multiplied by the pmpm_rate. Represents the base payment obligation for the period prior to retroactive enrollment changes, risk pool withholds, or stop-loss recoveries.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438.6; GAAP ASC 954; SAP Statement 107

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Line of Business (LOB) under which the capitation payment is made. Determines regulatory requirements, rate-setting methodology, and CMS reporting obligations applicable to the payment.
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage Regulations 42 CFR Part 422; CMS Medicaid Managed Care 42 CFR Part 438; ACA Section 1301

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Final net amount disbursed to the provider after all adjustments: gross_payment_amount + enrollment_adjustment_amount - risk_pool_withhold_amount + stop_loss_recovery_amount + other_adjustment_amount. This is the actual amount reflected in the 835 ERA remittance advice.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 835 ERA Transaction Standard; GAAP ASC 954; SAP Statement 107

attributes.name: other_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Catch-all adjustment amount for miscellaneous contractual adjustments not captured in enrollment, risk pool, or stop-loss categories. Includes quality bonus payments, performance incentive adjustments, or administrative fee offsets per contract terms.
attributes.references: CMS Value-Based Care Program Standards; NAIC Model Managed Care Standards

attributes.name: payment_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the capitation payment was formally approved for disbursement by the authorized approver in the billing or finance system. Supports segregation of duties controls and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 164; SOC 1 Type II Controls; GAAP Internal Control Standards

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Actual date the capitation payment was disbursed to the provider via EFT, check, or ACH. Used for accounts payable reconciliation and provider remittance reporting.
attributes.references: ERISA Section 503; CMS Prompt Payment Standards; NAIC Prompt Pay Model Act

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Mechanism by which the capitation payment was or will be disbursed to the provider. EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer) and ACH (Automated Clearing House) are most common for capitation arrangements.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules; CMS Electronic Payment Standards

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this capitation payment disbursement, used in provider remittance advice (835 ERA), accounts payable records, and provider portal references. Format: CAP-YYYYMM-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 835 ERA Transaction Standard; CMS Remittance Advice Standards

attributes.name: payment_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last day of the coverage month or period for which this capitation payment is being made. Typically the last day of the calendar month in monthly capitation cycles.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438.6; NAIC Model Managed Care Standards

attributes.name: payment_period_start_date
attributes.description: First day of the coverage month or period for which this capitation payment is being made. Typically the first day of the calendar month in monthly capitation cycles.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438.6; NAIC Model Managed Care Standards

attributes.name: payment_run_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the capitation payment run or batch cycle that generated this payment record. Used to group all payments processed in the same cycle for reconciliation, audit, and reprocessing purposes in the Core Administration Platform (Facets/QNXT).
attributes.references: Internal Payment Processing Standards; CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the capitation payment disbursement. 'pending' = calculated but not yet approved; 'approved' = authorized for payment; 'paid' = disbursed to provider; 'voided' = cancelled before disbursement; 'reversed' = clawed back after disbursement; 'on_hold' = suspended pending investigation or contract dispute.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Managed Care Standards; CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the capitation payment by its business purpose. 'standard' = routine monthly capitation; 'retroactive' = payment for prior periods due to enrollment changes; 'adjustment' = correction to a previously issued payment; 'stop_loss_recovery' = reimbursement under stop-loss provisions; 'risk_pool_settlement' = periodic risk pool distribution or withhold settlement.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438.6; NAIC Risk-Sharing Model Standards

attributes.name: pmpm_rate
attributes.description: Per Member Per Month (PMPM) capitation rate applied for this payment period, as defined in the contract rate schedule. This is the contractually negotiated amount paid per attributed member per month. Classified confidential as it represents proprietary contract pricing.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438.6; NAIC Model Managed Care Plan Standards; ERISA Section 408

attributes.name: prior_period_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capitation payment includes or represents an adjustment to a prior payment period. True when the payment corrects or supplements a previously issued capitation payment due to retroactive enrollment changes or rate corrections.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438.6; GAAP ASC 954 Prior Period Adjustments

attributes.name: quality_withhold_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld from the capitation payment pending achievement of quality performance targets (e.g., HEDIS measures, STAR ratings thresholds). Released or forfeited at the end of the performance measurement period based on provider quality scores.
attributes.references: CMS STAR Ratings Program; NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS Medicare Advantage Quality Bonus Payment Program

attributes.name: remittance_advice_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the 835 Electronic Remittance Advice (ERA) transaction sent to the provider for this capitation payment. Used to reconcile capitation disbursements with provider accounts receivable and the EDI clearinghouse (Availity/Change Healthcare) transaction log.
attributes.references: HIPAA ASC X12 835 ERA Transaction Standard; CMS Remittance Advice Standards

attributes.name: risk_adjusted_pmpm_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Risk-Adjusted Per Member Per Month (PMPM) Rate
attributes.description: PMPM rate after application of the risk adjustment factor (RAF score) to the base contractual PMPM rate. Reflects the risk-adjusted capitation amount per member per month for Medicare Advantage or risk-adjusted commercial arrangements.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Methodology; 42 CFR Part 422 Subpart G; CMS Medicare Advantage Rate Announcement

attributes.name: risk_pool_withhold_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld from the gross capitation payment and placed into a shared risk pool per the contract terms. Risk pool withholds are held and distributed (or forfeited) at the end of the risk settlement period based on actual utilization versus targets.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438.6; NAIC Risk-Sharing Model Standards

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Aggregate Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) score for the attributed member population used to adjust the capitation rate for this payment period. Derived from Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) coding and CMS Risk Adjustment Processing System (RAPS/EDPS) submissions.
attributes.references: CMS Risk Adjustment Methodology; HCC Model; RAPS/EDPS Submission Standards; 42 CFR Part 422 Subpart G

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this capitation payment record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and reconciliation between the Core Administration Platform (Facets/QNXT), Billing System (HealthEdge), and Oracle Financials.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 164; Internal Data Governance Standards; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: source_system_payment_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this capitation payment record in the originating operational system (Facets, QNXT, or HealthEdge). Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing between the Silver Layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 164

attributes.name: stop_loss_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Amount recovered from or credited to the provider under stop-loss provisions of the capitation contract. Positive values indicate plan reimbursement to provider for catastrophic cases exceeding the stop-loss threshold; negative values indicate provider liability adjustments.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438.6; NAIC Stop-Loss Insurance Model Act

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capitation payment record was last modified in the Silver Layer data platform. Tracks the most recent update for change data capture (CDC), audit trail, and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: HIPAA Security Rule 45 CFR Part 164; SOC 2 Type II Audit Standards; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: vbc_contract_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capitation payment is made under a Value-Based Care (VBC) or Accountable Care Organization (ACO) contract arrangement, as opposed to a standard fee-for-service capitation. Drives VBC performance reporting and quality incentive calculations.
attributes.references: CMS Innovation Center VBC Models; CMS ACO Regulations 42 CFR Part 425; NCQA VBC Standards

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Business reason code or description explaining why this capitation payment was voided or reversed. Populated only when payment_status is 'voided' or 'reversed'. Examples: contract_termination, duplicate_payment, enrollment_error, rate_correction.
attributes.references: CMS Managed Care Regulations 42 CFR Part 438; NAIC Model Managed Care Standards; Internal Audit Standards

products.name: vbc_contract
products.description: Master record for Value-Based Care (VBC) contracts, ACO agreements, risk-sharing arrangements, and bundled payment programs. Captures VBC model type (shared savings, shared risk, full capitation, bundled payment, pay-for-performance), ACO/IPA entity details, and reconciliation status. Includes performance period definitions with performance year, benchmark expenditure target, actual expenditure, quality score, shared savings or loss amount, reconciliation status, settlement date, minimum savings rate (MSR), maximum shared savings/loss rate, and quality gate requirements (HEDIS/STAR measure targets). For bundled payment models, captures episode definitions including episode type (joint replacement, cardiac surgery, maternity), trigger event (procedure code, DRG), episode window (days pre/post trigger), target price, included/excluded services, reconciliation methodology, and quality metrics. Supports CMS MSSP, BPCI-A, and commercial ACO/VBC reporting. SSOT for all VBC, risk-sharing, episode-based payment contractual structures, performance period tracking, bundled episode definitions, and year-over-year performance trend analysis.

attributes.name: vbc_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Value-Based Care (VBC) contract record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for all VBC contract master records including ACO agreements, shared savings, bundled payment, and risk-sharing arrangements.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Program; BPCI-A Program Guidelines

attributes.name: contract_provider_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.provider_contract. Business justification: VBC contracts are a subtype of provider contracts; linking them centralizes contract metadata and removes redundant columns.

attributes.name: health_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to plan.health_plan. Business justification: Required for Value‑Based Contract performance reporting per plan; VBC contracts are negotiated per health plan and need plan_id to generate plan‑specific shared‑savings reports.

attributes.name: risk_pool_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to risk.pool. Business justification: VBC_REPORTING: Value‑based contracts calculate shared savings against a risk pool; required for performance and settlement reports.

attributes.name: aco_cms_identifier
attributes.description: CMS-assigned unique identifier for the ACO participating in the Medicare Shared Savings Program (MSSP) or other CMS Innovation Center models. Required for RAPS/EDPS submissions and CMS regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP 42 CFR §425.118; CMS ACO Public Reporting

attributes.name: aco_entity_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Accountable Care Organization (ACO) / Independent Practice Association (IPA) Entity Name
attributes.description: Legal name of the ACO, IPA, or provider organization that is the counterparty to this VBC contract. Used for regulatory reporting to CMS, network directory maintenance, and reconciliation settlement correspondence.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP ACO Participation Agreement; 42 CFR §425; NCQA ACO Accreditation

attributes.name: aco_entity_tin
attributes.business_glossary_term: ACO / IPA Entity Tax Identification Number (TIN)
attributes.description: Federal Tax Identification Number (TIN/EIN) of the ACO or IPA entity party to this contract. Required for CMS regulatory submissions, 1099 reporting, and settlement payment processing.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1635; CMS MSSP Reporting Requirements; HIPAA §1173

attributes.name: actual_expenditure
attributes.description: Total actual claims expenditure (in USD) incurred by attributed members or episode participants during the performance period. Compared against the benchmark expenditure target to determine shared savings or shared loss amounts.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Financial Reconciliation (42 CFR §425.604); BPCI-A Reconciliation Methodology

attributes.name: amendment_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent contract amendment became effective. Used to determine which contract terms apply to claims and reconciliation calculations for a given service date.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; CMS MSSP Amendment Process

attributes.name: attributed_member_count
attributes.description: Number of health plan members attributed to this VBC contract/ACO entity for the current performance period. Used as the denominator for PMPM calculations, benchmark setting, and population health reporting.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Attribution Methodology (42 CFR §425.400); CMMI Attribution Rules

attributes.name: attribution_methodology
attributes.description: Method used to assign health plan members to this VBC contract/ACO entity for performance measurement. Prospective: members assigned at start of period based on prior utilization; Retrospective: members assigned at end of period based on actual utilization; Voluntary: member elects assignment.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Attribution (42 CFR §425.400); CMMI Attribution Methodology; NCQA ACO Accreditation Standards

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this VBC contract is configured to automatically renew at the end of the current term without requiring a new execution. True = auto-renews; False = requires affirmative renewal action.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Standards; CMS MSSP Participation Agreement Renewal Terms

attributes.name: benchmark_expenditure_target
attributes.description: The risk-adjusted, trend-adjusted target expenditure amount (in USD) against which actual expenditures are compared during reconciliation. Calculated using historical claims data, risk scores (HCC/RAF), and applicable trend factors per the contract methodology.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Benchmark Methodology (42 CFR §425.600); BPCI-A Target Price Methodology; CMMI Benchmark Setting Guidelines

attributes.name: cms_program_track
attributes.description: Specific CMS Innovation Center program track or model under which this contract operates (e.g., 'MSSP_BASIC_A', 'MSSP_BASIC_E', 'MSSP_ENHANCED', 'BPCI_A', 'CJR', 'PCF'). Null for commercial VBC contracts not affiliated with a CMS program. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MSSP_BASIC_A|MSSP_BASIC_B|MSSP_BASIC_C|MSSP_BASIC_D|MSSP_BASIC_E|MSSP_ENHANCED|BPCI_A|CJR|PCF|DCE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS MSSP 42 CFR §425; CMS BPCI-A Program; CMS CJR Model; CMMI Innovation Models

attributes.name: contract_amendment_number
attributes.description: Sequential identifier for the most recent amendment to this VBC contract (e.g., 'AMD-003'). Tracks contract modifications including rate changes, term extensions, quality measure updates, and risk arrangement adjustments. Null for original, unamended contracts.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Contract Amendment Standards; CMS MSSP Participation Agreement Amendment Process

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VBC contract record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record-keeping. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.312(b) Audit Controls; NAIC Data Governance Standards; SOC 2 Type II Audit Requirements

attributes.name: episode_target_price
attributes.description: The risk-adjusted target price (in USD) for a single bundled payment episode. Calculated from historical claims data with applicable discounts and trend adjustments. Actual episode expenditures are compared to this target for reconciliation. Null for non-bundled VBC models.
attributes.references: CMS BPCI-A Target Price Methodology; CMS CJR Target Price Calculation; CMMI Bundled Payment Pricing

attributes.name: episode_trigger_code
attributes.description: The CPT procedure code or DRG (Diagnosis Related Group) code that initiates a bundled payment episode. For example, DRG 470 triggers a major joint replacement episode under BPCI-A. Null for non-bundled VBC models.
attributes.references: CMS BPCI-A Episode Trigger Definitions; AMA CPT Code Set; CMS DRG Grouper; ICD-10-PCS

attributes.name: episode_type
attributes.description: For bundled payment contracts, the clinical episode category being bundled (e.g., 'joint_replacement', 'cardiac_surgery', 'maternity', 'hip_fracture', 'spinal_fusion'). Null for non-bundled VBC models. Determines the trigger event, episode window, and target price methodology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: joint_replacement|cardiac_surgery|maternity|hip_fracture|spinal_fusion|pneumonia|copd|stroke — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS BPCI-A Episode Definitions; CMS Comprehensive Care for Joint Replacement (CJR) Model; CMMI Bundled Payment Models

attributes.name: episode_window_days
attributes.description: Total number of days in the bundled payment episode window, measured from the trigger event (e.g., 90 days post-discharge for BPCI-A). Defines the period during which all included services are attributed to the bundle for reconciliation.
attributes.references: CMS BPCI-A Episode Window Definition; CMS CJR Model Episode Definition; CMMI Bundled Payment Design

attributes.name: hedis_measure_targets
attributes.business_glossary_term: Healthcare Effectiveness Data and Information Set (HEDIS) / STAR Measure Targets
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of HEDIS or CMS STAR measure identifiers and their contractual target thresholds included as quality gate requirements for this VBC contract (e.g., 'CBP:75.0|CDC-HbA1c:80.0|W34:85.0'). Supports quality performance monitoring and NCQA reporting.
attributes.references: NCQA HEDIS Technical Specifications; CMS STAR Ratings Methodology; CMS MSSP Quality Measure Set

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Line of business under which this VBC contract operates. Determines applicable regulatory framework, benchmark methodology, and quality measure set (e.g., HEDIS for commercial, STAR for Medicare Advantage, MSSP for fee-for-service Medicare). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commercial|medicare_advantage|medicaid|mssp|bpci_a|exchange|dual_eligible — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CMS Medicare Advantage (42 CFR §422); CMS MSSP (42 CFR §425); ACA §1311; NAIC LOB Classification

attributes.name: max_shared_loss_rate
attributes.description: The maximum percentage of benchmark expenditure (expressed as a decimal) that can be assessed as shared loss against the ACO/provider entity. Caps the provider's downside financial exposure in two-sided risk arrangements.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Shared Loss Cap (42 CFR §425.606); CMMI Two-Sided Risk Parameters

attributes.name: max_shared_savings_rate
attributes.description: The maximum percentage of benchmark expenditure (expressed as a decimal) that can be distributed as shared savings to the ACO/provider entity, regardless of actual savings achieved. Caps the health plan's financial exposure on the upside.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Shared Savings Cap (42 CFR §425.604(d)); CMMI Model Design Parameters

attributes.name: minimum_loss_rate
attributes.description: The minimum percentage threshold (expressed as a decimal) by which actual expenditures must exceed the benchmark before any shared loss is assessed. Applicable to two-sided risk arrangements. Symmetric counterpart to the Minimum Savings Rate (MSR).
attributes.references: CMS MSSP MLR Definition (42 CFR §425.558); CMMI Two-Sided Risk Model

attributes.name: minimum_savings_rate
attributes.description: The minimum percentage threshold (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.02 = 2%) by which actual expenditures must fall below the benchmark before any shared savings are distributed. Protects against random variation triggering unearned payments. Required field for MSSP Track 1 and Track 1+ contracts.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP MSR Definition (42 CFR §425.556); CMMI MSR Methodology

attributes.name: performance_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the current performance measurement period. Marks the close of the measurement window after which actual expenditures are compared to the benchmark target for reconciliation and settlement.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP 42 CFR §425.502; BPCI-A Performance Period Definition

attributes.name: performance_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the current performance measurement period for this VBC contract. Defines the window during which attributed member expenditures, quality scores, and utilization are measured against the benchmark.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP 42 CFR §425.502; BPCI-A Performance Period Definition

attributes.name: performance_year
attributes.description: Calendar or contract year for which performance is being measured and reconciled under this VBC contract. Used to track year-over-year performance trends, benchmark updates, and quality score progression. Typically a 4-digit year (e.g., 2024).
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Performance Year Definition; BPCI-A Performance Period; CMMI Model Year Framework

attributes.name: quality_gate_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ACO/provider entity met the minimum quality performance threshold (quality gate) required to be eligible for shared savings distribution. True = quality gate satisfied; False = quality gate not met, shared savings withheld or reduced.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Quality Performance Standard (42 CFR §425.502); NCQA HEDIS Quality Gate Requirements

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: Composite quality performance score (expressed as a decimal percentage, e.g., 0.85 = 85%) achieved by the ACO/provider entity during the performance period. Derived from HEDIS measures, STAR ratings, or contract-specific quality metrics. May gate or adjust shared savings distribution.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Quality Performance Standard (42 CFR §425.502); NCQA HEDIS Measures; CMS STAR Ratings Methodology

attributes.name: reconciliation_methodology
attributes.description: Approach used to calculate and settle financial performance under this VBC contract. Prospective: target price set in advance; Retrospective: actual costs compared to historical benchmark after the period; Hybrid: combination of prospective target with retrospective quality adjustment.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Reconciliation (42 CFR §425.604); BPCI-A Reconciliation Methodology; CMMI Model Design

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the financial reconciliation process for the performance period. Tracks the lifecycle from initial calculation through dispute resolution to final settlement: pending (not yet started), in_progress (under calculation), completed (finalized), disputed (under appeal), settled (payment processed).
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Reconciliation Process (42 CFR §425.604); BPCI-A Reconciliation Methodology; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: risk_arrangement_type
attributes.description: Specifies the financial risk-sharing structure between the health plan and the provider/ACO entity. Upside_only: provider shares in savings only; two_sided: provider shares in both savings and losses; full_risk: provider assumes full financial risk (global capitation); partial_risk: provider assumes a defined portion of risk.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Track 1/1+/2/3 Definitions; CMMI Risk Arrangement Framework; NAIC Risk-Sharing Model Act

attributes.name: risk_corridor_lower
attributes.description: Lower bound of the risk corridor (expressed as a decimal percentage below benchmark) within which no financial settlement occurs. Protects both parties from small random expenditure variations. Equivalent to the Minimum Savings Rate in MSSP terminology.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Risk Corridor Definition; CMMI Risk Corridor Framework; ACA §1342 Risk Corridor Program

attributes.name: risk_corridor_upper
attributes.description: Upper bound of the risk corridor (expressed as a decimal percentage above benchmark) beyond which the health plan absorbs excess losses (stop-loss protection). Limits the provider's maximum financial exposure in two-sided risk arrangements.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Risk Corridor Definition; CMMI Risk Corridor Framework; Stop-Loss Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: savings_sharing_rate
attributes.description: The percentage (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.50 = 50%) of qualifying shared savings that is distributed to the ACO/provider entity. Negotiated contractually and may vary by quality score tier or performance band.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Sharing Rate (42 CFR §425.604(b)); CMMI Shared Savings Distribution

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the shared savings distribution or shared loss recoupment payment was or is scheduled to be processed. Used for financial accrual, IBNR reserve release, and cash flow reporting.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Settlement Timeline; GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SAP Statutory Accounting

attributes.name: shared_savings_amount
attributes.description: Net shared savings (positive) or shared loss (negative) amount in USD calculated after reconciliation. Represents the financial settlement due to or owed by the ACO/provider entity based on performance against the benchmark. Positive = savings distribution; negative = loss recoupment.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Shared Savings Calculation (42 CFR §425.604); BPCI-A Reconciliation; CMMI Settlement Methodology

attributes.name: stop_loss_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount of shared loss that the ACO/provider entity is obligated to repay in a given performance period. Provides downside protection and is a key negotiated term in two-sided risk VBC contracts.
attributes.references: NAIC Stop-Loss Model Act; CMS MSSP Loss Sharing Cap; CMMI Risk Mitigation Provisions

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VBC contract record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance. Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: HIPAA §164.312(b) Audit Controls; NAIC Data Governance Standards; SOC 2 Type II Audit Requirements

attributes.name: vbc_model_type
attributes.description: Classification of the VBC payment model governing this contract. Determines the financial risk structure and reconciliation methodology: shared_savings (upside only), shared_risk (two-sided), full_capitation (global budget), bundled_payment (episode-based), pay_for_performance (quality incentive). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shared_savings|shared_risk|full_capitation|bundled_payment|pay_for_performance|global_budget — promote to reference product if additional models are needed]
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Track Definitions; BPCI-A Model Design; CMMI Alternative Payment Model Framework

products.name: vbc_performance_period
products.description: Defines the measurement and reconciliation periods within a VBC contract. Captures performance year, benchmark expenditure target, actual expenditure, quality score, shared savings or loss amount, reconciliation status, and settlement date. Tracks year-over-year performance trends and supports CMS MSSP and commercial ACO reporting requirements.

attributes.name: vbc_performance_period_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a VBC performance period record within the contract domain. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Program Guidance; NCQA VBC Standards

attributes.name: vbc_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent VBC contract under which this performance period is defined. Links the performance period to its governing contractual agreement.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Program Guidance; NCQA VBC Standards

attributes.name: aco_identifier
attributes.description: Reference to the Accountable Care Organization (ACO) participating in this performance period. Supports CMS MSSP and commercial ACO reporting.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP 42 CFR Part 425; CMS ACO Program Guidance

attributes.name: actual_expenditure
attributes.description: Total actual claims expenditure (in USD) incurred for the attributed population during the performance period. Compared against the benchmark to determine savings or losses.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP 42 CFR Part 425; GAAP; SAP

attributes.name: actual_pmpm
attributes.description: Actual expenditure expressed on a Per Member Per Month (PMPM) basis in USD. Compared against benchmark PMPM to assess cost efficiency of the ACO or provider entity.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Program Guidance; NCQA VBC Standards

attributes.name: appeal_deadline_date
attributes.description: Contractual or regulatory deadline by which the ACO or provider entity must file a formal appeal of the reconciliation results for this performance period.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP 42 CFR Part 425 §425.800; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: attributed_member_count
attributes.description: Total number of members attributed to the ACO or provider entity for this performance period. Used as the denominator for Per Member Per Month (PMPM) calculations and benchmark setting.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP Attribution Methodology 42 CFR Part 425 §425.400

attributes.name: benchmark_expenditure_target
attributes.description: The projected total expenditure benchmark (in USD) established at the start of the performance period, representing the expected cost of care for the attributed population. Basis for shared savings or loss calculations.
attributes.references: CMS MSSP 42 CFR Part 425; CMS Benchmark Methodology

attributes.name: benchmark_pmpm
